```css
  padding: 4px 8px; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: underline;
}

.alert {
  max-width: 66ch; padding: 12px 16px;
  background: var(--paper-2); border: 1px solid var(--tone, var(--rule-strong));
  border-radius: var(--radius); color: var(--ink);
}
.alert p { margin: 0; }
.alert strong { color: var(--tone); font-weight: 600; }

.toast {
  position: fixed; left: 16px; bottom: 16px; max-width: 360px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 12px 16px;
  background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); border-radius: var(--radius);
  animation: toast-in 120ms ease-out;
}
.toast p { margin: 0; }
.toast button { font: inherit; font-weight: 600; color: var(--paper); background: none; border: 0; text-decoration: underline; cursor: pointer; }
:is(.banner, .toast) button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }
.toast button:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--paper); }
@keyframes toast-in { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .toast { animation: none; } }
```

#### States

- Hover and focus on a toast: the dismiss timer pauses and resumes 1 second after the pointer leaves.
- Error resolved: the inline alert is removed, and a `role="status"` line says what changed ("All 120 rows imported.").
- Dismissed: gone for that account, stored server-side, until its condition changes.

#### Copy

```slop
Success! Your changes have been saved successfully.
Oops! Something went wrong. Please try again later.
Heads up! We're making some exciting changes.
```

- Saved. Last edit 14:32.
- Could not save. The server did not answer within 30 seconds. Your text is still here. Try again.
- Maintenance on Sunday 19 Oct, 02:00 to 03:00 UTC. Sync will pause; nothing is lost.

Order: what happened, what it means for the person, what to do.

#### Checklist

- Message placed next to what it is about; banner reserved for account-wide state.
- Status word as first word, not color alone; text contrast at least 4.5:1.
- One banner, one toast visible at a time.
- Errors stay on the page; toasts carry confirmations and undo only.

### 4.3 Avatars

#### What the machine produces

```slop
<div className="flex -space-x-3">
  {users.map((u) => (
    <div className="relative rounded-full bg-gradient-to-tr from-pink-500 to-violet-500 p-0.5">
      <img src={`https://i.pravatar.cc/150?u=${u.id}`} className="h-10 w-10 rounded-full ring-2 ring-white" />
      <span className="absolute bottom-0 right-0 h-3 w-3 rounded-full bg-green-400 ring-2 ring-white" />
    </div>
  ))}
  <div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-indigo-100 text-xs font-medium text-indigo-600 ring-2 ring-white">+5</div>
</div>
```

The Instagram-story gradient ring, `i.pravatar.cc` stock faces, a green presence dot that nobody wired to presence data, and `-space-x-3` overlap with `ring-2 ring-white`. The `img` has no `alt`.

#### Rules

1. Four sizes: 24px in dense lists and table cells, 32px in comments and menus, 40px in headers, 64px on a profile page.
2. People are circles. Organizations, workspaces and bots are squares with `var(--radius)`, so the shape tells the reader which kind of entity it is.
3. Photos get a 1px inner border so a white background in the photo does not bleed into `--paper`: `outline: 1px solid var(--rule); outline-offset: -1px`.
4. The fallback is initials: first letter of the given name and of the family name, 2 letters at most, 40% of the avatar size, weight 500, `var(--ink)` on `var(--paper-3)`. One neutral color for everyone, not a rainbow of hashed hues.
5. Show a presence indicator only when the product tracks presence and refreshes it at least every 60 seconds. Then pair it with text in the tooltip or next to the name: "Active", "Away since 14:10". No pulsing.
6. Stacks show at most 3 avatars, overlapping by 25% of their width, then a text count: "and 12 others" as a link to the full list. The count is text, not a fourth fake circle.
7. `alt` is the person's name. When the name is printed right next to the image, use `alt=""` so a screen reader does not read the name twice.
8. No placeholder services (`i.pravatar.cc`, `randomuser.me`) in production, least of all beside a customer quote.

#### Reference build

```html
<span class="avatar" style="--size: 32px">
  <img src="/u/1187.jpg" alt="" width="32" height="32">
</span>
<span class="avatar" style="--size: 32px" aria-hidden="true">MK</span>
<span class="name">Mira Kowalski</span>

<div class="stack">
  <span class="avatar" style="--size: 24px"><img src="/u/1.jpg" alt="Ana Ruiz" width="24" height="24"></span>
  <span class="avatar" style="--size: 24px"><img src="/u/2.jpg" alt="Tom Berg" width="24" height="24"></span>
  <span class="avatar" style="--size: 24px" title="Li Wen">LW</span>
  <a href="/members">and 12 others</a>
</div>
```

```css
.avatar {
  --size: 32px;
  display: inline-grid; place-items: center; flex: none;
  width: var(--size); height: var(--size); border-radius: 50%;
  overflow: hidden; vertical-align: middle;
  background: var(--paper-3); color: var(--ink);
  font: 500 calc(var(--size) * 0.4)/1 var(--font-sans);
}
.avatar img {
  width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; border-radius: inherit;
  outline: 1px solid var(--rule); outline-offset: -1px;
}
.avatar-org { border-radius: var(--radius); }
.stack { display: flex; align-items: center; }
.stack .avatar + .avatar { margin-left: calc(var(--size) * -0.25); }
.stack .avatar { outline: 2px solid var(--paper); }
.stack a { margin-left: 8px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-2); }
```

#### States

- Loading: the initials fallback renders first and the photo replaces it when loaded. No grey pulsing circle.
- Broken image: catch the `error` event and swap to initials.
- Interactive avatar: 2px focus outline at 2px offset, and a name on the button: "Account menu for Mira Kowalski".

#### Copy

```slop
<img alt="avatar">
<img alt="User profile picture">
+5
```

- `alt=""` when the name is adjacent; `alt="Mira Kowalski"` when it is not.
- "and 12 others", linking to the member list.
- "Active", "Away since 14:10", "Last seen 3 days ago". Only when real.

#### Checklist

- Circles for people, 2px squares for organizations.
- Initials on one neutral `--paper-3` fill, never a hashed rainbow.
- No presence dot without presence data and a text label.
- Stacks capped at 3 plus a text count.

### 4.4 Badges, tags and status indicators

#### What the machine produces

```slop
<span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-green-500/10 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-green-500 ring-1 ring-inset ring-green-500/20">
  <span className="relative flex h-2 w-2">
    <span className="absolute inline-flex h-full w-full animate-ping rounded-full bg-green-400 opacity-75"></span>
    <span className="relative inline-flex h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-green-500"></span>
  </span>
  Live
</span>

<span className="rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-violet-500 to-fuchsia-500 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white">NEW</span>
<span className="rounded-full bg-blue-100 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs text-blue-700">Design</span>
<span className="rounded-full bg-amber-100 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs text-amber-700">Research</span>
```

The first element is copied almost verbatim from the `animate-ping` example in the Tailwind documentation, where it decorates a notification button. Models paste it onto dashboards, landing pages, pricing tables and AI chat headers, with the word "Live" next to it. Below it: the gradient "NEW" pill and one pastel `rounded-full` chip per category, the shadcn `Badge` with hues picked from the Tailwind palette in order.

#### The green-dot LIVE pill, specifically

This handbook bans the green-dot status pill outright. A product that ships one has told the reader the interface was assembled, not designed. The reasons are concrete.

1. It asserts a state nobody checks. The pill is static markup. It says "Live" when the socket closed 20 minutes ago, when the tab was asleep, when the API returns yesterday's batch. A status the code does not compute is decoration pretending to be data.
2. It carries no evidence. "Live" answers nothing a person monitoring a system needs: live since when, how fresh is the last value, how would I know if it stopped. A timestamp answers all three.
3. It moves forever. `animate-ping` loops at 1 second per cycle with no end. WCAG 2.2.2 requires a way to pause any motion that starts automatically and lasts more than 5 seconds, and this handbook allows only 0ms to 150ms transitions in response to a change.
4. It is color alone. Green against grey is the pair people with deuteranopia, about 5% of men, confuse first. The word next to it is in uppercase at 12px with `tracking-wider`, the least readable setting of the least informative word.
5. It is the same pill on every product: crypto tickers, AI chat apps, analytics dashboards and status pages all carry it.

#### What to show instead

Write the state as plain text and attach the evidence: a timestamp, an age, or a count.

- A feed or dashboard: "Updated 14:32:05 UTC (3 s ago)". The age ticks every second under 1 minute, then every minute.
- A connection: "Connected. Last event 14:32:05." When it drops: "Reconnecting, attempt 2 of 5." When it gives up: "Offline since 14:28. Retry."
- A batch source dressed up as real time: say what it is. "Data as of 06:00 today. Next refresh 06:00 tomorrow."
- A real broadcast or stream: "Streaming since 19:00 (1 h 12 min)" in the player chrome, as text, square corners, no dot, no loop.
- A stale feed: after 2 times the expected interval without data, the text changes and takes the `--warn` color: "No new data since 14:28 (4 min)." The person learns the system stopped without needing to notice that a dot stopped pulsing.

| State | Text to show | Color token | Live region |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Receiving data | Connected. Last event 14:32:05 (3 s ago) | `--ink-2` | announce on entry only |
| Late | No new data since 14:28 (4 min) | `--warn` | polite |
| Reconnecting | Reconnecting, attempt 2 of 5 | `--warn` | polite |
| Down | Offline since 14:28. Retry | `--bad` | assertive once |
| Paused by user | Paused at 14:30. Resume | `--ink-2` | polite |
| Batch | Data as of 06:00 today | `--ink-2` | none |

#### Rules

1. Status is text first. A color token may tint the word; a shape never replaces it.
2. No dots, no pulse, no ping, no glow. If a table column needs a scannable mark, put the status word in the column and let the color sit on the word.
3. Every claim of freshness carries a time. Use `<time datetime="...">` with an ISO value and print a local, absolute time; add the relative age in parentheses.
4. Put `role="status"` on the state word only. The ticking age stays outside the live region, or a screen reader announces every second.
5. Tags (user-assigned labels) are 20px tall, 12px text in sentence case, 0 6px padding, 1px `var(--rule)` border, `var(--radius)` corners, `var(--ink-2)` text. All tags share one style. Category hues are not a design; they are a palette walked in order.
6. Show at most 3 tags on a row in a list, then "+2" as text that expands on click.
7. Count badges hold digits only. 18px tall, minimum 18px wide, 12px tabular figures, `var(--ink)` fill with `var(--paper)` text. Cap at "99+". Hide at zero; do not print "0".
8. A "New" label on a menu item or feature expires 30 days after release. Write it as text in `var(--accent)`, no pill, no gradient, no uppercase.

#### Reference build

```html
<p class="feed" data-state="ok">
  <span class="feed-state" role="status">Connected, last event at</span>
  <time class="feed-time" datetime="2026-10-15T14:32:05Z">14:32:05 UTC</time>
  <span class="feed-age">(3 s ago)</span>
</p>

<ul class="tags" aria-label="Tags">
  <li class="tag">Freight</li>
  <li class="tag">Q4 audit</li>
  <li><button class="tag tag-more" type="button">+2</button></li>
</ul>

<a class="nav-item" href="/inbox">Inbox <span class="count" aria-label="14 unread">14</span></a>
```

```css
.feed { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-2); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.feed-state { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 500; }
.feed[data-state="late"] .feed-state { color: var(--warn); }
.feed[data-state="down"] .feed-state { color: var(--bad); }

.tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.tag {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; padding: 0 6px;
  font: 400 12px/1 var(--font-sans); color: var(--ink-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: var(--radius); background: transparent;
}
.tag-more { cursor: pointer; }
.tag-more:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

.count {
  display: inline-grid; place-items: center; min-width: 18px; height: 18px; padding: 0 5px;
  font: 500 12px/1 var(--font-sans); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); border-radius: 9px;
}
```

```js
const feed = document.querySelector(".feed");
const [stateEl, timeEl, ageEl] = feed.querySelectorAll(".feed-state, .feed-time, .feed-age");
let last = Date.now();

function setState(key, text) {
  if (feed.dataset.state !== key) { feed.dataset.state = key; stateEl.textContent = text; }
}
function onEvent(ts) {
  last = ts;
  timeEl.dateTime = new Date(ts).toISOString();
  timeEl.textContent = new Date(ts).toISOString().slice(11, 19) + " UTC";
  setState("ok", "Connected, last event at");
}
setInterval(() => {
  const s = Math.round((Date.now() - last) / 1000);
  ageEl.textContent = s < 60 ? `(${s} s ago)` : `(${Math.floor(s / 60)} min ago)`;
  if (s > 30) setState("late", "No new data since");
}, 1000);
```

Events arrive every 15 seconds, so the stale threshold is 30. Late, the line reads "No new data since 14:28:05 UTC (4 min ago)". The state word changes once per transition, so the live region speaks once.

#### States

- Tag hover (only when tags are links or filters): border goes to `--rule-strong`, text to `--ink`. No fill.
- Tag selected as a filter: `--paper-3` fill, `--ink` text, and `aria-pressed="true"` on the button.
- Removable tag: a trailing 1.5px SVG cross with `aria-label="Remove tag Freight"`.

#### Copy

```slop
LIVE
NEW
Beta
```

- Updated 14:32:05 UTC (3 s ago)
- No new data since 14:28 (4 min)
- New in October: tax lines in CSV export

#### Checklist

- No green dot, no `animate-ping`, no pulsing anything.
- Every "live" or "current" claim replaced by a time and an age.
- Stale threshold set at 2 times the expected interval, with a text change.
- One neutral tag style; no per-category pastel hues.

### 4.5 Breadcrumbs

#### What the machine produces

```slop
<nav className="flex items-center space-x-2 rounded-full bg-gray-100 px-4 py-2 text-sm">
  <a href="/"><HomeIcon className="h-4 w-4 text-gray-500" /></a>
  <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4 text-gray-400" />
  <a href="/dashboard" className="text-gray-500 hover:text-indigo-600">Dashboard</a>
  <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4 text-gray-400" />
  <a href="/dashboard/settings" className="font-medium text-indigo-600">Settings</a>
</nav>
```

Breadcrumbs inside a grey pill, a house icon with no accessible name, chevron icons read aloud by screen readers as images, and the current page styled as an indigo link that reloads itself.

#### Rules

1. Add breadcrumbs only when the hierarchy is 3 or more levels deep and people land on deep pages from search or links.
2. Markup: `<nav aria-label="Breadcrumb">` containing an `<ol>`. The last item is the current page, written as text with `aria-current="page"`, not a link.
3. Separator: a slash or a 1.5px chevron drawn in CSS, with no accessible text. Use `content: "/" / ""` so the separator is skipped by screen readers.
4. 14px text, `--ink-2` for ancestors, `--ink` for the current page. 8px gap on each side of the separator. No container background.
5. The first item is a word ("Projects", "Home"), not an icon alone.
6. Show at most 5 levels. Deeper trails collapse the middle into a button labelled "..." with `aria-label="Show 3 more levels"` that opens a menu of the hidden items.
7. Under 480px, show only the parent as a back link: "Back to Invoices".

#### Reference build

```html
<nav class="crumbs" aria-label="Breadcrumb">
  <ol>
    <li><a href="/projects">Projects</a></li>
    <li><a href="/projects/halden">Halden Freight</a></li>
    <li><a href="/projects/halden/invoices">Invoices</a></li>
    <li><span aria-current="page">Invoice 1042</span></li>
  </ol>
  <a class="crumbs-back" href="/projects/halden/invoices">Back to Invoices</a>
</nav>
```

```css
.crumbs { font-size: 14px; }
.crumbs ol { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.crumbs li { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; color: var(--ink-2); }
.crumbs li + li::before { content: "/" / ""; margin: 0 8px; color: var(--ink-3); }
.crumbs a { color: var(--ink-2); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--rule); text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.crumbs a:hover { color: var(--ink); text-decoration-color: currentColor; }
.crumbs a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }
.crumbs [aria-current="page"] { color: var(--ink); }
.crumbs-back { display: none; }
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .crumbs ol { display: none; }
  .crumbs-back { display: inline; color: var(--ink); }
}
```

#### States

- Hover: ancestor text goes from `--ink-2` to `--ink` and the underline goes from `--rule` to full ink.
- Current: no hover, no pointer cursor, no underline.
- Collapsed: the "..." button opens a menu (see 4.25) listing the hidden levels.

#### Copy

```slop
Home > Dashboard > Settings > General Settings > Settings
Back
```

- Projects / Halden Freight / Invoices / Invoice 1042
- Back to Invoices

#### Checklist

- Only on hierarchies 3 or more levels deep.
- `nav` with `aria-label`, an ordered list, `aria-current` on the last item.
- Separators hidden from assistive tech; no chevron icons with alt text.
- No pill background; 14px, two ink levels.

### 4.6 Buttons

#### What the machine produces

```slop
<button className="group inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 to-purple-600 px-8 py-4 font-semibold text-white shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/50 transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-105 hover:shadow-xl">
  Get Started
  <ArrowRight className="h-5 w-5 transition-transform group-hover:translate-x-1" />
</button>
<button className="rounded-xl border border-gray-300 bg-white/50 px-8 py-4 font-semibold text-gray-700 backdrop-blur-sm hover:bg-white">
  Learn More
</button>
```

The indigo to purple gradient, a colored glow from `shadow-indigo-500/50`, `hover:scale-105` that shifts the layout, an arrow that slides 4px right on hover, and Title Case labels that name no action. The second button is the glass ghost button that always rides next to it. Both then reappear in settings pages and dialogs, because the model reuses its only button.

#### Rules

1. Three sizes: 32px tall for dense toolbars and tables, 40px default, 48px for a single primary action on a marketing page. Horizontal padding 12px, 16px and 20px.
2. Text: 14px at 32px height, 15px or 16px at 40 and 48. Weight 500. Sentence case. No letter spacing.
3. Corners: `var(--radius)`, which is 0 or 2px. Never pill-shaped for a text button.
4. Three levels. Primary: `--accent` fill, `--accent-ink` text, one per view region. Secondary: transparent, 1px `--rule-strong` border, `--ink` text. Tertiary: text only, underlined. Destructive: `--bad` fill, only inside the confirmation step.
5. Hover changes color only: primary darkens by mixing 12% `--ink` into the accent. No scale, no lift, no glow, no icon slide. Transition 100ms `ease-out` on `background-color`.
6. Active: `translateY(1px)` for 0ms in, 100ms out.
7. Minimum target 24px by 24px (WCAG 2.5.8). On touch layouts, 44px by 44px, extended with padding if the visible button is smaller.
8. Labels are a verb plus the object: "Save invoice", "Send 3 reminders", "Delete project". Not "Submit", "OK", "Get started", "Learn more".
9. Prefer `aria-disabled="true"` with an explanation over the `disabled` attribute, so the button stays focusable and the reason is reachable.
10. Loading keeps the button's width fixed, swaps the label to "Saving..." and sets `aria-busy="true"`. Keep that state for at least 400ms even when the request returns in 80ms, so it does not flash.
11. Icon-only buttons are 32px or 40px squares with an `aria-label` and a tooltip after 500ms hover. Icons beside text are 16px and carry meaning (a download glyph on "Download CSV"), never a decorative arrow.

#### Reference build

```html
<button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Save invoice</button>
<button class="btn btn-secondary" type="button">Preview PDF</button>
<button class="btn btn-tertiary" type="button">Discard changes</button>
<button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit" aria-busy="true" style="inline-size: 9.5em">Saving...</button>
<button class="btn btn-icon" type="button" aria-label="Duplicate invoice">
  <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" aria-hidden="true">
    <rect x="5.5" y="5.5" width="8" height="8"/><path d="M10.5 2.5h-8v8"/>
  </svg>
</button>
```

```css
.btn {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px;
  height: 40px; padding: 0 16px;
  font: 500 15px/1 var(--font-sans); letter-spacing: 0; white-space: nowrap;
  border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius);
  cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 100ms ease-out, transform 100ms ease-out;
}
.btn-primary { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); }
.btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 88%, var(--ink)); }
.btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--rule-strong); }
.btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--paper-2); }
.btn-tertiary { background: transparent; color: var(--ink); padding: 0 4px; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.btn-tertiary:hover { text-decoration-thickness: 2px; }
.btn-icon { width: 40px; padding: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--rule); }
.btn-icon:hover { background: var(--paper-2); border-color: var(--rule-strong); }
.btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }
.btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); transition-duration: 0ms; }
.btn[aria-disabled="true"], .btn:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }
.btn[aria-disabled="true"]:active { transform: none; }
.btn[aria-busy="true"] { cursor: progress; }
.btn-sm { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 14px; }
.btn-lg { height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; font-size: 16px; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .btn { transition: none; } .btn:active { transform: none; } }
```

#### States

- Hover: color step only, 100ms. Active: 1px down, no duration on press.
- Focus-visible: 2px `--focus` outline at 2px offset. Never `outline: none` without a replacement.
- Disabled: 45% opacity, `not-allowed` cursor, reason written beside it ("Add at least one line item to save").
- Loading: fixed width, "Saving...", `aria-busy`, at least 400ms.

#### Copy

```slop
Get Started
Learn More
Submit
```

- Save invoice
- Send 3 reminders
- Start 14-day trial (no card)

A good label still makes sense when it is the only thing a person reads in the dialog. "Delete project and 214 files" does; "Confirm" does not.

#### Checklist

- Heights 32, 40, 48; radius 0 or 2px.
- One primary per region; the rest secondary or tertiary.
- Hover is a color step; no scale, glow, gradient or sliding arrow.
- Labels name the action and the object.

### 4.7 Cards

#### What the machine produces

```slop
<div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-8 md:grid-cols-3">
  {features.map((f) => (
    <div key={f.title} className="group rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 bg-white p-8 shadow-sm transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-xl">
      <div className="mb-6 flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-indigo-100">
        <f.icon className="h-6 w-6 text-indigo-600" />
      </div>
      <h3 className="mb-2 text-xl font-semibold text-gray-900">{f.title}</h3>
      <p className="text-gray-600">{f.description}</p>
      <div className="mt-6 rounded-xl border border-gray-100 bg-gray-50 p-4">
        <div className="rounded-lg bg-white p-3 shadow-sm">{f.stat}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  ))}
</div>
```

Three failures in one grid. The icon sits in a 48px `rounded-xl bg-indigo-100` tile, the most recognizable mark of a generated feature section. The card lifts 4px with `hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-xl` even though nothing in it is clickable. And there are three nested enclosures: card, grey panel, white chip, each with its own border radius and padding, so 30% of the width is spent on frames.

#### Rules

1. A card holds one object a person can act on as a unit: a project, an invoice, a listing. Marketing paragraphs and feature lists are not objects. Set them as headings and text in a grid with no boxes.
2. One level of enclosure. Inside a card, separate parts with a 1px `--rule` line or 16px of space, never with another bordered or filled box.
3. No icon tiles. If an icon earns a place, it is 20px, stroke 1.5px, `--ink-2`, inline before the heading or above it with 8px of space. No colored square or circle behind it.
4. Card: 1px `--rule` border, `var(--radius)` corners, `--paper` fill or one tonal step down to `--paper-2`. Padding 16px in dense grids, 24px otherwise.
5. No hover lift, no hover scale, no hover border glow. A card that is a link changes its border to `--rule-strong` and underlines its title. Duration 0ms or 100ms.
6. One link per card, on the title, stretched over the card with a pseudo-element. Do not wrap the card in an `<a>` that also contains buttons; nested interactive elements break keyboard and screen reader use.
7. Title 18px weight 600, metadata 14px `--ink-2`, numbers in tabular figures. Put the fact a person scans for (amount, date, status) in the same position on every card.

#### Reference build

```html
<ul class="cards">
  <li class="card">
    <h3 class="card-title"><a href="/invoices/1042">Invoice 1042</a></h3>
    <p class="card-meta">Halden Freight. Due 28 Oct 2026</p>
    <hr class="card-rule">
    <dl class="card-facts">
      <div><dt>Amount</dt><dd>EUR 4,180.00</dd></div>
      <div><dt>Status</dt><dd class="is-late">12 days late</dd></div>
    </dl>
    <button class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm card-action" type="button">Send reminder</button>
  </li>
</ul>
```

```css
.cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(260px, 1fr)); gap: 16px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.card {
  position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px;
  padding: 16px; background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: var(--radius);
  transition: border-color 100ms ease-out;
}
.card-title { margin: 0; font: 600 18px/1.25 var(--font-sans); }
.card-title a { color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; }
.card-title a::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; }
.card:hover { border-color: var(--rule-strong); }
.card:hover .card-title a { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.card-title a:focus-visible { outline: none; }
.card:has(.card-title a:focus-visible) { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }
.card-meta { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-2); }
.card-rule { width: 100%; margin: 8px 0; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.card-facts { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; margin: 0; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.card-facts dt { font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-3); }
.card-facts dd { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink); }
.card-facts .is-late { color: var(--bad); }
.card-action { position: relative; z-index: 1; align-self: start; margin-top: 8px; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .card { transition: none; } }
```

#### States

- Hover: border to `--rule-strong`, title underline. Nothing moves.
- Focus-visible: the whole card gets the 2px outline through `:has()`, so the focus area matches the click area.
- Selected (in a picker): `--paper-3` fill and `aria-selected` or a checked checkbox in the card's top-left.

```slop
Built for speed. Our platform delivers blazing performance at scale.
Secure by Default
```

- Exports in under 2 seconds. 10,000 rows to CSV in 1.4 s on the median account.
- SSO with SAML and SCIM. Okta, Entra ID and Google Workspace tested.

Headings in a feature grid state the fact. The text below gives the number or the condition.

#### Checklist

- Cards only for objects a person acts on; feature copy set without boxes.
- One enclosure level; no card in a card.
- No icon in a rounded colored square.
- No lift, scale or glow on hover; border and underline only.

### 4.8 Charts and stat tiles

#### What the machine produces

```slop
<Card>
  <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between pb-2">
    <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium">Total Revenue</CardTitle>
    <DollarSign className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
  </CardHeader>
  <CardContent>
    <div className="text-2xl font-bold">$45,231.89</div>
    <p className="text-xs text-green-500">+20.1% from last month</p>
  </CardContent>
</Card>
<AreaChart data={data}>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="colorUv" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="5%" stopColor="#8884d8" stopOpacity={0.8} />
      <stop offset="95%" stopColor="#8884d8" stopOpacity={0} />
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <Area type="monotone" dataKey="uv" stroke="#8884d8" fill="url(#colorUv)" />
</AreaChart>
```

"Total Revenue, $45,231.89, +20.1% from last month" is the first tile of the shadcn dashboard example, reproduced with the same numbers in thousands of generated apps. The chart is the Recharts documentation area chart with its `colorUv` gradient and `#8884d8` lavender. `type="monotone"` smooths the line, which invents values between real points.

#### Rules

1. A stat tile has three lines: label (14px, `--ink-2`), value (32px, weight 500, tabular figures), comparison (14px). No icon in the corner.
2. The comparison names both the absolute change and the period: "+EUR 7,602 vs September (+20.1%)". A percentage alone hides whether the base was 10 or 10 million.
3. Color the comparison by meaning, not by sign. Churn going up is bad; costs going down is good. When the metric has no direction, leave it `--ink-2`.
4. State freshness on the row of tiles, once: "Figures to 14 Oct 23:59 UTC".
5. At most 4 tiles in a row, 5 on a 1440px screen. Separate them with 1px vertical rules or 16px gaps, not with a card per tile.
6. Bar charts start at zero. Line charts may start elsewhere, with the axis labelled.
7. Lines are 1.5px to 2px, straight segments between points. No `monotone` smoothing, no area fill, no gradient.
8. Gridlines are horizontal only, 1px `--rule`, 3 to 5 of them. No vertical gridlines on time series.
9. Tooltips show the exact value with units and the exact date. Every chart has a data table available under it, in a `<details>` titled "Show data".
10. No pie or donut past 5 slices. No 3D. No dual y-axes.

#### Reference build

```html
<section class="stats" aria-labelledby="stats-h">
  <h2 id="stats-h" class="stats-h">October to date <span>Figures to 14 Oct 23:59 UTC</span></h2>
  <dl class="stat-row">
    <div class="stat">
      <dt>Revenue</dt>
      <dd class="stat-value">EUR 45,231</dd>
      <dd class="stat-delta is-good">+EUR 7,602 vs Sep (+20.1%)</dd>
    </div>
    <div class="stat">
      <dt>Churned accounts</dt>
      <dd class="stat-value">31</dd>
      <dd class="stat-delta is-bad">+9 vs Sep (+40.9%)</dd>
    </div>
  </dl>
  <figure class="chart">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 320 120" role="img" aria-label="Daily revenue, 1 to 14 October, from EUR 2,900 to EUR 3,640">
      <g class="grid"><line x1="0" y1="20" x2="320" y2="20"/><line x1="0" y1="60" x2="320" y2="60"/><line x1="0" y1="100" x2="320" y2="100"/></g>
      <polyline class="series" points="0,82 24,76 49,79 73,70 98,66 122,71 147,58 171,52 196,55 220,47 245,40 269,44 294,33 318,28"/>
      <text x="318" y="20" text-anchor="end">EUR 3,640</text>
    </svg>
    <figcaption>Daily revenue, EUR. Source: billing ledger.</figcaption>
  </figure>
</section>
```

```css
.stats-h { font: 600 16px/1.25 var(--font-sans); margin: 0 0 12px; }
.stats-h span { font-weight: 400; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-3); margin-left: 8px; }
.stat-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr)); margin: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.stat { padding: 16px 16px 16px 0; }
.stat + .stat { padding-left: 16px; border-left: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.stat dt { font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-2); }
.stat dd { margin: 0; }
.stat-value { font: 500 32px/1.15 var(--font-sans); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink); margin-top: 4px; }
.stat-delta { font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-2); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.stat-delta.is-good { color: var(--ok); }
.stat-delta.is-bad { color: var(--bad); }
.chart { margin: 24px 0 0; }
.chart svg { width: 100%; height: auto; overflow: visible; }
.chart .grid line { stroke: var(--rule); stroke-width: 1; }
.chart .series { fill: none; stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 2; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.chart text { font: 12px var(--font-sans); fill: var(--ink-2); }
.chart figcaption { font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-3); margin-top: 8px; }
```

#### States

- Hover on a chart: a 1px `--ink-3` vertical rule at the nearest point and a tooltip with the value and date. No enlarged glowing dot.
- Loading: the tile prints its label and "Loading" in place of the value; the chart area keeps its height with the axis drawn.
- No data: "No revenue recorded in October yet." inside the chart frame, axes still visible.
- Error: "Could not load revenue. Retry." with the last known value and its date.

```slop
$45,231.89
+20.1% from last month
```

- Revenue, October to date
- EUR 45,231
- +EUR 7,602 vs September (+20.1%)

#### Checklist

- Tiles: label, value, absolute and relative change with the period.
- Delta color by meaning; freshness stated once.
- No icons in tiles, no card per tile.
- Straight 2px lines, no area fill, no smoothing, horizontal gridlines only.

### 4.9 Checkboxes, radios and switches

#### What the machine produces

```slop
<div onClick={() => setOn(!on)} className={`relative h-7 w-14 cursor-pointer rounded-full transition-colors duration-300 ${on ? "bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 to-purple-500" : "bg-gray-200"}`}>
  <div className={`absolute top-0.5 h-6 w-6 rounded-full bg-white shadow-md transition-transform duration-300 ${on ? "translate-x-7" : "translate-x-0.5"}`} />
</div>
<span className="text-sm text-gray-600">I agree to the Terms of Service</span>
```

A switch made of two divs with a click handler: no role, no keyboard access, no label association, a 300ms slide and a gradient track. It is used for consent, which is a checkbox decision applied on submit.

#### Rules

1. Use native `<input type="checkbox">` and `<input type="radio">`, styled with `accent-color: var(--accent)`. If you rebuild the visual with `appearance: none`, keep the input element.
2. Box size 16px to 20px. The clickable area is the whole `<label>`, at least 24px tall, with 8px between control and text.
3. Checkbox: independent yes or no choices, applied when the form is saved. Consent, opt-ins and filters are checkboxes.
4. Radio: 2 to 5 mutually exclusive options, all visible. Past 5, use a select (4.15). Always one option preselected unless no answer is a valid answer.
5. Switch: a setting that takes effect the moment it changes, with no save button. Use `<input type="checkbox" role="switch">`. Track 36px by 20px, thumb 14px, a printed "On" or "Off" next to it.
6. Group related controls in `<fieldset>` with a `<legend>` that asks the question.
7. Never pre-check consent, marketing or data-sharing boxes. In the EU this is not valid consent (CJEU, Planet49, 2019).
8. The thumb moves in 100ms `ease-out`, or instantly under reduced motion.

#### Reference build

```html
<fieldset class="choice">
  <legend>Send invoices by</legend>
  <label><input type="radio" name="send" value="email" checked> Email, as PDF attachment</label>
  <label><input type="radio" name="send" value="link"> Email, as link to the portal</label>
  <label><input type="radio" name="send" value="post"> Post (EUR 1.20 per letter)</label>
</fieldset>

<label class="check"><input type="checkbox" name="news"> Email me product changes, about 1 per month</label>

<label class="switch">
  <input type="checkbox" role="switch" checked>
  <span class="switch-track" aria-hidden="true"></span>
  <span class="switch-label">Auto-send reminders</span>
  <span class="switch-state" aria-hidden="true"></span>
</label>
```

```css
.choice { margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; }
.choice legend { padding: 0; margin-bottom: 8px; font-weight: 600; }
.choice label, .check { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 32px; cursor: pointer; }
.choice input, .check input { width: 18px; height: 18px; margin: 0; accent-color: var(--accent); }
:is(.choice, .check) input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

.switch { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 32px; cursor: pointer; }
.switch input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 36px; height: 20px; margin: 0; }
.switch-track {
  position: relative; width: 36px; height: 20px; flex: none;
  background: var(--paper-3); border: 1px solid var(--ink-3); border-radius: 10px;
}
.switch-track::after {
  content: ""; position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 14px; height: 14px;
  background: var(--ink-2); border-radius: 50%; transition: transform 100ms ease-out;
}
.switch input:checked + .switch-track { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); }
.switch input:checked + .switch-track::after { transform: translateX(16px); background: var(--accent-ink); }
.switch input:focus-visible + .switch-track { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }
.switch input:disabled ~ * { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }
.switch-state { font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-2); min-width: 2.5em; }
.switch-state::before { content: "Off"; }
.switch input:checked ~ .switch-state::before { content: "On"; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .switch-track::after { transition: none; } }
```

The track border is `--ink-3`, which measures 4.6:1 on `--paper`, so the off state passes the 3:1 non-text contrast rule (WCAG 1.4.11).

#### States

- Focus-visible: 2px outline at 2px offset around the box or the track.
- Checked, unchecked, indeterminate: each visible without color (check mark, empty box, dash).
- Disabled: 45% opacity plus text saying why ("Requires a verified domain").
- Error: a `--bad` line under the legend, linked to the group with `aria-describedby`.

#### Copy

```slop
I agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy and consent to receive marketing communications
Enable notifications
Toggle dark mode
```

- I accept the Terms of Service (link opens in this tab)
- Email me product changes, about 1 per month
- Auto-send reminders 3 days after the due date

Split combined consent into separate boxes, one decision each.

#### Checklist

- Native inputs, real labels, `fieldset` and `legend` for groups.
- Checkbox for submit-time choices, switch only for instant settings.
- Radios for 2 to 5 options, one preselected when valid.
- No pre-checked consent; combined consent split.

### 4.10 Code blocks

#### What the machine produces

```slop
<div className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-900 to-slate-800 shadow-2xl ring-1 ring-white/10">
  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-white/10 px-4 py-3">
    <div className="h-3 w-3 rounded-full bg-red-500" />
    <div className="h-3 w-3 rounded-full bg-yellow-500" />
    <div className="h-3 w-3 rounded-full bg-green-500" />
    <span className="ml-auto text-xs text-slate-400">terminal</span>
  </div>
  <pre className="p-6 font-mono text-sm text-green-400">
    <TypeAnimation sequence={["$ npm install acme-sdk", 1000]} />
  </pre>
</div>
```

The fake macOS window with three traffic-light dots, a slate gradient, `shadow-2xl`, green-on-black terminal text and a typing animation. It shows one line of code inside 60px of decoration, and the `$` prompt is copied along with the command when someone selects it.

#### Rules

1. Block: `--paper-2` background, 1px `--rule` border, `var(--radius)` corners, 16px padding, `var(--font-mono)` at 14px with 1.5 line height. Follow the page theme; do not force a dark block on a light page.
2. No window chrome, no traffic-light dots, no typing animation, no glow.
3. Long lines scroll horizontally inside the block (`overflow-x: auto`).
4. A label row above the block gives the filename or language when it helps: `src/config.ts`, 12px `--ink-2`, 1px rule below it.
5. Copy button: text "Copy", top-right inside the label row, 28px tall. After a click it reads "Copied" for 2000ms, announced through `role="status"`. It copies the code without prompts, line numbers or output lines.
6. Shell examples put the prompt in CSS (`::before`), never in the text, so selection and copy get the command alone.
7. Syntax colors: at most 4 hues plus `--ink`, each at 4.5:1 or better on `--paper-2`. Comments in `--ink-3`, not italic grey at 3:1.
8. Inline code: `--paper-2` background, 0 4px padding, 0.9em, 2px radius, no border.

#### Reference build

```html
<figure class="code">
  <figcaption class="code-head">
    <span>Install</span>
    <button class="code-copy" type="button" data-copy="npm install @halden/sdk@4.2.0">Copy</button>
    <span class="code-status visually-hidden" role="status"></span>
  </figcaption>
  <pre><code><span class="sh">npm install @halden/sdk@4.2.0</span></code></pre>
</figure>
```

```css
.code { margin: 16px 0; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--paper-2); }
.code-head {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px;
  padding: 4px 8px 4px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  font: 12px/1.5 var(--font-sans); color: var(--ink-2);
}
.code-copy {
  height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; font: 500 12px var(--font-sans); color: var(--ink);
  background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: var(--radius); cursor: pointer;
}
.code-copy:hover { border-color: var(--rule-strong); }
.code-copy:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }
.code pre { margin: 0; padding: 16px; overflow-x: auto; tab-size: 2; }
.code code { font: 14px/1.5 var(--font-mono); color: var(--ink); }
.code .sh::before { content: "$ "; color: var(--ink-3); user-select: none; }
:not(pre) > code { padding: 0 4px; font-size: 0.9em; background: var(--paper-2); border-radius: var(--radius); }
```

#### States

- Copy hover: border to `--rule-strong`. Focus-visible: 2px outline.
- Copied: the label changes for 2000ms; no toast, no check glyph.
- Copy failed: the code is selected and the status says "Press Ctrl C to copy".

#### Copy

```slop
Get started in seconds

Copied to clipboard!
```

- `// Retries 3 times with 500ms backoff`
- Copied

#### Checklist

- Block follows the page theme on `--paper-2`, 14px mono, 1.5 line height.
- No window dots, no typing effect, no gradient frame.
- Prompts and line numbers excluded from selection and copy.
- "Copy" becomes "Copied" for 2 seconds, announced politely.

### 4.11 Command palettes

#### What the machine produces

```slop
<Dialog open={open}>
  <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-sm" />
  <Command className="fixed left-1/2 top-1/4 w-full max-w-2xl -translate-x-1/2 rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-white/80 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl">
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4">
      <Sparkles className="h-5 w-5 text-violet-500" />
      <Command.Input placeholder="Ask AI anything or search..." className="h-14 bg-transparent" />
      <kbd className="rounded-md bg-gray-100 px-2 text-xs"><CommandIcon className="inline h-3 w-3" />K</kbd>
    </div>
  </Command>
</Dialog>
```

The cmdk demo with a frosted `bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl` panel, `shadow-2xl`, and a sparkles icon that turns the search field into "Ask AI anything".

#### Rules

1. Open with Ctrl K on Windows and Linux, Cmd K on macOS, and from a visible "Search or run a command" button in the header.
2. Panel: 640px wide at most, top edge at 15vh. 1px `--rule-strong` border, `--paper` fill, `var(--radius)`.
3. Scrim: `rgb(20 20 18 / 0.4)`, no blur.
4. Input: 48px tall, 16px text, no icon unless it is a 16px search glyph.
5. Results: rows 40px tall, at most 8 visible, then the list scrolls. Each row: label, then the context in `--ink-3` ("Invoice 1042, Halden Freight"), then the shortcut right-aligned in 12px mono.
6. Empty query shows the 5 most recent commands, then 3 pinned ones.
7. Filter 1,000 items in under 50ms per keystroke; past that, debounce at 120ms.
8. Keys: Up and Down move and wrap, Enter runs, Esc clears the input, and Esc on an empty input closes. Focus returns to the element that had it before.
9. Pattern: `role="combobox"` on the input, `role="listbox"` on the list, `aria-activedescendant` pointing at the active option. Focus stays in the input.

#### Reference build

```html
<dialog class="palette" aria-label="Command palette">
  <input class="palette-input" role="combobox" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="palette-list"
         aria-activedescendant="cmd-2" aria-autocomplete="list" placeholder="Search or run a command" autocomplete="off">
  <ul class="palette-list" id="palette-list" role="listbox">
    <li class="palette-head" role="presentation">Recent</li>
    <li id="cmd-1" role="option" aria-selected="false">New invoice <kbd>N</kbd></li>
    <li id="cmd-2" role="option" aria-selected="true">Go to <b>Inv</b>oice 1042 <span class="ctx">Halden Freight</span></li>
    <li id="cmd-3" role="option" aria-selected="false">Export <b>inv</b>oices as CSV <kbd>Ctrl E</kbd></li>
  </ul>
</dialog>
```

```css
.palette {
  width: min(640px, calc(100vw - 32px)); margin: 15vh auto 0; padding: 0;
  background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink);
  border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: var(--radius);
}
.palette::backdrop { background: rgb(20 20 18 / 0.4); }
.palette-input {
  width: 100%; height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  font: 16px var(--font-sans); color: var(--ink); background: transparent;
}
.palette-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: -2px; }
.palette-list { max-height: 320px; overflow-y: auto; margin: 0; padding: 4px 0; list-style: none; }
.palette-head { padding: 8px 16px 4px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-3); }
[role="option"] { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; cursor: pointer; }
[role="option"] b { font-weight: 600; }
[role="option"] .ctx { color: var(--ink-3); font-size: 14px; }
[role="option"] kbd { margin-left: auto; font: 12px var(--font-mono); color: var(--ink-3); }
[role="option"]:hover { background: var(--paper-2); }
[role="option"][aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--paper-3); }
```

#### States

- Active option: `--paper-3` fill. Hovered option: `--paper-2`.
- No results: one line with the query quoted and one fallback action.
- Slow command: the row shows "Running..." for up to 1 second, then the palette closes and the page shows the result.

#### Copy

```slop
Ask AI anything...
What would you like to do today?
No results found.
```

- Search or run a command
- No commands match "invocie". Search all records for "invocie"
- Go to Invoice 1042, Halden Freight

#### Checklist

- Ctrl K and Cmd K, plus a visible header button.
- Solid panel, plain scrim, no blur, 640px max.
- Recent commands on an empty query.
- Combobox and listbox roles, active descendant, focus returned on close.

```slop
      </tr>
```

The shadcn data table demo: "Olivia Martin, olivia.martin@email.com, $1,999.00, Success". Uppercase tracked headers, centered amounts, zebra stripes and divider lines at once, a 64px row height from `py-4` plus a two-line cell, a pastel status pill and a "..." button with no label.

#### Rules

1. Numbers align right and use `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`. Text aligns left. Nothing is centered except single-character columns.
2. Units go in the header, not in every cell: "Amount (EUR)".
3. Row height 40px default, 32px compact, 48px only for rows with two-line cells. Cell padding 0 12px.
4. Header: `--paper-2` fill, 14px weight 600, sentence case, `position: sticky; top: 0`. No uppercase tracking.
5. Rows separated by 1px `--rule` lines. No zebra stripes when rules are present. No vertical rules below 8 columns.
6. Sortable headers are buttons inside `th`, with `aria-sort` on the `th` and a 12px arrow drawn in SVG showing the direction.
7. Row hover: `--paper-2`. Selected: `--paper-3` plus a checked checkbox in the first column.
8. Status is a word in a column, colored by token (see 4.4), not a pill.
9. On narrow screens, the table scrolls horizontally inside a container with `tabindex="0"` and a label; the first column sticks to the left.
10. Pagination names the range: "Rows 51 to 100 of 1,284". Changing pages keeps sort and filters.
11. Row actions: a labelled menu button ("Actions for invoice 1042") in the last column, 32px square.

#### Reference build

```html
<div class="table-wrap" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="Invoices, 1,284 rows">
  <table class="table">
    <thead>
      <tr>
        <th scope="col">Invoice</th>
        <th scope="col">Customer</th>
        <th scope="col" class="num" aria-sort="descending"><button type="button">Amount (EUR)</button></th>
        <th scope="col">Status</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><td>1042</td><td>Halden Freight</td><td class="num">4,180.00</td><td class="bad">12 days late</td></tr>
      <tr><td>1041</td><td>Oru Studio</td><td class="num">960.50</td><td>Paid 9 Oct</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
</div>
<p class="table-range">Rows 1 to 50 of 1,284</p>
```

```css
.table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; border: 1px solid var(--rule); max-height: 70vh; }
.table-wrap:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }
.table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 14px; }
.table th, .table td { height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; text-align: left; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); white-space: nowrap; }
.table thead th { position: sticky; top: 0; background: var(--paper-2); font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink); }
.table th:first-child, .table td:first-child { position: sticky; left: 0; background: var(--paper); }
.table thead th:first-child { background: var(--paper-2); z-index: 1; }
.table .num { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.table th button { font: inherit; color: inherit; background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; }
.table th button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }
.table tbody tr:hover td { background: var(--paper-2); }
.table tbody tr[aria-selected="true"] td { background: var(--paper-3); }
.table .bad { color: var(--bad); }
.table-range { font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-2); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
```

#### States

- Loading the first page: header renders at once; the body shows one row reading "Loading invoices" for up to 1 second, then rows of `--paper-2` blocks at real column widths.
- Empty: see 4.16. Headers stay visible.
- Error: one full-width row: "Could not load invoices. Retry." Filters remain applied.

#### Copy

```slop
Showing 1-10 of 100 results
No data available
Status: Success
```

- Rows 1 to 50 of 1,284
- No invoices match "Halden" and "Late". Clear filters
- Paid 9 Oct / 12 days late / Draft

#### Checklist

- Numbers right-aligned in tabular figures; units in headers.
- 40px rows, sticky `--paper-2` header, sentence case.
- Rules or stripes, never both.
- `aria-sort` on sortable headers; labelled row action buttons.

### 4.13 Date pickers

#### What the machine produces

```slop
<Popover>
  <PopoverTrigger asChild>
    <Button variant="outline" className="w-[280px] justify-start rounded-xl text-left font-normal">
      <CalendarIcon className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
      {date ? format(date, "PPP") : <span>Pick a date</span>}
    </Button>
  </PopoverTrigger>
  <PopoverContent className="w-auto rounded-2xl p-0 shadow-xl">
    <Calendar mode="single" selected={date} onSelect={setDate} classNames={{ day_selected: "rounded-full bg-indigo-600 text-white" }} />
  </PopoverContent>
</Popover>
```

The shadcn date picker, used for every date field including date of birth, where it starts at today and takes 40 clicks back to reach 1986. The trigger is a button, so the date cannot be typed or pasted. The selected day is an `indigo-600` circle.

#### Rules

1. Typing comes first. Every date field accepts text, shows the expected format above the field ("DD/MM/YYYY", matching the locale) and parses common variants (3/11/2026, 3 Nov 2026, 2026-11-03).
2. After parsing, echo the date in words under the field: "Tuesday 3 November 2026". This catches day and month swaps.
3. Dates far from today (birth dates, passport expiry) use three fields (day, month, year) or one text field. No calendar.
4. A calendar is for picking near-future dates where the weekday matters: bookings, deadlines. It opens from a 32px button next to the field, labelled "Choose date".
5. Grid cells 40px square, 14px tabular figures. The week starts on the locale's first day.
6. Today: 1px `--rule-strong` border. Selected: `--ink` fill with `--paper` text. Ranges: `--paper-3` fill between the ends. Unavailable: `--ink-3` text with a strike-through and `aria-disabled`.
7. Keyboard per the WAI-ARIA date picker dialog pattern: arrows move by day and week, Page Up and Down by month, Home and End to week edges, Enter selects, Esc closes.
8. State limits in text before the person hits them: "Delivery dates from 20 Oct to 20 Dec".

#### Reference build

```html
<div class="field">
  <label for="due">Due date</label>
  <p class="hint" id="due-hint">DD/MM/YYYY. From 20 Oct to 20 Dec 2026.</p>
  <div class="date-row">
    <input id="due" class="input" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="off" aria-describedby="due-hint due-echo" value="03/11/2026">
    <button class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog">Choose date</button>
  </div>
  <p class="echo" id="due-echo" aria-live="polite">Tuesday 3 November 2026</p>
</div>
```

```css
.date-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
.date-row .input { width: 12ch; }
.echo { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-2); }
.cal button { width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius); background: none; }
.cal button[aria-current="date"] { border-color: var(--rule-strong); }
.cal button[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); }
```

#### States

- Valid: the echo line shows the full date.
- Unparseable: "Could not read 31/02/2026. February has 28 days in 2026." in `--bad` under the field, on blur.
- Out of range: "Choose a date between 20 Oct and 20 Dec." with the range repeated, not "Invalid date".

#### Copy

```slop
Pick a date
Invalid date
Select date range
```

- Due date (DD/MM/YYYY)
- Tuesday 3 November 2026
- Choose a date between 20 Oct and 20 Dec.

#### Checklist

- Typed input with a visible format; parsed variants; date echoed in words.
- No calendar for birth dates or dates years away.
- 40px cells, today outlined, selected filled with ink.
- Keyboard per the APG date picker dialog.

### 4.14 Dialogs and modals

#### What the machine produces

```slop
<div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in duration-300" />
<div className="fixed left-1/2 top-1/2 z-50 w-full max-w-md -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-2xl bg-white p-6 shadow-2xl animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-300">
  <div className="mx-auto flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-red-100">
    <AlertTriangle className="h-6 w-6 text-red-600" />
  </div>
  <h2 className="mt-4 text-center text-lg font-semibold">Are you absolutely sure?</h2>
  <p className="mt-2 text-center text-sm text-gray-500">This action cannot be undone.</p>
  <div className="mt-6 flex gap-3"><Button variant="outline">Cancel</Button><Button variant="destructive">Continue</Button></div>
</div>
```

The shadcn `AlertDialog` copy ("Are you absolutely sure? This action cannot be undone.") with a blurred scrim, a 300ms zoom, centered text and an icon in a red circle. "Continue" does not say what will be deleted. The dialog is a div, so focus can escape to the page behind.

#### Rules

1. Use `<dialog>` with `showModal()`. It traps focus, makes the page inert, closes on Esc and has a `::backdrop`.
2. Widths: 480px for confirmations, 640px for short forms, 800px maximum.
3. 1px `--rule-strong` border, `--paper` fill, `var(--radius)`. Scrim `rgb(20 20 18 / 0.5)`. No blur.
4. Title 21px weight 600, left-aligned, naming the object: "Delete invoice 1042?"
5. Body states the consequence in numbers: what is lost, what is kept, whether it can be undone.
6. Buttons right-aligned, 8px apart, cancel first, action last. The action label repeats the verb and the object.
7. Initial focus: the first field in a form dialog; the cancel button in a destructive confirmation.
8. Esc and the cancel button close. A click on the scrim closes only when nothing is typed.
9. On close, focus returns to the element that opened the dialog.
10. Open with a 120ms opacity change. No zoom, no slide.
11. Prefer undo over confirmation for reversible actions. Confirm only what cannot be undone.

#### Reference build

```html
<dialog class="dialog" id="del" aria-labelledby="del-title" aria-describedby="del-body">
  <form method="dialog">
    <h2 id="del-title">Delete invoice 1042?</h2>
    <p id="del-body">The PDF and 3 payment reminders are deleted. The customer record and the ledger entry stay. You cannot undo this.</p>
    <div class="dialog-actions">
      <button class="btn btn-secondary" value="cancel" autofocus>Cancel</button>
      <button class="btn btn-danger" value="delete">Delete invoice 1042</button>
    </div>
  </form>
</dialog>
```

```css
.dialog {
  width: min(480px, calc(100vw - 32px)); max-height: 85vh; padding: 24px;
  color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper);
  border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: var(--radius);
}
.dialog[open] { animation: dialog-in 120ms ease-out; }
.dialog::backdrop { background: rgb(20 20 18 / 0.5); }
.dialog h2 { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 600 21px/1.25 var(--font-sans); }
.dialog p { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-2); max-width: 60ch; }
.dialog-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; margin-top: 24px; }
.btn-danger { background: var(--bad); color: var(--accent-ink); }
.btn-danger:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bad) 88%, var(--ink)); }
@keyframes dialog-in { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .dialog[open] { animation: none; } }
```

#### States

- Submitting: the action button shows "Deleting..." with `aria-busy`; cancel stays enabled until the request is sent.
- Error: the message appears inside the dialog above the buttons, in `--bad`, and the dialog stays open.
- Unsaved changes: Esc asks once, in place: "Discard changes to this form? Discard / Keep editing".

#### Copy

```slop
Are you absolutely sure?
This action cannot be undone.
Continue
```

- Delete invoice 1042?
- The PDF and 3 payment reminders are deleted. The ledger entry stays. You cannot undo this.
- Cancel / Delete invoice 1042

#### Checklist

- Native `dialog` with `showModal`, focus returned on close.
- 480, 640 or 800px; solid scrim; no blur, no zoom.
- Title names the object; body gives consequences in numbers.
- Action label repeats verb and object.

### 4.15 Dropdown menus

#### What the machine produces

```slop
<Listbox value={selected} onChange={setSelected}>
  <Listbox.Button className="relative w-full rounded-xl border bg-white py-3 pl-4 pr-10 text-left shadow-sm focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-500/20">
    {selected?.name ?? "Select an option..."}
    <ChevronUpDownIcon className="absolute right-3 top-3.5 h-5 w-5 text-gray-400" />
  </Listbox.Button>
  <Transition>
    <Listbox.Options className="absolute mt-2 max-h-60 w-full overflow-auto rounded-xl bg-white py-1 shadow-lg ring-1 ring-black/5">
      {options.map((o) => <Listbox.Option value={o} className="ui-active:bg-indigo-600 ui-active:text-white">{o.name}<CheckIcon className="text-indigo-600" /></Listbox.Option>)}
    </Listbox.Options>
  </Transition>
</Listbox>
```

The Headless UI listbox from the Tailwind UI examples, rebuilt for a field with 3 options that should have been radio buttons. `ring-4 ring-indigo-500/20` is the halo focus ring of every Tailwind form, and the active row inverts to solid `indigo-600`.

#### Rules

1. Match the control to the option count: 2 to 5, radio buttons (4.9); 6 to 15, a native `<select>`; more than 15, or options people search by name, a combobox. Action menus are in 4.25.
2. Style the native select: `appearance: none`, 40px tall, 1px `--ink-3` border, 2px radius, 12px left padding, 32px right padding for the chevron.
3. The placeholder is a real first option with an empty value: "Choose a country". Required selects do not preselect a guess.
4. Custom listbox panels: at least the trigger's width, at most 320px tall, 1px `--rule-strong` border, `--paper` fill, 4px gap below the trigger.
5. Option rows 36px, 14px text. The selected option shows a 16px check drawn in SVG on the left and weight 600. The keyboard-active option gets `--paper-3`. No solid accent fill on the active row.
6. Group long lists with non-selectable headings (`optgroup` natively). Put the 3 to 5 most used options in a "Frequent" group at the top.
7. Flip above the trigger when there is less than 320px below it.

#### Reference build

```html
<div class="field">
  <label for="country">Country</label>
  <div class="select">
    <select id="country" name="country" required autocomplete="country">
      <option value="">Choose a country</option>
      <optgroup label="Frequent">
        <option value="DE">Germany</option>
        <option value="FR">France</option>
      </optgroup>
      <optgroup label="All countries">
        <option value="AT">Austria</option>
        <option value="BE">Belgium</option>
      </optgroup>
    </select>
  </div>
</div>
```

```css
.select { position: relative; max-width: 320px; }
.select select {
  appearance: none; width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 0 32px 0 12px;
  font: 16px var(--font-sans); color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper);
  border: 1px solid var(--ink-3); border-radius: var(--radius); cursor: pointer;
}
.select::after {
  content: ""; position: absolute; right: 14px; top: 50%; width: 6px; height: 6px;
  border-right: 1.5px solid var(--ink-2); border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--ink-2);
  transform: translateY(-70%) rotate(45deg); pointer-events: none;
}
.select select:hover { border-color: var(--ink); }
.select select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }
.select select:invalid { color: var(--ink-3); }
.select select[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--bad); }
.select select:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }
```

#### States

- Hover: border from `--ink-3` to `--ink`.
- Focus-visible: 2px outline at 2px offset, no colored halo.
- Placeholder showing: `--ink-3` text via `:invalid` on a required select.
- Error: `--bad` border plus a text line below (see 4.19).

#### Copy

```slop
Select an option...
Please select
-- Select --
```

- Choose a country
- Choose a VAT rate (19%, 7% or 0%)
- Frequent / All countries

#### Checklist

- Radios for up to 5, native select to 15, combobox beyond.
- Native select styled, not replaced, where possible.
- Placeholder is an empty first option; no preselected guess on required fields.
- Selected marked with check and weight; active row in `--paper-3`.

### 4.16 Empty states

#### What the machine produces

```slop
<div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-24 text-center">
  <div className="mb-6 flex h-24 w-24 animate-bounce items-center justify-center rounded-full border-2 border-dashed border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50">
    <Rocket className="h-10 w-10 text-indigo-500" />
  </div>
  <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold">No projects yet</h3>
  <p className="mt-2 text-gray-500">Get started by creating your first project. It only takes a few seconds!</p>
  <Button className="mt-6 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 to-purple-500">+ Create Project</Button>
</div>
```

A bouncing rocket in a dashed indigo circle, centered in 192px of vertical padding, with copy that says "get started" and a promise about seconds. The same block appears for a new account, for a search with no matches and for a failed load, which are three different situations.

#### Rules

1. Write a separate state for each cause: first use, no results for a filter, everything done (inbox zero), no permission, failed to load.
2. Keep the frame. An empty table keeps its header row; an empty list keeps its toolbar and filters. The empty message sits where the first row would be.
3. Left-align the message with the content, 16px text, max 52ch.
4. Three parts at most: what will appear here, why it is empty now, one action. Two sentences and one button.
5. No illustrations taller than 120px, no animation, no mascots.
6. For filtered results, print the active filters and offer "Clear filters" plus the closest broad search.
7. For first use, offer the fastest real path in: import from a file, connect an account, or a sample dataset that is labelled as sample and removable in one click.
8. For no permission, name who can grant it: "Ask an admin (Mira Kowalski) for Billing access."

#### Reference build

```html
<table class="table">
  <thead><tr><th scope="col">Invoice</th><th scope="col">Customer</th><th scope="col" class="num">Amount (EUR)</th></tr></thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr><td colspan="3" class="empty">
      <p><strong>No invoices match Halden Freight and Late.</strong> 214 invoices exist for other filters.</p>
      <button class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" type="button">Clear filters</button>
    </td></tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
```

```css
.empty { height: auto; padding: 24px 12px; white-space: normal; }
.empty p { margin: 0 0 12px; max-width: 52ch; color: var(--ink-2); }
.empty strong { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; }
```

#### States

- First use: action is primary.
- No results: action is secondary; the filters stay editable above.
- Done: no action at all. "All 38 invoices for October are paid."
- Error: "Could not load invoices. Retry." with the error code in `--ink-3`.

#### Copy

```slop
No data yet
Nothing to see here!
It looks like you don't have any projects yet. Get started by creating your first project.
```

- Invoices you create or import appear here. Import a CSV from your old tool, or create one.
- No invoices match Halden Freight and Late. Clear filters
- All 38 invoices for October are paid.

#### Checklist

- One state per cause, each with its own text.
- Table headers, toolbars and filters stay visible.
- Left-aligned, two sentences, one action.
- No large illustration, no animation.

### 4.17 File upload

#### What the machine produces

```slop
<div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border-2 border-dashed border-gray-300 bg-gray-50 p-12 transition hover:border-indigo-500 hover:bg-indigo-50">
  <div className="mb-4 rounded-full bg-indigo-100 p-4"><CloudUpload className="h-8 w-8 text-indigo-600" /></div>
  <p className="text-lg font-medium">Drag & drop your files here</p>
  <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">or <span className="text-indigo-600 underline">click to browse</span></p>
  <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-gray-400">Supports: PNG, JPG, GIF up to 10MB</p>
  <div className="mt-4 h-2 w-full rounded-full bg-gray-200"><div className="h-2 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 to-purple-500" style={{ width: `${progress}%` }} /></div>
</div>
```

The react-dropzone demo: a dashed `rounded-2xl` box with a cloud icon in a circle, "click to browse" as a span that is not a button, limits in `gray-400` at 12px (about 2.5:1), and one gradient progress bar for all files together.

#### Rules

1. The control is a real `<input type="file">` behind a visible button, "Choose files". Drag and drop is an addition on top, not the only path; on touch devices it does not exist.
2. State limits before upload, in `--ink-2` at 14px: types, size per file, file count. "PDF or PNG, up to 20 MB each, 10 files at most."
3. Set `accept` to the same types, and validate type and size on the client before sending.
4. Drop zone: 1px solid `--rule` border on `--paper-2`, 24px padding, left-aligned text. On `dragover`, `--paper-3` fill and `--rule-strong` border.
5. One row per file: name, size, progress as a percentage and a 4px bar, and a per-file "Cancel" or "Remove" button.
6. Errors are per file and say why: "scan-03.tiff: TIFF is not accepted. Convert to PDF or PNG." The other files continue.
7. Do not clear the list on an error, and do not lose the files on a failed form submit.

#### Reference build

```html
<div class="upload" data-drag="false">
  <label class="btn btn-secondary" for="files">Choose files</label>
  <input id="files" type="file" multiple accept=".pdf,.png,application/pdf,image/png" class="visually-hidden" aria-describedby="files-limits">
  <p id="files-limits">Or drop them here. PDF or PNG, up to 20 MB each, 10 files at most.</p>
</div>
<ul class="files">
  <li><span class="f-name">contract-2026.pdf</span><span class="f-size">4.2 MB</span>
    <progress max="100" value="64">64%</progress><span class="f-pct">64%</span>
    <button type="button" class="btn-tertiary btn">Cancel</button></li>
  <li class="is-error"><span class="f-name">scan-03.tiff</span>
    <span class="f-msg">TIFF is not accepted. Convert to PDF or PNG.</span>
    <button type="button" class="btn-tertiary btn">Remove</button></li>
</ul>
```

```css
.upload { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 12px 16px; padding: 24px; background: var(--paper-2); border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: var(--radius); }
.upload[data-drag="true"] { background: var(--paper-3); border-color: var(--rule-strong); }
.upload p { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-2); }
.upload:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }
.visually-hidden { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); }
.files { margin: 8px 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; font-size: 14px; }
.files li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 120px 4ch auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 40px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.files .f-size, .files .f-pct { color: var(--ink-2); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; }
.files progress { width: 120px; } /* bar colors as in 4.24 */
.files .is-error { grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr auto; }
.files .f-msg { color: var(--bad); }
```

#### States

- Drag over: `--paper-3` and strong border, no scale.
- Uploading: per-file percentage, cancel available.
- Done: the bar is replaced by the text "Uploaded".
- Error: per-file reason in `--bad` and a remove button; other files continue.

#### Copy

```slop
Drag & drop your files here or click to browse
Supports: PNG, JPG, GIF up to 10MB
Upload failed
```

- Choose files
- Or drop them here. PDF or PNG, up to 20 MB each, 10 files at most.
- scan-03.tiff: TIFF is not accepted. Convert to PDF or PNG.

#### Checklist

- Native file input behind a real button; drop is optional.
- Limits printed before upload at 4.5:1 contrast; `accept` set.
- One row per file with size, percentage and cancel.
- Errors per file with the reason; nothing cleared on failure.

### 4.18 Footers

#### What the machine produces

```slop
<footer className="border-t bg-gradient-to-b from-white to-gray-50">
  <div className="mx-auto grid max-w-7xl grid-cols-2 gap-8 px-6 py-16 md:grid-cols-6">
    <div className="col-span-2">
      <Logo />
      <p className="mt-4 text-sm text-gray-500">Making the world a better place through constructing elegant hierarchies.</p>
      <div className="mt-6 flex gap-4">{socials.map((s) => <a className="rounded-full bg-gray-100 p-2 hover:bg-indigo-100"><s.icon className="h-5 w-5" /></a>)}</div>
    </div>
  </div>
```
