```slop
</footer>
```

The Tailwind UI footer with its own placeholder tagline (`Making the world a better place through constructing elegant hierarchies`, a line from the TV series Silicon Valley), social icons in grey circles, four columns of links that lead to `#`, a hardcoded copyright year and "Made with a heart".

#### Rules

1. The footer holds what people scroll to the bottom to find: contact, legal pages, system status, the company's legal name and address, and a short site map. Nothing promotional.
2. At most 4 link columns, each with a 14px weight 600 heading and up to 7 links. Links 14px, 32px row pitch so touch targets clear 24px.
3. Background `--paper-2` with a 1px `--rule` top border. 48px top padding, 32px bottom.
4. Social links are text ("GitHub", "LinkedIn"), or 20px stroke icons with an `aria-label`. No circles.
5. The legal line names the entity and where it is registered where required: "Halden Software GmbH, Torstrasse 12, 10119 Berlin. HRB 123456 B." Germany and Austria require an imprint page; link it as "Imprint".
6. Compute the copyright year from the build or server date. "All rights reserved" has no legal effect under the Berne Convention; leave it out.
7. Remove every link that points to `#`.

#### Reference build

```html
<footer class="footer">
  <nav class="footer-cols" aria-label="Footer">
    <div><h2>Product</h2><ul><li><a href="/pricing">Pricing</a></li><li><a href="/changelog">Changelog</a></li><li><a href="https://status.halden.example">Status</a></li></ul></div>
    <div><h2>Company</h2><ul><li><a href="/about">About</a></li><li><a href="/jobs">Jobs (3 open)</a></li><li><a href="mailto:hello@halden.example">hello@halden.example</a></li></ul></div>
    <div><h2>Legal</h2><ul><li><a href="/terms">Terms</a></li><li><a href="/privacy">Privacy</a></li><li><a href="/imprint">Imprint</a></li></ul></div>
  </nav>
  <p class="footer-legal">&copy; 2026 Halden Software GmbH, Torstrasse 12, 10119 Berlin. HRB 123456 B.</p>
</footer>
```

```css
.footer { background: var(--paper-2); border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); padding: 48px 16px 32px; font-size: 14px; }
.footer-cols { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr)); gap: 32px; max-width: 1080px; margin: 0 auto; }
.footer h2 { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 600 14px/1.25 var(--font-sans); color: var(--ink); }
.footer ul { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.footer li { line-height: 32px; }
.footer a { color: var(--ink-2); text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.footer a:hover { color: var(--ink); }
.footer a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }
.footer-legal { max-width: 1080px; margin: 32px auto 0; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); color: var(--ink-3); }
```

#### States

- Links: underlined, `--ink-2`, `--ink` on hover, 2px outline on focus-visible.

#### Copy

```slop
Made with love in San Francisco
© 2024 Acme Inc. All rights reserved.
Stay in the loop! Subscribe to our newsletter.
```

- Halden Software GmbH, Torstrasse 12, 10119 Berlin. HRB 123456 B.
- Status (all systems running at 14:30 UTC)
- Monthly changelog, 1 email. Unsubscribe in one click.

#### Checklist

- Contact, legal, status, address; no slogans.
- 4 columns at most, 14px links on 32px rows.
- Social links as text or labelled 20px icons.
- Year computed; "All rights reserved" removed.

### 4.19 Forms and text inputs

#### What the machine produces

```slop
<form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6 rounded-2xl bg-white p-8 shadow-xl">
  <div className="relative">
    <Mail className="absolute left-4 top-3.5 h-5 w-5 text-gray-400" />
    <input type="email" placeholder="Enter your email" className="peer w-full rounded-xl border border-gray-200 py-3 pl-12 pr-4 placeholder-transparent focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-500/20" />
    <label className="absolute left-12 top-3 text-sm text-gray-500 transition-all peer-placeholder-shown:text-base peer-focus:-top-2.5 peer-focus:text-xs">Email</label>
  </div>
  <button className="w-full rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-violet-600 py-3 text-white">Submit</button>
</form>
```

A floating label that shrinks into the border on focus, an envelope icon that repeats the word "Email", a `gray-200` border that measures about 1.3:1 against white, the `ring-4 ring-indigo-500/20` halo, a gradient "Submit", and a form floating in a `shadow-xl` card. Errors arrive as a toast after submit.

#### Rules

1. Labels sit above the input, 14px weight 500, 4px gap. Never inside the field, never only as a placeholder.
2. Input height 40px, 0 12px padding, 16px text. Below 16px, iOS Safari zooms the page on focus.
3. Border 1px `--ink-3` (4.6:1 on `--paper`). WCAG 1.4.11 asks 3:1 for the boundary of a control; `--rule` does not reach it.
4. Field width follows the expected answer: postcode 8ch, year 6ch, IBAN 34ch, email 32ch. Not every field at 100%.
5. Hints go between label and input in 14px `--ink-2`, linked with `aria-describedby`.
6. Mark optional fields with "(optional)" in the label. Do not scatter red asterisks.
7. Validate on blur and on submit, never on each keystroke. Remove an error as soon as the input becomes valid.
8. Errors go under the field in `--bad`, starting with what to do: "Enter an IBAN that starts with 2 letters". Set `aria-invalid="true"` and add the error id to `aria-describedby`.
9. On submit with more than 2 errors, show a summary at the top listing each error as a link to its field, and move focus to the summary.
10. Set `autocomplete`, `inputmode` and `type` on every field: `email`, `tel`, `postal-code`, `one-time-code`.
11. Keep the submit button enabled; let the click run validation and show what is missing.

#### Reference build

```html
<div class="field">
  <label for="iban">IBAN</label>
  <p class="hint" id="iban-hint">On your bank statement. 22 characters for Germany.</p>
  <input class="input" id="iban" name="iban" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"
         aria-describedby="iban-hint iban-err" aria-invalid="true" style="width: 34ch" value="DE89 3704">
  <p class="error" id="iban-err">Enter the full IBAN. This one has 8 of 22 characters.</p>
</div>
<div class="field">
  <label for="ref">Reference <span class="opt">(optional)</span></label>
  <input class="input" id="ref" name="ref" style="width: 24ch">
</div>
```

```css
.field { display: grid; gap: 4px; margin-bottom: 24px; }
.field label { font: 500 14px/1.4 var(--font-sans); color: var(--ink); }
.field .opt { font-weight: 400; color: var(--ink-2); }
.hint { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-2); max-width: 60ch; }
.input {
  max-width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px;
  font: 16px var(--font-sans); color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper);
  border: 1px solid var(--ink-3); border-radius: var(--radius);
}
.input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-3); }
.input:hover { border-color: var(--ink); }
.input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }
.input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--bad); border-width: 2px; padding: 0 11px; }
.input:disabled, .input[readonly] { background: var(--paper-2); border-color: var(--rule); color: var(--ink-2); }
.error { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--bad); }
```

The error border goes to 2px so the change is visible without color; the padding drops by 1px so the text does not shift.

#### States

- Hover: border to `--ink`. Focus-visible: 2px outline at 2px offset.
- Invalid: 2px `--bad` border plus the error line. Valid again: both removed at once; no green tick.
- Disabled and read-only: `--paper-2` fill, `--rule` border. Read-only text stays selectable.

#### Copy

```slop
Please enter a valid email address.
This field is required.
Enter your email
```

- Enter an email address with an @, like name@company.com
- Enter your postcode. We use it to work out VAT.
- IBAN (on your bank statement)

#### Checklist

- Labels above, 16px input text, 40px fields.
- Field boundary at 3:1 or more.
- Widths match the answer length.
- Errors under fields, on blur and submit, with a summary past 2 errors.

### 4.20 Headers and top navigation

#### What the machine produces

```slop
<header className="sticky top-0 z-50 border-b border-white/20 bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-lg">
  <div className="mx-auto flex h-16 max-w-7xl items-center justify-between px-6">
    <span className="bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 to-purple-600 bg-clip-text text-xl font-bold text-transparent">Acme</span>
    <nav className="hidden gap-8 md:flex">{["Features", "Pricing", "About", "Blog"].map((l) => <a className="text-sm text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900">{l}</a>)}</nav>
    <div className="flex gap-3"><Button variant="ghost">Sign in</Button><Button className="rounded-full">Get Started</Button></div>
  </div>
</header>
```

The frosted sticky header (`bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-lg`), a wordmark in `bg-clip-text` gradient, centered links with no current-page marker, and a pill "Get Started". Text over translucent blur changes contrast with whatever scrolls behind it.

#### Rules

1. Height 56px in apps, 64px on marketing pages. Solid `--paper` fill, 1px `--rule` bottom border. No blur, no transparency.
2. At most 6 top-level links. Labels are nouns for places: "Pricing", "Docs", "Customers".
3. The current section gets `aria-current="page"`, `--ink` text and a 2px `--ink` bar along the header's bottom edge.
4. One call to action on the right, secondary style in apps, primary on marketing pages. "Sign in" is a text link.
5. A skip link is the first focusable element: "Skip to content", visible on focus.
6. Below the width where the links fit, replace them with a button labelled "Menu" that opens a full-width panel. Not a lone hamburger icon.

#### Reference build

```html
<a class="skip" href="#main">Skip to content</a>
<header class="hdr">
  <a class="hdr-logo" href="/"><img src="/logo.svg" alt="Halden" width="88" height="20"></a>
  <nav aria-label="Main">
    <ul class="hdr-nav">
      <li><a href="/product">Product</a></li>
      <li><a href="/pricing" aria-current="page">Pricing</a></li>
      <li><a href="/docs">Docs</a></li>
    </ul>
  </nav>
  <div class="hdr-end"><a href="/login">Sign in</a><a class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" href="/signup">Start trial</a></div>
</header>
```

```css
.skip { position: absolute; left: 16px; top: -48px; padding: 8px 12px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); z-index: 10; }
.skip:focus { top: 8px; }
.hdr {
  position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 5; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 32px;
  height: 64px; padding: 0 24px; background: var(--paper); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
}
.hdr-nav { display: flex; gap: 24px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.hdr-nav a { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 64px; font-size: 15px; color: var(--ink-2); text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; margin-bottom: -1px; }
.hdr-nav a:hover { color: var(--ink); }
.hdr-nav a[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--ink); border-bottom-color: var(--ink); }
.hdr a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }
.hdr-end { margin-left: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; font-size: 15px; }
.hdr-end > a:first-child { color: var(--ink); }
```

#### States

- Link hover: `--ink-2` to `--ink`. Current: ink plus 2px bar.
- Menu open (narrow screens): the button reads "Close menu", `aria-expanded="true"`, and the panel sits under the header on `--paper` with 48px rows.
- Signed in: the right side becomes the account avatar button (4.3) with an accessible name.

#### Copy

```slop
Get Started
Solutions
Resources
```

- Product / Pricing / Docs / Customers
- Sign in / Start trial
- Skip to content

#### Checklist

- Solid paper header, 1px bottom rule, no blur.
- 6 links at most, nouns, current page marked.
- One call to action; sign in as a link.
- Skip link first; "Menu" button with text on narrow screens.

### 4.21 Hero sections

#### What the machine produces

```slop
<section className="relative overflow-hidden bg-slate-950 py-32 text-center">
  <div className="absolute left-1/2 top-0 h-[600px] w-[1200px] -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-indigo-500/30 blur-3xl" />
  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-indigo-500/30 bg-indigo-500/10 px-4 py-1.5 text-sm text-indigo-300">
    <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4" /> Now with AI <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4" />
  </span>
  <h1 className="mt-8 bg-gradient-to-r from-white via-indigo-200 to-purple-400 bg-clip-text text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-transparent md:text-7xl">
    Build the future of work, faster
  </h1>
  <p className="mx-auto mt-6 max-w-2xl text-lg text-slate-400">The all-in-one platform that helps teams ship faster with AI-powered workflows.</p>
  <div className="mt-10 flex justify-center gap-4">
    <Button size="lg" className="rounded-full bg-indigo-500 shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/50">Get Started Free</Button>
    <Button size="lg" variant="outline" className="rounded-full">Watch Demo</Button>
  </div>
  <img src="/dashboard.png" className="mx-auto mt-16 rounded-2xl border border-white/10 shadow-2xl [transform:perspective(1200px)_rotateX(12deg)]" />
</section>
```

Five defaults stacked: a radial indigo glow (`blur-3xl` on a `bg-indigo-500/30` blob), a "Now with AI" pill with sparkles and an arrow, a headline in `bg-clip-text` gradient that names no product, two pill buttons ("Get Started Free" and "Watch Demo"), and a dashboard screenshot tilted with `rotateX` and floating on `shadow-2xl`. Readers skip it the way they skip banner ads.

#### Rules

1. The headline says what the product does and for whom, in 10 words or fewer: "Invoicing for freight companies that bill by the pallet." Left-aligned, 40px to 56px, weight 600, line height 1.1, max 20ch per line, solid `--ink`.
2. One supporting sentence, 18px or 21px, `--ink-2`, max 52ch, with a number or a constraint in it.
3. One primary button and, at most, one text link. The link leads somewhere specific ("See pricing", "Read the API docs"), not "Watch demo".
4. No pill above the headline. If there is news, write one line of text with a date as a link: "12 Oct: CSV import with tax lines".
5. No glow, no grid backdrop, no noise texture, no blob. The background is `--paper`.
6. The image is the product at real size, or a cropped detail at 1:1 pixels, inside a 1px `--rule` border. No tilt, no perspective, no floating, no browser chrome mockup.
7. Height follows content. Not `min-height: 100vh`; the next section should show above the fold at 1440 by 900.
8. Proof, if any, is specific and sourced: "Used by 412 freight firms in 9 countries" with the count updated from data, not "Trusted by thousands".

#### Reference build

```html
<section class="hero">
  <div class="hero-text">
    <p class="hero-news"><a href="/changelog#2026-10-12">12 Oct: CSV import with tax lines</a></p>
    <h1>Invoicing for freight companies that bill by the pallet.</h1>
    <p class="hero-sub">Turn delivery notes into invoices with VAT per country. 412 firms in 9 countries send 38,000 invoices a month with it.</p>
    <div class="hero-actions">

      <a href="/pricing">See pricing</a>
    </div>
  </div>
  <figure class="hero-shot">
    <img src="/shots/invoice-1042.png" width="1200" height="760" alt="Invoice editor showing 14 pallet lines grouped by delivery note, with German and Austrian VAT totals.">
  </figure>
</section>
```

```css
.hero { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 5fr) minmax(0, 7fr); gap: 48px; align-items: start; padding: 64px 24px 96px; max-width: 1280px; margin: 0 auto; }
.hero h1 { margin: 0; font: 600 clamp(40px, 5vw, 56px)/1.1 var(--font-sans); color: var(--ink); max-width: 20ch; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
.hero-news { margin: 0 0 24px; font-size: 14px; }
.hero-news a { color: var(--ink-2); text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.hero-sub { margin: 24px 0 32px; font-size: 21px; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--ink-2); max-width: 52ch; }
.hero-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; }
.hero-actions > a:last-child { color: var(--ink); text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.hero-shot { margin: 0; border: 1px solid var(--rule); background: var(--paper-2); }
.hero-shot img { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; }
@media (max-width: 900px) { .hero { grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding-top: 48px; } }
```

#### States

- Primary button: as 4.6. Text link: underline thickens to 2px on hover.
- Image loading: the figure reserves space with `width` and `height`, so nothing jumps; `--paper-2` shows until the image arrives.
- Narrow screens: one column, headline at 40px, image below the actions.

#### Copy

```slop
Now with AI
Build the future of work, faster
The all-in-one platform that helps teams ship faster with AI-powered workflows.
```

- Invoicing for freight companies that bill by the pallet.
- Turn delivery notes into invoices with VAT per country.
- Start 14-day trial / See pricing

#### Checklist

- Headline names the product's job and audience, 10 words or fewer, solid ink.
- One button, one text link.
- No pill, no glow, no grid backdrop, no gradient text.
- Real screenshot, flat, 1px border, no tilt.

### 4.22 Links

#### What the machine produces

```slop
<p className="text-gray-600">
  To learn more about our pricing, <a href="/pricing" className="font-medium text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-500">click here</a>.
</p>
<a href="/docs" className="group inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-sm font-semibold text-indigo-600">
  Learn more <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4 transition-transform group-hover:translate-x-1" />
</a>
```

Links told apart by `indigo-600` color alone, underline removed by Tailwind's preflight, "click here" as link text, and "Learn more" with a sliding arrow. Out of context, a screen reader's link list reads "click here, Learn more, Learn more, Learn more".

#### Rules

1. Links in running text are underlined. Color alone fails WCAG 1.4.1 unless the contrast between link and body text is 3:1, which `--accent` against `--ink` is not.
2. Underline 1px at `text-underline-offset: 0.2em`. Hover thickens it to 2px. No color change needed.
3. Link text names the destination: "the pricing page", "invoice 1042", "Read the API rate limits". Never "click here", "here", "this link".
4. Navigation and button-like links may drop the underline only where position makes them obvious: header, footer columns, tabs.
5. Name the file and size for downloads: "Annual report (PDF, 2.4 MB)".
6. Open links in the same tab. Use a new tab only for help pages opened from inside a form being filled, and say so: "(opens in new tab)".

#### Reference build

```html
<p>Prices are on <a href="/pricing">the pricing page</a>. The <a href="/files/report-2025.pdf">2025 annual report (PDF, 2.4 MB)</a> lists every fee change.</p>
```

```css
a { color: var(--ink); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; }
a:hover { text-decoration-thickness: 2px; }
a:visited { color: var(--ink-2); }
a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; text-decoration: none; }
a:active { color: var(--accent); }
```

#### States

- Hover: 2px underline. Focus-visible: outline replaces the underline. Active: accent for the press.
- Visited: `--ink-2` in documentation and long reading pages only.
- Broken or disabled: do not render as a link; write plain text and say why if it matters.

#### Copy

```slop
Click here
Learn more
Read more
```

- the pricing page
- 2025 annual report (PDF, 2.4 MB)
- Read the API rate limits

#### Checklist

- Underlined in running text; 1px, 2px on hover.
- Link text names the destination.
- File type and size on downloads.
- Same tab by default; new tab announced.

### 4.23 Lists

#### What the machine produces

```slop
<ul className="space-y-4">
  <li className="flex items-start gap-3"><CheckCircle2 className="h-6 w-6 flex-none text-green-500" /><span><strong>Seamless Integration:</strong> Connect with your favorite tools effortlessly.</span></li>
  <li className="flex items-start gap-3"><CheckCircle2 className="h-6 w-6 flex-none text-green-500" /><span><strong>Advanced Analytics:</strong> Gain actionable insights in real time.</span></li>
  <li className="flex items-start gap-3"><CheckCircle2 className="h-6 w-6 flex-none text-green-500" /><span><strong>Enterprise Security:</strong> Bank-level encryption keeps your data safe.</span></li>
</ul>
```

Green check-circle icons as bullets, 16px of space between one-line items, and the language-model list signature: a bold Title Case label, a colon, then a sentence that restates the label.

#### Rules

1. Use `<ul>` with the native disc or a 6px hyphen marker, `<ol>` only when order matters (steps, rankings), `<dl>` for term and value pairs.
2. Marker in `--ink-3`, indent 1.25em, 4px between single-line items, 8px between multi-line items.
3. No icons as bullets. A check mark claims a verified result; a feature list is not one.
4. Do not open every item with "Bold label: sentence".
5. Items share grammar: all noun phrases or all sentences starting with a verb.
6. 3 to 7 items. Longer lists get subheadings or become a table.

#### Reference build

```html
<ul class="list">
  <li>Imports CSV, XLSX and JSON up to 50 MB</li>
  <li>Calculates VAT for 27 EU countries and Switzerland</li>
  <li>Sends reminders 3, 10 and 30 days after the due date</li>
</ul>
<dl class="pairs">
  <div><dt>Plan</dt><dd>Team, 12 seats</dd></div>
  <div><dt>Renews</dt><dd>1 Feb 2027</dd></div>
</dl>
```

```css
.list { margin: 0 0 16px; padding-left: 1.25em; max-width: 66ch; }
.list li { margin-bottom: 4px; padding-left: 4px; }
.list li::marker { color: var(--ink-3); }
.list.is-dash { list-style: none; padding-left: 0; }
.list.is-dash li { position: relative; padding-left: 1.25em; }
.list.is-dash li::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0.75em; width: 6px; border-top: 1px solid var(--ink-3); }
.pairs { display: grid; gap: 8px; margin: 0; }
.pairs div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 12ch 1fr; gap: 16px; }
.pairs dt { color: var(--ink-2); }
.pairs dd { margin: 0; color: var(--ink); }
```

#### States

- Lists are static. Interactive lists (selectable rows) follow 4.12 and 4.25.

#### Copy

```slop
Seamless Integration: Connect with your favorite tools effortlessly.
Advanced Analytics: Gain actionable insights in real time.
Enterprise Security: Bank-level encryption keeps your data safe.
```

- Imports CSV, XLSX and JSON up to 50 MB
- Calculates VAT for 27 EU countries and Switzerland
- Encrypts data at rest with AES-256; keys rotate every 90 days

#### Checklist

- Native markers in `--ink-3`; no icon bullets.
- 4px between short items.
- No "Bold label:" on every item.
- Parallel grammar; 3 to 7 items.

### 4.24 Loading and skeletons

#### What the machine produces

```slop
<div className="flex h-screen items-center justify-center">
  <div className="h-12 w-12 animate-spin rounded-full border-4 border-indigo-500 border-t-transparent" />
</div>
<div className="space-y-3">
  <div className="h-4 w-3/4 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-gray-200" />
  <div className="relative h-4 w-1/2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-gray-200 before:absolute before:inset-0 before:-translate-x-full before:animate-[shimmer_2s_infinite] before:bg-gradient-to-r before:from-transparent before:via-white/60 before:to-transparent" />
</div>
```

A full-screen spinner for a request that takes 120ms, and `animate-pulse` bars with rounded ends at fixed widths unrelated to the content that will replace them, with a shimmer gradient sweeping across. Both loop forever and say nothing about progress.

#### Rules

1. Under 300ms: show nothing.
2. 300ms to 1 second: keep the old content, set `aria-busy="true"` on the region, and show a short text line: "Loading invoices".
3. Over 1 second for a first load: a static skeleton that matches the real layout (table rows at real column widths, the card grid at real card size) in `--paper-2` blocks with `var(--radius)` corners.
4. No pulse, no shimmer, no spinner loop. Skeletons are still. If the wait has no known length, print the elapsed time once per second after 3 seconds: "Still loading (6 s)".
5. When progress is known, show it as a number and a bar: "Exporting 4,210 of 12,000 rows (35%)".
6. Over 10 seconds: offer "Cancel", and say what continues in the background: "You can leave this page. We will email the file."
7. Announce completion once with `role="status"` ("Loaded 50 invoices"), not each tick.

#### Reference build

```html
<section aria-busy="true" aria-labelledby="inv-h">
  <h2 id="inv-h">Invoices</h2>
  <p class="loading-text" role="status">Loading invoices <span class="elapsed"></span></p>
  <div class="sk-table" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="sk-row"><span style="width: 6ch"></span><span style="width: 18ch"></span><span class="sk-num" style="width: 9ch"></span></div>
    <div class="sk-row"><span style="width: 6ch"></span><span style="width: 14ch"></span><span class="sk-num" style="width: 8ch"></span></div>
  </div>
  <p class="progress-line">Exporting 4,210 of 12,000 rows (35%)</p>
  <progress max="12000" value="4210">35%</progress>
</section>
```

```css
.loading-text { font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-2); }
.sk-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.sk-row span { display: block; height: 12px; background: var(--paper-2); border-radius: var(--radius); }
.sk-row .sk-num { margin-left: auto; }
.progress-line { margin: 16px 0 4px; font-size: 14px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
progress { appearance: none; width: 100%; max-width: 480px; height: 4px; border: 0; background: var(--paper-3); }
progress::-webkit-progress-bar { background: var(--paper-3); }
progress::-webkit-progress-value { background: var(--ink); }
progress::-moz-progress-bar { background: var(--ink); }
```

The `.elapsed` span is filled once per second after 3 seconds, with the same `setInterval` pattern as the feed status in 4.4.

#### States

- Loaded: skeleton replaced in one frame; `aria-busy` removed; status says what loaded.
- Slow: elapsed seconds, then cancel at 10 seconds.
- Failed: the text line turns into the error with a retry button; the skeleton is removed so it does not look like it is still trying.

#### Copy

```slop
Loading...
Hang tight! We're getting things ready for you.
Almost there...
```

- Loading invoices
- Still loading (6 s)
- Exporting 4,210 of 12,000 rows (35%)

#### Checklist

- Nothing under 300ms; text from 300ms; skeleton past 1 second.
- Skeletons match real layout and do not move.
- No pulse, shimmer or spinner loop; elapsed time instead.
- Known progress as number and bar; cancel past 10 seconds.

### 4.25 Menus and context menus

#### What the machine produces

```slop
<DropdownMenu>
  <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild><Button variant="ghost" size="icon"><MoreHorizontal /></Button></DropdownMenuTrigger>
  <DropdownMenuContent className="w-56 rounded-xl shadow-lg animate-in zoom-in-95">
    <DropdownMenuLabel>My Account</DropdownMenuLabel>
    <DropdownMenuItem><User className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />Profile<DropdownMenuShortcut>Shift Cmd P</DropdownMenuShortcut></DropdownMenuItem>
    <DropdownMenuItem><CreditCard className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />Billing</DropdownMenuItem>
    <DropdownMenuItem className="text-red-600"><Trash className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />Delete</DropdownMenuItem>
    <DropdownMenuItem><Settings className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />Settings</DropdownMenuItem>
  </DropdownMenuContent>
</DropdownMenu>
```

The shadcn `DropdownMenu` demo, down to the "My Account" label: an unlabelled "..." trigger, an icon on every row, a zoom-in animation, and a red "Delete" that sits between two harmless items where a slip of the pointer reaches it.

#### Rules

1. Use the WAI-ARIA menu button pattern: a `<button aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded>` and a `role="menu"` list of `role="menuitem"` elements.
2. The trigger has a name that includes the object: "Actions for invoice 1042". A visible label ("Actions") beats an icon alone.
3. Items 32px tall, 14px text, 12px horizontal padding. Panel at least 180px wide, 1px `--rule-strong` border, `--paper` fill, 4px from the trigger.
4. Icons on every item or on none.
5. Groups separated by a 1px `--rule` line with 4px of space. 3 groups and 12 items at most; beyond that, the menu is a page.
6. Destructive items go last, in their own group, in `--bad` text. They open a confirmation (4.14) or run with undo.
7. Shortcuts right-aligned, 12px mono, `--ink-3`, written as text: "Ctrl D", "Shift Ctrl P". Match the platform: "Cmd D" on macOS.
8. Keyboard: Enter, Space and Down open and focus the first item; Up and Down move and wrap; Home and End jump; letters jump by first letter; Esc closes and returns focus to the trigger.
9. Every context menu action is also reachable from a visible control or menu. Right-click is a shortcut, never the only path.
10. Position inside the viewport; flip up or left when it would overflow. One level of submenu at most.

#### Reference build

```html
<div class="menu-wrap">
  <button class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" id="inv-1042-btn" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="inv-1042-menu">Actions<span class="visually-hidden"> for invoice 1042</span></button>
  <ul class="menu" id="inv-1042-menu" role="menu" aria-labelledby="inv-1042-btn">
    <li role="none"><button role="menuitem" tabindex="-1">Edit<kbd>E</kbd></button></li>
    <li role="none"><button role="menuitem" tabindex="-1">Duplicate<kbd>Ctrl D</kbd></button></li>
    <li role="none"><button role="menuitem" tabindex="-1">Download PDF</button></li>
    <li role="separator"></li>
    <li role="none"><button role="menuitem" tabindex="-1" class="is-bad">Delete invoice</button></li>
  </ul>
</div>
```

```css
.menu-wrap { position: relative; display: inline-block; }
.menu {
  position: absolute; top: calc(100% + 4px); left: 0; min-width: 180px; z-index: 20;
  margin: 0; padding: 4px 0; list-style: none;
  background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: var(--radius);
}
.menu [role="menuitem"] {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; width: 100%; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px;
  font: 14px var(--font-sans); color: var(--ink); text-align: left; background: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer;
}
.menu [role="menuitem"]:hover { background: var(--paper-2); }
.menu [role="menuitem"]:focus-visible { background: var(--paper-3); outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: -2px; }
.menu [role="menuitem"][aria-disabled="true"] { color: var(--ink-3); cursor: not-allowed; }
.menu kbd { margin-left: auto; font: 12px var(--font-mono); color: var(--ink-3); }
.menu [role="separator"] { margin: 4px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.menu .is-bad { color: var(--bad); }
```

#### States

- Hover: `--paper-2`. Keyboard focus: `--paper-3` with an inset 2px outline.
- Disabled item: `--ink-3`, `aria-disabled`, still focusable, with the reason in a tooltip ("Paid invoices cannot be edited").
- Checkable item: `role="menuitemcheckbox"` with `aria-checked`, a 16px SVG check on the left.

#### Copy

```slop
My Account
Delete
More options
```

- Actions for invoice 1042
- Duplicate / Download PDF / Delete invoice
- Ctrl D

#### Checklist

- Menu button pattern with roles and keyboard support.
- Trigger names the object; text label preferred over "...".
- 32px items, icons on all or none, 12 items and 3 groups at most.
- Destructive item last, separated, confirmed or undoable.

## Part 5. Components, N to Z, and Marketing Sections

This Part finishes the component catalogue from Part 4, then covers the sections of a marketing page. Reference builds use the tokens from Part 1.6 and no shadow, gradient or backdrop blur.

### 5.1 Navigation sidebars

#### What the machine produces

```slop
<aside className="flex h-screen w-72 flex-col bg-gradient-to-b from-slate-900 to-indigo-950 p-4 shadow-2xl">
  <div className="mb-8 flex items-center gap-2">
    <div className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-500 to-purple-600">
      <SparklesIcon className="h-5 w-5 text-white" />
    </div>
    <span className="text-xl font-bold text-white">Nexora</span>
  </div>
  <nav className="space-y-1">
    <a className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/20 px-4 py-3 text-white shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/20">
      <HomeIcon className="h-5 w-5" /> Dashboard
    </a>
    <a className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-slate-400 hover:bg-white/5">
      <ChartBarIcon className="h-5 w-5" /> Insights
      <span className="ml-auto rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-pink-500 to-orange-400 px-2 text-xs">New</span>
    </a>
  </nav>
  <div className="mt-auto rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-600 to-purple-700 p-4">
    <p className="font-semibold text-white">Upgrade to Pro</p>
    <p className="text-sm text-indigo-200">Unlock all features</p>
  </div>
</aside>
```

This is the dark application shell from the Tailwind UI catalogue, crossed with the shadcn `Sidebar` block. The logo is a gradient `rounded-xl` square holding a sparkle, the active item glows with `shadow-indigo-500/20`, a "New" pill sits on an item nobody asked about, and the bottom of the rail carries an upgrade card that has nothing to do with getting around the product. The dark rail beside a white content area doubles the number of surfaces the eye has to reconcile.

#### Rules

1. Width is 240px expanded and 56px collapsed. No other widths.
2. Background is `--paper-2` with a 1px `--rule` right border. The sidebar uses the same theme as the content. A dark rail on a light app is banned.
3. Items are 32px tall with 8px horizontal padding, 14px text, a 16px icon, and an 8px gap between icon and label.
4. The active item gets three signals: `--paper-3` background, a 2px `--ink` left bar, and weight 500. It also gets `aria-current="page"`. Never mark the active item with color alone.
5. At most 7 items per group and at most 3 groups. Group labels are 12px, `--ink-3`, sentence case, with 16px above them.
6. Counts are allowed only when they change what the user does next, such as unread messages. Show them as plain 12px monospace numerals. "New", "Beta" and "Hot" pills are banned.
7. Plan status and upgrade prompts live in Settings, Billing. Never put a promotional card in the rail.
8. Below 768px the sidebar becomes a drawer opened by a 40px menu button. The drawer enters with `transform: translateX` over 150ms `ease-out`, and with no motion under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
9. Collapsed, the labels stay in the DOM, clipped for screen readers, and each item shows a tooltip after 500ms of hover (see 5.14).

#### Reference build

```html
<nav class="side" aria-label="Main">
  <a class="side-brand" href="/">Ledgerline</a>
  <ul class="side-list">
    <li><a href="/inbox" aria-current="page"><svg class="i" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-inbox"/></svg><span class="side-text">Inbox</span><span class="side-count">12</span></a></li>
    <li><a href="/invoices"><svg class="i" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-file"/></svg><span class="side-text">Invoices</span></a></li>
  </ul>
  <p class="side-label" id="nav-reports">Reports</p>
  <ul class="side-list" aria-labelledby="nav-reports">
    <li><a href="/reports/aging"><svg class="i" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-clock"/></svg><span class="side-text">Aging</span></a></li>
    <li><a href="/reports/tax"><svg class="i" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-percent"/></svg><span class="side-text">Sales tax</span></a></li>
  </ul>
</nav>
```

```css
.side {
  position: sticky; top: 0;
  width: 240px; height: 100vh; overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 12px 8px;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--rule);
  font: 14px/20px var(--font-sans);
}
.side-brand { display: block; padding: 6px 8px; margin-bottom: 16px; color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; }
.side-list { list-style: none; margin: 0 0 16px; padding: 0; }
.side-list a {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  height: 32px; padding: 0 8px;
  border-left: 2px solid transparent;
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  color: var(--ink-2); text-decoration: none;
}
.side-list a:hover { background: var(--paper-3); color: var(--ink); }
.side-list a[aria-current="page"] { background: var(--paper-3); border-left-color: var(--ink); color: var(--ink); font-weight: 500; }
.side-list a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }
.side-text { overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.side-count { margin-left: auto; font: 12px var(--font-mono); color: var(--ink-3); }
.side-label { margin: 16px 0 4px; padding: 0 8px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-3); }
.i { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex: none; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; }
.side[data-collapsed] { width: 56px; }
.side[data-collapsed] :is(.side-text, .side-label, .side-count) { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); }
```

#### States

- Current: background, left bar and weight together, plus `aria-current="page"`.
- Collapsed: icons only, labels kept for screen readers, state stored per user so it survives reloads.
- Long labels: truncate with an ellipsis at one line and expose the full label in a tooltip.

#### Copy

```slop
Dashboard / Insights Hub / AI Studio / Magic Workspace
Upgrade to Pro. Unlock all features.
```

Name items after the objects inside them: Inbox, Invoices, Customers, Aging, Sales tax. Use "Home" only when the page shows a real summary. Put the plan name and seat count on the Billing page, in a sentence such as "Team plan, 8 of 10 seats used."

#### Checklist

- Width is 240px or 56px, background `--paper-2`, 1px right border.
- Active item has background, left bar, weight and `aria-current`.
- No pills, no upgrade card, no gradient logo tile.
- No more than 7 items in a group.
- Drawer below 768px, no motion with reduced motion set.

### 5.2 Notifications and toasts

#### What the machine produces

```slop
<div className="fixed right-4 top-4 z-50 w-96 rounded-xl border border-white/20 bg-white/80 p-4 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-lg">
  <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
    <div className="rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-400 to-teal-500 p-2">
      <CheckCircleIcon className="h-5 w-5 text-white" />
    </div>
    <div>
      <p className="font-semibold text-gray-900">Success!</p>
      <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">Your changes have been saved successfully.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 h-1 animate-shrink rounded-b-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 to-purple-500" />
</div>
```

This is the `react-hot-toast` and `sonner` default with a glass card from the Tailwind UI notification panel. It stacks in the top-right corner, where it covers the save button and the account menu. It says `Success!` twice in two different words, uses an icon in a gradient circle, and drains a gradient countdown bar that tells the reader to hurry.

#### Rules

1. Toast only the result of an action the user just took that is not already visible. If the saved value is on screen, the toast is noise. Remove it.
2. Place toasts bottom-left, 24px from both edges, at most 400px wide. Show one at a time. A newer toast replaces the older one.
3. Success toasts stay for 6000ms. Hovering or focusing a toast pauses the timer. A toast with an action such as Undo stays for at least 10000ms. Error toasts never auto-dismiss.
4. Success uses a container with `role="status"` (polite). Errors use `role="alert"`. Render the live region empty on page load, then insert text into it.
5. One sentence at 14px, at most 2 lines. Name the object: "Invoice INV-2041 archived", not "Item archived".
6. Use an inverted surface: `--ink` background, `--paper` text, no border, `--radius` corners. The inversion separates it from the page without a shadow.
7. Enter with opacity 0 to 1 and `translateY(8px)` to 0 over 150ms. No exit animation over 100ms. No motion under reduced motion. No countdown bar.
8. The notification inbox behind a bell icon shows a numeral up to 99, then "99+". Unread rows get an 8px `--accent` square and weight 600 titles. Group by day.

#### Reference build

```html
<div class="toast-region" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>

<!-- inserted by script after the action completes -->
<div class="toast">
  <p class="toast-text">Invoice INV-2041 archived.</p>
  <button type="button" class="toast-action">Undo</button>
  <button type="button" class="toast-close" aria-label="Dismiss">
    <svg class="i" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-x"/></svg>
  </button>
</div>
```

```css
.toast-region { position: fixed; left: 24px; bottom: 24px; z-index: 50; max-width: min(400px, calc(100vw - 48px)); }
.toast {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  padding: 12px 8px 12px 16px;
  background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  font: 14px/20px var(--font-sans);
  animation: toast-in 150ms ease-out;
}
.toast-text { margin: 0; flex: 1; }
.toast-action { background: none; border: 0; padding: 4px 8px; color: var(--paper); font: inherit; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; cursor: pointer; }
.toast-close { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; background: none; border: 0; color: var(--paper); cursor: pointer; }
.toast button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--paper); outline-offset: 2px; }
.toast[data-tone="error"] { border-left: 4px solid var(--bad); }
@keyframes toast-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .toast { animation: none; } }
```

#### States

- Success: text only, no icon. The sentence carries the meaning.
- Error: `role="alert"`, 4px `--bad` left bar, a fix action where one exists, no timer.
- Offline queue: a single persistent toast, "Offline. 3 changes will sync when you reconnect."

#### Copy

```slop
Success! Your changes have been saved successfully.
Oops! Something went wrong. Please try again later.
Heads up! You've got new notifications.
Woohoo! You're all set.
```

- Invoice INV-2041 archived. Undo
- Could not send to ana@harbor.co. The address bounced. Edit address
- 3 files uploaded to Q3 receipts.
- Offline. 3 changes will sync when you reconnect.

#### Checklist

- Toast only for changes the user cannot already see.
- Bottom-left, one at a time, 400px max.
- Errors persist and use `role="alert"`.
- Timers pause on hover and focus. No countdown bar.
- Inverted `--ink` surface, no blur, no icon circle.

### 5.3 Onboarding flows and checklists

#### What the machine produces

```slop
<div className="fixed bottom-6 right-6 w-80 rounded-2xl bg-white p-6 shadow-2xl ring-1 ring-black/5">
  <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
    <svg className="h-14 w-14"><circle className="stroke-indigo-100" /><circle className="stroke-[url(#grad)]" strokeDasharray="20 100" /></svg>
    <div>
      <p className="font-bold">Welcome aboard, Alex!</p>
      <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">You're 20% of the way there</p>
    </div>
  </div>
  <ul className="mt-4 space-y-3">
    <li className="flex gap-2 line-through text-gray-400"><CheckCircleIcon className="text-emerald-500" /> Create your account</li>
    <li className="flex gap-2"><CircleIcon /> Explore the dashboard</li>
    <li className="flex gap-2"><CircleIcon /> Connect your favorite tools</li>
  </ul>
  <button className="mt-4 w-full rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 to-purple-600 py-2 text-white">Let's go</button>
</div>
```

This is the floating checklist from Intercom and Appcues-style onboarding widgets, rebuilt with a progress ring in an SVG gradient. The first task is pre-checked ("Create your account") to inflate progress, the next one ("Explore the dashboard") cannot be completed because it is not an action, and the widget covers the bottom-right corner where most primary actions in a form sit. Product tours with pulsing hotspot dots and confetti on completion usually come with it.

#### Rules

1. At most 5 tasks. Each task completes when the user does the real thing in the product, detected by the product. Never offer "Mark as done".
2. Never pre-complete a task to make progress look further along. Account creation is not a task.
3. Show progress as "2 of 5 done". No percent, no ring, no bar under 5 steps.
4. Place the checklist inline at the top of the home page, inside a 1px `--rule` border. Floating corner widgets are banned.
5. The checklist is dismissible from the first visit. Dismissal persists per user. A "Setup guide" link in the help menu brings it back.
6. Each task has a verb title, one line saying what it does for the user, and one button that goes straight to the place where it happens.
7. Ask at most 3 questions between sign-up and the product. Each answer must change something visible, such as currency, time zone, or which sample data loads.
8. Product tours are banned over 3 steps. No pulsing hotspot dots, no confetti, no mascot.

#### Reference build

```html
<section class="setup" aria-labelledby="setup-h">
  <header class="setup-head">
    <h2 id="setup-h">Set up Ledgerline</h2>
    <p class="setup-count">2 of 5 done</p>
    <button type="button" class="setup-hide">Hide</button>
  </header>
  <ol class="setup-list">
    <li data-done>
      <span class="box" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M3.5 8.5l3 3 6-7"/></svg></span>
      <div><p class="t">Connect a bank account</p><p class="d">Done. Imported 412 transactions from the last 90 days.</p></div>
    </li>
    <li>
      <span class="box" aria-hidden="true"></span>
      <div><p class="t">Send your first invoice</p><p class="d">Pick a customer, add line items, and email a PDF.</p></div>
      <a class="setup-go" href="/invoices/new">New invoice</a>
    </li>
  </ol>
</section>
```

```css
.setup { border: 1px solid var(--rule); background: var(--paper); margin-bottom: 32px; }
.setup-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 16px; padding: 16px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.setup-head h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.25; }
.setup-count { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-2); font-size: 14px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.setup-hide { margin-left: auto; background: none; border: 0; color: var(--ink-2); font: inherit; font-size: 14px; text-decoration: underline; cursor: pointer; }
.setup-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.setup-list li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 16px 1fr auto; gap: 16px; align-items: start; padding: 16px 24px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.setup-list li:first-child { border-top: 0; }
.box { width: 16px; height: 16px; margin-top: 2px; border: 1px solid var(--ink-3); border-radius: var(--radius); }
.box svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; fill: none; stroke: var(--paper); stroke-width: 1.5; }
li[data-done] .box { background: var(--ink); border-color: var(--ink); }
li[data-done] .t { color: var(--ink-2); }
.t { margin: 0; font-weight: 600; }
.d { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--ink-2); font-size: 14px; }
.setup-go { align-self: center; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: var(--radius); color: var(--ink); font-size: 14px; text-decoration: none; }
```

#### States

- Done: filled `--ink` box with a stroked path, title in `--ink-2`, description replaced with what happened ("Imported 412 transactions"). No strikethrough.
- All done: the section collapses to one line, "Setup done. Hide", and removes itself after the next visit.
- Dismissed: gone, recoverable from the help menu.
- Blocked: when a task needs an admin, say so and name the admin: "Needs an owner. Ask Priya Nair."

#### Copy

```slop
Welcome aboard, Alex! Let's get you started on your journey.
You're 20% of the way there. Keep it up!
Explore the dashboard
Customize your workspace to make it yours
You're crushing it!
```

- Set up Ledgerline: 2 of 5 done
- Connect a bank account. Imports the last 90 days of transactions.
- Send your first invoice. Pick a customer, add line items, email a PDF.
- Setup done. Hide

#### Checklist

- 5 tasks or fewer, each detected from real use.
- No pre-checked tasks, no percent ring.
- Inline at the top of home, not a floating corner widget.
- Dismissible on the first visit, recoverable from help.
- No tour over 3 steps, no pulsing dots, no confetti.

### 5.4 Pagination

#### What the machine produces

```slop
<div className="flex items-center justify-between">
  <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">Showing <span className="font-medium">1</span> to <span className="font-medium">10</span> of <span className="font-medium">97</span> results</p>
  <nav className="flex gap-2">
    <button className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-4 py-2 shadow-sm hover:bg-gray-50"><ChevronLeftIcon className="h-4 w-4" /> Previous</button>
    <button className="h-10 w-10 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 to-purple-500 text-white shadow-md">1</button>
    <button className="h-10 w-10 rounded-full hover:bg-gray-100">2</button>
    <span className="px-2">...</span>
    <button className="h-10 w-10 rounded-full hover:bg-gray-100">10</button>
    <button className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-4 py-2 shadow-sm hover:bg-gray-50">Next <ChevronRightIcon className="h-4 w-4" /></button>
  </nav>
</div>
```

This is the Tailwind UI "Card footer with page buttons" with pill buttons and a gradient current page. Every page number is a `<button>`, so no page has a URL, the back button does nothing useful, and nobody can share "page 4". "Previous" is enabled on page 1 and does nothing when pressed.

#### Rules

1. Pick the pattern by task. Numbered pages for lists people return to by position (support queues, search results, audit logs). "Load more" for feeds. Infinite scroll only when the page has no footer and nobody needs to come back to a position.
2. Every page is a link with the page in the URL: `?page=4`. Never a `<button>` with local state.
3. Show first, last, current, and one neighbour on each side. That fixes the row at 7 slots, so its width never jumps. The ellipsis is text, not a control.
4. Targets are at least 32px square with 4px gaps. WCAG 2.5.8 asks for 24px. Use 32px.
5. The current page is a `<span aria-current="page">` with `--ink` background and `--paper` text. It is not a link.
6. Previous and Next are text links. At either end, render them as `<span aria-disabled="true">` in `--ink-3`, not as enabled buttons.
7. The range reads "41 to 60 of 1,284" in tabular numerals, left of the pager. Use thousands separators.
8. Page size options are 25, 50 and 100. Default to 50. Keep the choice in the URL.
9. After a page change, move focus to the table caption or heading and scroll the table top into view.

#### Reference build

```html
<div class="pager-bar">
  <p class="pager-range">41 to 60 of 1,284</p>
  <nav class="pager" aria-label="Pages">
    <a href="?page=2" rel="prev">Previous</a>
    <a href="?page=1">1</a>
    <span class="gap">...</span>
    <a href="?page=2">2</a>
    <span aria-current="page">3</span>
    <a href="?page=4">4</a>
    <span class="gap">...</span>
    <a href="?page=65">65</a>
    <a href="?page=4" rel="next">Next</a>
  </nav>
</div>
```

```css
.pager-bar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 12px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); font: 14px/20px var(--font-sans); }
.pager-range { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-2); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.pager { display: flex; gap: 4px; align-items: center; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.pager a, .pager span {
  display: inline-grid; place-items: center;
  min-width: 32px; height: 32px; padding: 0 8px;
  border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius);
  color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none;
}
.pager a:hover { border-color: var(--rule); background: var(--paper-2); }
.pager a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }
.pager [aria-current="page"] { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); font-weight: 600; }
.pager [aria-disabled="true"] { color: var(--ink-3); }
.pager .gap { min-width: 16px; padding: 0; color: var(--ink-3); }
@media (max-width: 480px) { .pager a:not([rel]), .pager .gap { display: none; } }
```

#### States

- First page: Previous is a disabled span. Last page: Next is a disabled span.
- One page only: hide the pager, keep the range text ("12 invoices").
- Narrow screens: below 480px show only Previous, the current page, and Next, with "Page 3 of 65" as the current label.
- Loading the next page: keep the old rows visible at full opacity and set `aria-busy="true"` on the table until the new rows arrive.
- "Load more": a full-width 40px outlined button that reads "Show 50 more (1,224 left)".

#### Copy

```slop
Showing 1 to 10 of 97 results
Load more awesome content
You've reached the end! 
```

- 41 to 60 of 1,284
- Page 3 of 65
- Show 50 more (1,224 left)
- End of list. 1,284 invoices.

#### Checklist

- Each page has a URL.
- Seven slots, fixed width, ellipsis as text.
- 32px targets, current page as a span with `aria-current`.
- Disabled ends rendered disabled.
- Focus moves to the table after a page change.

### 5.5 Pricing tables

#### What the machine produces

```slop
<div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-8 items-center">
  <div className="rounded-3xl bg-white p-8 shadow-lg">...Starter, $0/mo, Basic features, Get started...</div>
  <div className="relative scale-105 rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-b from-indigo-500 to-purple-600 p-[2px] shadow-2xl shadow-purple-500/30">
    <span className="absolute -top-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-pink-500 to-violet-500 px-4 py-1 text-sm text-white">Most popular</span>
    <div className="rounded-3xl bg-white p-8">
      <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold">Pro</h3>
      <p className="mt-4 text-5xl font-bold">$29<span className="text-base text-gray-500">/mo</span></p>
      <ul className="mt-6 space-y-3">
        <li className="flex gap-2"><CheckIcon className="text-emerald-500" /> Everything in Starter</li>
        <li className="flex gap-2"><CheckIcon className="text-emerald-500" /> Unlimited projects</li>
        <li className="flex gap-2"><CheckIcon className="text-emerald-500" /> Advanced analytics</li>
        <li className="flex gap-2"><CheckIcon className="text-emerald-500" /> Priority support</li>
      </ul>
      <button className="mt-8 w-full rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 to-purple-600 py-3 text-white">Get started</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div className="rounded-3xl bg-white p-8 shadow-lg">...Enterprise, Custom...</div>
</div>
```

This is the three-tier pricing block from every SaaS template: Starter, Pro, Enterprise at $0, $29 and "Custom". The middle card is scaled to 105%, wrapped in a 2px gradient ring with a purple glow, and topped with a gradient "Most popular" pill. Each card is a list of green check icons beside phrases that say nothing measurable ("Basic features", "Advanced analytics"), and every button reads "Get started" regardless of what happens on click.

#### Rules

1. Name plans after who buys them: Solo, Team, Company. Not Starter, Pro and Enterprise, and never `Premium`.
2. Write the price with its currency, amount, unit and billing basis in one place: "$24 per user per month, billed yearly ($288 per user)". A bare "$24/mo" hides the unit and the commitment.
3. If you offer a monthly and a yearly price, default the toggle to the one most customers buy and state the difference as an amount: "Yearly saves $72 per user". No "Save 20%" pill.
4. Every limit is a number: "3 projects", "10 GB storage", "90 days of history". Never "Generous storage" or "Advanced analytics".
5. Plan summaries list differences only, at most 6 lines each, starting from "Everything in Solo, plus". The full matrix goes into a comparison table below (see 5.21).
6. Mark the recommended plan with a line of text above it ("Most teams of 5 to 50 pick this") and a 1px `--ink` border on that column. No scale, no ring, no glow, no pill. If you cannot say who it is recommended for, recommend nothing.
7. Inside the comparison table, write "Included", a number, or a dash. If you use an icon, it is a 16px stroked SVG with a text label for screen readers. No green checks against grey crosses.
8. One button per plan, labelled with what happens: "Start 14-day trial", "Create free account", "Book a call with sales". One filled button for the recommended plan, outlined buttons for the rest.
9. Prices are 32px in tabular numerals, plan names 18px, summaries 14px. Align price baselines across columns.
10. Say what ends a free plan and what happens to data after a downgrade, in one sentence each, under the table.

#### Reference build

```html
<section class="plans" aria-labelledby="plans-h">
  <h2 id="plans-h">Pricing</h2>
  <p class="plans-basis">Prices per user per month, billed yearly. Monthly billing costs $6 more per user.</p>
  <div class="plans-grid">
    <article class="plan">
      <h3>Solo</h3>
      <p class="price"><span class="amt">$0</span> for one person</p>
      <ul><li>1 user</li><li>3 active projects</li><li>30 days of history</li></ul>
      <a class="btn btn-outline" href="/signup">Create free account</a>
    </article>
    <article class="plan plan-rec" aria-describedby="rec-note">
      <p class="rec" id="rec-note">Most teams of 5 to 50 pick this</p>
      <h3>Team</h3>
      <p class="price"><span class="amt">$24</span> per user</p>
      <ul><li>Everything in Solo, plus</li><li>Unlimited projects</li><li>2 years of history</li><li>SAML single sign-on</li></ul>
      <a class="btn btn-fill" href="/signup?plan=team">Start 14-day trial</a>
    </article>
    <article class="plan">
      <h3>Company</h3>
      <p class="price"><span class="amt">$41</span> per user</p>
      <ul><li>Everything in Team, plus</li><li>Audit log export</li><li>99.9% uptime in contract</li><li>Named support engineer</li></ul>
      <a class="btn btn-outline" href="/sales">Book a call with sales</a>
    </article>
  </div>
  <p class="plans-foot">Solo ends when you add a second user. Downgrading keeps all data read-only for 90 days.</p>
</section>
```

```css
.plans { max-width: 1040px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 64px 16px; }
.plans h2 { font-size: 32px; line-height: 1.2; margin: 0 0 8px; }
.plans-basis, .plans-foot { color: var(--ink-2); font-size: 14px; max-width: 66ch; }
.plans-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); margin-top: 32px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.plan { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; padding: 32px 24px; border-left: 1px solid var(--rule); background: var(--paper); }
.plan:first-child { border-left: 0; }
.plan-rec { outline: 1px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: -1px; background: var(--paper-2); }
.rec { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink); }
.plan h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; }
.price { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-2); font-size: 14px; }
.amt { display: block; font-size: 32px; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.plan ul { margin: 0; padding: 0 0 0 16px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; flex: 1; }
.btn { display: block; padding: 10px 16px; text-align: center; border-radius: var(--radius); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; }
.btn-fill { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); border: 1px solid var(--accent); }
.btn-outline { background: transparent; color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--ink); }
.btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .plans-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .plan { border-left: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }
  .plan-rec { order: -1; border-top: 0; }
}
```

#### States

- Billing toggle: a two-option segmented control (see 5.11) labelled "Yearly" and "Monthly". Switching updates every price and the basis line together. No animation on the numbers.
- Current plan (signed-in view): replace that plan's button with the text "Your plan" and a link "Manage in Billing".

#### Copy

```slop
Most popular
Best value
Pro: Unlock premium features and supercharge your workflow
Get started
```

- Most teams of 5 to 50 pick this
- Team: unlimited projects, 2 years of history, SAML single sign-on
- Start 14-day trial. No card until day 14.
- Book a call with sales. From $18,000 per year.

#### Checklist

- Plan names describe buyers. No `Premium`.
- Every price has unit and billing basis. Every limit is a number.
- Recommended plan marked with a sentence and a 1px `--ink` border only.
- No scale, ring, glow or gradient pill.
- Buttons say what happens next.
- Free plan limits and downgrade behaviour stated under the table.

### 5.6 Progress bars and steppers

#### What the machine produces

```slop
<div className="w-full rounded-full bg-gray-200 h-3 overflow-hidden">
  <div className="h-3 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 via-purple-500 to-pink-500 animate-pulse bg-[length:200%] shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(139,92,246,0.6)]" style={{ width: '75%' }} />
</div>
<span className="mt-2 inline-block rounded-full bg-indigo-50 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-indigo-600">75% Complete</span>

<ol className="flex items-center">
  <li className="flex items-center"><span className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 to-purple-600 text-white"><CheckIcon /></span><div className="h-0.5 w-24 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 to-purple-600" /></li>
  <li><span className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gray-200">3</span></li>
</ol>
```

The bar is the `rounded-full` progress from shadcn with a three-stop gradient, a pulse animation, and a purple glow. The percent pill reports a number with no unit of work behind it. The stepper is the Tailwind UI "Circles with text" pattern with the labels removed, so the user sees three numbered dots and no idea what step 3 is.

#### Rules

1. Use a determinate bar only when the fraction is real. If you cannot count the work, show a sentence with a count of what is done so far: "Imported 3,120 rows".
2. Bars are 4px tall inline and 8px tall as a page-level indicator. Track `--paper-3`, fill `--ink`. Radius 0 or `--radius`.
3. Show units of work, not only percent: "312 of 1,240 rows". Add time remaining only when your estimate is right within 20%.
4. Use the native `<progress>` element, or `role="progressbar"` with `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax` and an accessible name.
5. Move the fill with `transform: scaleX()` over 150ms or less. No stripes, no pulse, no shimmer.
6. Announce progress to screen readers at 25%, 50%, 75% and done through a polite live region, not on every tick.
7. Steppers have at most 5 steps. Every step shows its label at all times. Current step text is weight 600 with a 2px `--ink` underline.
8. Completed steps are links back. Future steps are plain text until they are reachable.
9. Below 600px, collapse the stepper to one line: "Step 2 of 4: Billing".

#### Reference build

```html
<div class="prog">
  <label for="imp" class="prog-label">Importing transactions</label>
  <progress id="imp" max="1240" value="312">312 of 1,240</progress>
  <p class="prog-count">312 of 1,240 rows</p>
</div>

<ol class="steps" aria-label="Checkout">
  <li class="done"><a href="/checkout/account">1. Account</a></li>
  <li aria-current="step">2. Billing</li>
  <li>3. Review</li>
</ol>
<p class="steps-compact">Step 2 of 3: Billing</p>
```

```css
.prog { max-width: 480px; }
.prog-label { display: block; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.prog progress { appearance: none; display: block; width: 100%; height: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--paper-3); color: var(--ink); }
.prog progress::-webkit-progress-bar { background: var(--paper-3); border-radius: var(--radius); }
.prog progress::-webkit-progress-value { background: var(--ink); border-radius: var(--radius); }
.prog progress::-moz-progress-bar { background: var(--ink); }
.prog-count { margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-2); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

.steps { display: flex; gap: 32px; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); font-size: 14px; }
.steps li { padding: 12px 0; color: var(--ink-3); }
.steps li.done a { color: var(--ink-2); }
.steps li[aria-current="step"] { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink); margin-bottom: -1px; }
.steps-compact { display: none; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; }
@media (max-width: 600px) { .steps { display: none; } .steps-compact { display: block; } }
```

#### States

- Indeterminate: no bar. A 16px stroked spinner plus a count sentence, or the sentence alone.
- Paused: bar stays, text reads "Paused at 312 of 1,240 rows. Resume".
- Failed: fill turns `--bad`, text names the row or file that failed and offers "Retry from row 313".
- Done: replace the bar with a sentence and the next action: "Imported 1,240 rows. Review duplicates (4)".

#### Copy

```slop
75% Complete
Almost there! Hang tight while we work our magic...
Step 2
You're crushing it!
```

- 312 of 1,240 rows
- About 2 minutes left
- Step 2 of 3: Billing
- Imported 1,240 rows. Review duplicates (4)

#### Checklist

- Determinate only when the work is countable.
- 4px or 8px, `--ink` on `--paper-3`, no stripes or glow.
- Count of real units beside the bar.
- Stepper labels always visible, 5 steps or fewer.
- Compact stepper text below 600px.

### 5.7 Search

#### What the machine produces

```slop
<div className="relative mx-auto max-w-2xl">
  <div className="absolute -inset-1 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 via-purple-500 to-pink-500 opacity-30 blur-lg" />
  <div className="relative flex items-center rounded-full bg-white/90 px-6 py-4 shadow-xl backdrop-blur">
    <MagnifyingGlassIcon className="h-5 w-5 text-gray-400" />
    <input className="ml-3 flex-1 bg-transparent outline-none" placeholder="Search anything..." />
    <kbd className="rounded-md border px-2 py-1 text-xs text-gray-400">Cmd K</kbd>
    <button className="ml-2 flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-violet-500 to-fuchsia-500 px-4 py-2 text-sm text-white">
      <SparklesIcon className="h-4 w-4" /> Ask AI
    </button>
  </div>
</div>
```

This is the docs-site search from the Algolia DocSearch and Mintlify defaults, inflated into a hero element. A blurred gradient glow sits behind a pill input, `outline-none` removes the focus ring, the placeholder promises "anything", and an "Ask AI" button with a sparkle sits inside the field so that the Enter key has two possible meanings.

#### Rules

1. Inputs are 36px tall in toolbars and 40px as a page's main search. 1px `--rule` border, `--radius` corners, 16px stroked icon inset 12px from the left.
2. The input has a label: visible, or `aria-label` when the icon and placement make the purpose obvious. Wrap it in `<search>` or `<form role="search">`.
3. The placeholder names what is searchable: "Search invoices by number, customer or amount". Never "Search anything".
4. Live results update 200ms after the last keystroke. Searches that hit a server show results after 300ms and keep the previous results visible while loading.
5. Report the count in a polite live region: "14 results for acme". When filters are on, say how many: "14 results, 2 filters on".
6. Mark matched text with `<mark>` styled as `--paper-3` background, `--ink` text, weight 600. Not yellow.
7. Show a keyboard shortcut as text in `<kbd>`: "/" or "Ctrl K" ("Cmd K" on macOS). Hide it on touch devices with `@media (hover: none)`.
8. Command palettes are 640px wide, placed 12vh from the top, over an overlay of `rgb(26 26 24 / 0.4)` with no blur. Rows are 36px. Show at most 8 rows before scrolling.
9. Escape closes the palette and returns focus to the element that opened it. Arrow keys move the active row. Enter runs it. The pattern is a combobox (see 5.8).

#### Reference build

```html
<search class="search">
  <form action="/invoices" method="get">
    <label for="q" class="sr-only">Search invoices</label>
    <svg class="i search-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-search"/></svg>
    <input id="q" name="q" type="search" autocomplete="off"
           placeholder="Number, customer or amount" value="acme">
    <kbd class="search-key">/</kbd>
  </form>
</search>
<p class="search-count" role="status">14 results for "acme"</p>
<ul class="results">
  <li><a href="/invoices/2041"><mark>Acme</mark> Freight, INV-2041, $4,120.00</a></li>
</ul>
```

```css
.search form { position: relative; max-width: 480px; }
.search input {
  width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 0 40px 0 36px;
  border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: var(--radius);
  background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font: 16px var(--font-sans);
}
.search input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-3); }
.search input:hover { border-color: var(--ink-3); }
.search input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: var(--ink); }
.search-icon { position: absolute; left: 12px; top: 12px; color: var(--ink-3); pointer-events: none; }
.search-key { position: absolute; right: 8px; top: 8px; padding: 2px 6px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--paper-2); font: 12px var(--font-mono); color: var(--ink-2); }
@media (hover: none) { .search-key { display: none; } }
.search-count { margin: 12px 0 8px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-2); }
.results { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.results a { display: block; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; }
.results a:hover { background: var(--paper-2); }
.results mark { background: var(--paper-3); color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; }
```

#### States

- Empty input: show recent searches or nothing. No "Try searching for something awesome".
- Typing: previous results stay at full opacity until new ones arrive.
- No results: repeat the query, offer to clear filters, offer the closest action: "No invoices match "acme ltd". Clear 2 filters, or create a customer named Acme Ltd."
- Error: "Search is not responding. Your filters still work." Keep filters usable.

#### Copy

```slop
Search anything...
Ask AI
No results found. Try a different search!
Oops, we couldn't find what you're looking for.
```

- Number, customer or amount
- 14 results for "acme"
- No invoices match "acme ltd". Clear 2 filters.
- Recent: INV-2041, Harbor Supply, overdue

#### Checklist

- Input has a label and a visible focus ring.
- Placeholder lists the searchable fields.
- Count announced in a live region.
- `<mark>` in `--paper-3`, not yellow.
- No glow, no pill, no AI button inside the field.
- Palette has no blur and returns focus on Escape.

### 5.8 Selects and comboboxes

#### What the machine produces

```slop
<Listbox value={selected} onChange={setSelected}>
  <Listbox.Button className="relative w-full rounded-xl bg-white py-3 pl-4 pr-10 text-left shadow-md ring-1 ring-gray-200 focus:outline-none">
    <span className="text-gray-400">Select an option...</span>
    <ChevronUpDownIcon className="absolute right-3 top-3 h-5 w-5 text-gray-400" />
  </Listbox.Button>
  <Listbox.Options className="absolute mt-2 max-h-80 w-full overflow-auto rounded-xl bg-white/95 py-2 shadow-2xl ring-1 ring-black/5 backdrop-blur">
    {options.map(o => (
      <Listbox.Option key={o.id} value={o} className="ui-active:bg-gradient-to-r ui-active:from-indigo-500 ui-active:to-purple-500 ui-active:text-white mx-2 rounded-lg px-3 py-2">
        {o.name} <CheckIcon className="ui-selected:block hidden text-indigo-600" />
      </Listbox.Option>
    ))}
  </Listbox.Options>
</Listbox>
```

This is the Headless UI `Listbox` example as published, with a gradient active row added. It replaces a native `<select>` for a list of six options, removes the focus ring with `focus:outline-none`, and floats the list on `shadow-2xl` plus a blur. The placeholder "Select an option..." gives no hint of what the options are.

#### Rules

1. Use radio buttons for 2 to 5 options that fit on screen. Use a native `<select>` for 6 to 15 known options. Use a combobox above 15 options or when the user may type a value that is not in the list.
2. The closed field is 40px tall with a 1px `--rule` border, `--radius` corners, and a 16px stroked chevron 12px from the right edge.
3. The open list sits on `--paper` with a 1px `--ink` border. The darker border separates it from the page. It is at most 8 rows tall (8 x 32px), then scrolls.
4. Options are 32px tall with 12px side padding. The keyboard-active option gets `--paper-3`. The selected option gets a 16px stroked check SVG on the left and `aria-selected="true"`.
5. A combobox follows the ARIA 1.2 pattern: an `<input role="combobox">` with `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` and `aria-activedescendant`, and a `role="listbox"` popup. Focus never leaves the input.
6. Filtering matches the start of any word, ignores case and accents, and bolds the matched part. Results appear within 100ms for local data.
7. When nothing matches, say so and offer to create the value if creation is allowed.
8. Multi-select shows chosen values as removable tokens, each with an accessible name such as "Remove Harbor Supply". Past 3 tokens, collapse to "Harbor, Acme and 4 more".
9. Prefer a sensible default over a placeholder. When there is no default, the placeholder names the choice: "Choose a currency".

#### Reference build

```html
<label for="cur" class="f-label">Currency</label>
<div class="select"><select id="cur"><option>EUR, Euro</option><option selected>USD, US dollar</option><option>GBP, Pound sterling</option></select></div>

<label for="cust" class="f-label">Customer</label>
<div class="cbx">
  <input id="cust" role="combobox" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="cust-list"
         aria-autocomplete="list" aria-activedescendant="cust-2" value="har">
  <ul id="cust-list" role="listbox" class="cbx-list">
    <li id="cust-1" role="option" aria-selected="false"><b>Har</b>bor Supply</li>
    <li id="cust-2" role="option" aria-selected="true" class="active"><b>Har</b>low and Sons</li>
  </ul>
</div>
```

```css
.f-label { display: block; margin: 16px 0 4px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; }
.select { position: relative; max-width: 320px; }
.select select, .cbx input {
  appearance: none; width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 0 36px 0 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: var(--radius);
  background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font: 16px var(--font-sans);
}
.select::after { content: ""; position: absolute; right: 14px; top: 15px; width: 6px; height: 6px; border: solid var(--ink-2); border-width: 0 1.5px 1.5px 0; transform: rotate(45deg); pointer-events: none; }
.select select:focus-visible, .cbx input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }
.cbx { position: relative; max-width: 320px; }
.cbx-list { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 44px; z-index: 20; max-height: 258px; overflow-y: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: var(--radius); }
.cbx-list li { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 14px; cursor: default; }
.cbx-list li.active { background: var(--paper-3); }
.cbx-list li[aria-selected="true"] { font-weight: 600; }
.cbx-list b { font-weight: 700; }
```

#### States

- Closed, open, keyboard-active option, selected option, disabled option (text `--ink-3`, `aria-disabled="true"`, still reachable by arrow keys).
- Loading remote results: keep the last list and add a row "Searching..." at the top. Do not clear the list.
- No match: one row, "No customer named "harx". Create Harx" when creation is allowed.

#### Copy

```slop
Select an option...
No results found :(
```

- Choose a currency
- No customer named "harx". Create Harx
- Harbor, Acme and 4 more

#### Checklist

- Radio, native select or combobox, chosen by option count.
- List on `--paper` with a 1px `--ink` border, 8 rows maximum.
- ARIA 1.2 combobox roles and `aria-activedescendant`.
- Focus ring kept. No blur, no gradient active row.

### 5.9 Settings pages

#### What the machine produces

```slop
<div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-6">
  <div className="rounded-2xl bg-white p-6 shadow-lg">
    <div className="mb-4 flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-500 to-purple-600"><BellIcon className="text-white" /></div>
    <h3 className="font-semibold">Notifications</h3>
    <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">Manage how you receive updates</p>
    <Switch checked className="mt-4 bg-indigo-600 shadow-inner" />
  </div>
  ...
  <div className="col-span-2 rounded-2xl border border-red-200 bg-gradient-to-r from-red-50 to-pink-50 p-6">
    <h3 className="font-semibold text-red-600">Danger Zone</h3>
    <button className="mt-4 rounded-xl bg-red-600 px-4 py-2 text-white shadow">Delete</button>
  </div>
</div>
<div className="fixed bottom-6 right-6"><button className="rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 to-purple-600 px-6 py-3 text-white shadow-xl">Save changes</button></div>
```

This is the settings screen from a dashboard starter kit: a grid of cards, one per topic, each with an icon in a gradient circle and a vague description. A floating "Save changes" button sits beside switches that may or may not already have saved. The "Danger Zone" card is pink and the button inside says "Delete" without naming what is deleted.

#### Rules

1. Layout is a 200px section list on the left and a form column at most 640px wide on the right. Below 768px, the section list becomes its own page.
2. Each setting is a row: label 14px weight 600, description 14px `--ink-2` at most 66ch, control on the right or below. Rows are separated by a 1px `--rule` border with 24px vertical padding. No cards.
3. Pick one save model per section. Switches and selects apply at once and show "Saved" beside the control for 2000ms. Text fields save with a button at the end of their section. Never mix both in one section.
4. Switches are only for settings that apply at once. Inside a form that needs a save button, use checkboxes.
5. Destructive actions sit last, in their own section titled with the action ("Delete workspace"). The button is outlined in `--bad` and names the object. Confirmation asks the user to type the workspace name.
6. Every section and setting has an anchor (`#email-digest`), so support can link straight to it.
7. Workspace-level settings show who last changed them and when: "Changed by Priya Nair on 3 Oct".

#### Reference build

```html
<section id="email" aria-labelledby="email-h" class="set-sec">
  <h2 id="email-h">Email</h2>
  <div class="set-row">
    <div><p class="set-label" id="digest-l">Daily digest</p>
      <p class="set-desc" id="digest-d">One email at 08:00 with yesterday's payments and overdue invoices.</p></div>
    <button type="button" role="switch" aria-checked="true" class="switch" aria-labelledby="digest-l" aria-describedby="digest-d"><span></span></button>
    <span class="set-saved" role="status">Saved</span>
  </div>
</section>
```

```css
.set-sec { max-width: 640px; padding-bottom: 32px; }
.set-sec h2 { font-size: 18px; margin: 32px 0 0; padding-bottom: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink); }
.set-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 4px 24px; align-items: center; padding: 24px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); }
```
