### 5.25 Dashboards as a whole

#### What the machine produces

```slop
<h1 className="text-3xl font-bold">Good morning, Alex</h1>
<div className="mt-6 grid grid-cols-4 gap-6">
  <Card className="rounded-2xl shadow-lg"><div className="rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-500 to-purple-600 p-3"><CurrencyDollarIcon /></div><p className="text-3xl font-bold">$45,231.89</p><span className="rounded-full bg-emerald-100 px-2 text-emerald-700">+20.1%</span></Card>
  ...
</div>
<div className="mt-6 grid grid-cols-3 gap-6">
  <Card className="col-span-2"><AreaChart fill="url(#indigoFade)" /></Card>
  <Card><DonutChart data={eightSlices} /></Card>
  <Card className="col-span-3"><SparklesIcon /> AI Insights: Revenue is trending up.</Card>
</div>
```

This is the shadcn "Dashboard" example with its `$45,231.89` and `+20.1% from last month`, extended by a model: a greeting, four KPI cards with icons in gradient circles, an area chart with a fading indigo fill, an eight-slice donut, and an `AI Insights` card that restates the chart. Every panel is a shadowed card, so nothing has more weight than anything else.

#### Rules

1. Start from the 3 questions the user asks every day, and give each one panel. Track clicks and remove any panel nobody opened in 30 days.
2. Title the page with its scope and range: "Overview, 1 to 15 Oct 2026". No greeting.
3. One date range control at the top drives every panel. Each comparison names its period.
4. At most 4 KPIs in one row, built as in 5.18. Every number links to the filtered list behind it.
5. Panels are regions with a 1px `--rule` border and a 40px header on `--paper-2`, laid out on a 12-column grid with 24px gutters. No cards, no shadows.
6. Use line and bar charts. Donuts only for 2 or 3 parts. Area fills are flat `--paper-3` or nothing. Chart rules live in 4.8, and chart color in 2.10.
7. Each panel loads on its own, with a placeholder the size of its final content.
8. Show freshness as text: "Updated 14:05". No "LIVE" pill and no green pulsing dot.

#### Reference build

```html
<header class="dash-head"><h1>Overview, 1 to 15 Oct 2026</h1><p>Updated 14:05</p></header>
<div class="dash">
  <section class="panel span-8" aria-labelledby="p-cash"><h2 id="p-cash">Cash in and out, by week</h2><div class="panel-body">...</div></section>
  <section class="panel span-4" aria-labelledby="p-over"><h2 id="p-over">Overdue invoices</h2>
    <div class="panel-body"><table>...</table><a href="/invoices?status=overdue">View all 7</a></div></section>
</div>
```

```css
.dash-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 24px; }
.dash-head h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 24px; }
.dash-head p { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-3); }
.dash { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 24px; }
.span-8 { grid-column: span 8; } .span-4 { grid-column: span 4; }
.panel { border: 1px solid var(--rule); background: var(--paper); }
.panel h2 { margin: 0; height: 40px; line-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; background: var(--paper-2); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.panel-body { padding: 16px; }
@media (max-width: 960px) { .span-8, .span-4 { grid-column: 1 / -1; } }
```

#### Copy

```slop
Good morning, Alex
AI Insights: Revenue is trending up.
+20.1% from last month
LIVE
```

- Overview, 1 to 15 Oct 2026
- Overdue invoices: 7, $18,240.00
- Revenue $84,120, +4.1% vs 1 to 15 Sep
- Updated 14:05

#### Checklist

- Each panel answers a named daily question.
- Scope and range in the title, one range control.
- Bordered panels on a 12-column grid, no cards.
- Numbers link to their lists. No greeting, no LIVE pill.

## Part 6. Stack Setup and Full Page Rebuilds

This part turns the rules into files. Chapters 6.1 to 6.7 are configuration: a base stylesheet, Tailwind configs for v3 and v4, replacement shadcn/ui components, a token file, lint rules, and an instruction block for coding agents. Paste them in, then delete what your project does not use.

Chapters 6.8 to 6.19 take twelve common pages, show the version a code generator produces on default settings, list every tell in it, and rebuild it. The rebuilt pages assume the base stylesheet from 6.1 is loaded, so each one carries only its page-specific CSS.

### 6.1 Base stylesheet

Load this file first, before any component CSS. It defines the canonical tokens, resets browser defaults, and styles bare HTML so that a page with no classes already follows the rules. It is about 9 KB unminified and has no dependencies.

Load the three fonts with one request. Ask for the weights you use and nothing else:

```html
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;600&family=Source+Serif+4:opsz,wght@8..60,400;8..60,600&display=swap">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/css/unslop-base.css">
```

```css
/* unslop-base.css. Load before every other stylesheet. */

/* 1. Tokens ------------------------------------------------------------ */
:root {
  --paper: #F7F5F0;
  --paper-2: #EFECE4;
  --paper-3: #E5E1D6;
  --ink: #1A1A18;
  --ink-2: #4A4843;
  --ink-3: #6F6C64;
  --rule: #D9D5CB;
  --rule-strong: #1A1A18;
  --accent: #B4441C;
  --accent-ink: #FFFFFF;
  --ok: #2F6B3A;
  --warn: #8A6100;
  --bad: #A3271F;
  --focus: #1A1A18;
  --radius: 2px;
  --font-sans: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  --font-serif: "Source Serif 4", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
  --font-mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, monospace;

  --s1: 4px;  --s2: 8px;  --s3: 12px; --s4: 16px; --s5: 24px;
  --s6: 32px; --s7: 48px; --s8: 64px; --s9: 96px; --s10: 128px;

  --t-12: 12px; --t-14: 14px; --t-16: 16px; --t-18: 18px; --t-21: 21px;
  --t-24: 24px; --t-32: 32px; --t-40: 40px; --t-56: 56px;

  --measure: 66ch;
  --page: 1120px;
  --control: 40px;
  --dur: 120ms;
  color-scheme: light;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] {
  --paper: #141412;
  --paper-2: #1E1D1A;
  --paper-3: #2A2925;
  --ink: #ECE9E1;
  --ink-2: #B5B1A7;
  --ink-3: #8F8B81;
  --rule: #34322E;
  --rule-strong: #ECE9E1;
  --accent: #E2703F;
  --accent-ink: #141412;
  --ok: #7FB38A;
  --warn: #D9A93A;
  --bad: #E0705F;
  --focus: #ECE9E1;
  color-scheme: dark;
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]) {
    --paper: #141412;
    --paper-2: #1E1D1A;
    --paper-3: #2A2925;
    --ink: #ECE9E1;
    --ink-2: #B5B1A7;
    --ink-3: #8F8B81;
    --rule: #34322E;
    --rule-strong: #ECE9E1;
    --accent: #E2703F;
    --accent-ink: #141412;
    --ok: #7FB38A;
    --warn: #D9A93A;
    --bad: #E0705F;
    --focus: #ECE9E1;
    color-scheme: dark;
  }
}

/* 2. Reset ------------------------------------------------------------- */
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
* { margin: 0; }
html { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; text-size-adjust: 100%; }
body {
  min-height: 100vh;
  background: var(--paper);
  color: var(--ink);
  font: 400 var(--t-16)/1.5 var(--font-sans);
  font-kerning: normal;
}
img, picture, svg, video, canvas { display: block; max-width: 100%; height: auto; }
input, button, textarea, select { font: inherit; color: inherit; letter-spacing: inherit; }
p, li, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, td, th { overflow-wrap: break-word; }
::selection { background: var(--paper-3); color: var(--ink); }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }

/* 3. Typography -------------------------------------------------------- */
h1, h2, h3, h4 { font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink); text-wrap: balance; }
h1 { font-size: var(--t-40); line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
h2 { font-size: var(--t-32); line-height: 1.2; }
h3 { font-size: var(--t-24); line-height: 1.25; }
h4 { font-size: var(--t-18); line-height: 1.25; }
h5, h6 { font-size: var(--t-16); line-height: 1.25; font-weight: 600; }
.display { font-size: var(--t-56); line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -0.015em; }
p, ul, ol, dl, blockquote, pre, table, figure { max-width: var(--measure); }
ul, ol { padding-left: 1.25em; }
li + li { margin-top: var(--s1); }
dt { font-weight: 600; }
dd { margin-left: 0; color: var(--ink-2); }
blockquote { border-left: 2px solid var(--rule-strong); padding-left: var(--s4); }
small, .small { font-size: var(--t-14); }
.lede { font-size: var(--t-18); color: var(--ink-2); }
.prose { max-width: var(--measure); }
.prose > * + * { margin-top: var(--s4); }
.prose > :is(h2, h3) { margin-top: var(--s7); }
.prose > :is(h2, h3) + * { margin-top: var(--s3); }
.serif { font-family: var(--font-serif); }
hr { border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }

/* 4. Links ------------------------------------------------------------- */
a {
  color: var(--ink);
  text-decoration-line: underline;
  text-decoration-thickness: 1px;
  text-decoration-color: var(--ink-3);
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
}
a:hover { text-decoration-color: var(--ink); text-decoration-thickness: 2px; }
a[aria-current="page"] { font-weight: 600; text-decoration-color: var(--accent); }
.link-quiet { text-decoration: none; }
.link-quiet:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

/* 5. Focus ------------------------------------------------------------- */
:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }
:focus:not(:focus-visible) { outline: none; }

/* 6. Forms ------------------------------------------------------------- */
label { display: block; font-weight: 500; font-size: var(--t-14); margin-bottom: var(--s1); }
input:not([type="checkbox"], [type="radio"], [type="range"]), select, textarea {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: var(--control);
  padding: var(--s2) var(--s3);
  background: var(--paper);
  border: 1px solid var(--ink-3);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
}
textarea { min-height: 120px; resize: vertical; }
::placeholder { color: var(--ink-3); opacity: 1; }
input:disabled, select:disabled, textarea:disabled { background: var(--paper-2); color: var(--ink-3); }
[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--bad) !important; }
input[type="checkbox"], input[type="radio"] { width: 16px; height: 16px; accent-color: var(--ink); }
fieldset { border: 0; padding: 0; }
legend { font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: var(--s2); }
.field + .field { margin-top: var(--s5); }
.hint { font-size: var(--t-14); color: var(--ink-2); margin-top: var(--s1); }
.error { font-size: var(--t-14); color: var(--bad); margin-top: var(--s1); }

/* 7. Buttons ----------------------------------------------------------- */
button, .btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--s2);
  min-height: var(--control);
  padding: 0 var(--s4);
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-weight: 500;
  text-decoration: none;
  cursor: pointer;
}
button:hover, .btn:hover { background: var(--paper-3); }
button:active, .btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); }
.btn-primary { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); }
.btn-primary:hover { background: var(--ink); border-color: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); }
.btn-quiet { border-color: transparent; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.btn-quiet:hover { background: transparent; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; }
.btn-danger { border-color: var(--bad); color: var(--bad); }
.btn-danger:hover { background: var(--bad); color: var(--paper); }
button:disabled, .btn[aria-disabled="true"] { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }
.btn-sm { min-height: 32px; padding: 0 var(--s3); font-size: var(--t-14); }

/* 8. Tables ------------------------------------------------------------ */
table { width: 100%; max-width: none; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: var(--t-14); }
caption { text-align: left; font-weight: 600; padding-bottom: var(--s2); }
th, td { text-align: left; padding: var(--s2) var(--s3); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); vertical-align: top; }
thead th { background: var(--paper-2); font-weight: 600; border-bottom-color: var(--rule-strong); }
td.num, th.num { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
tbody tr:hover { background: var(--paper-2); }

/* 9. Code -------------------------------------------------------------- */
code, kbd, samp, pre { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.875em; }
:not(pre) > code { background: var(--paper-2); padding: 1px var(--s1); border-radius: var(--radius); }
pre {
  background: var(--paper-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: var(--s4);
  overflow-x: auto;
  line-height: 1.45;
  max-width: none;
}
kbd {
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  border-bottom-width: 2px;
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 0 var(--s1);
  font-size: var(--t-12);
}

/* 10. Layout utilities ------------------------------------------------- */
.wrap { max-width: var(--page); margin-inline: auto; padding-inline: var(--s5); }
.stack > * + * { margin-top: var(--stack, var(--s4)); }
.cluster { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: var(--cluster, var(--s3)); }
.split { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: var(--s4); }
.grid { display: grid; gap: var(--s5); grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, var(--min, 280px)), 1fr)); }
.section { padding-block: var(--s8); border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.panel { border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: var(--s5); background: var(--paper); }
.panel-sunk { background: var(--paper-2); border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: var(--s5); }

/* 11. Text utilities --------------------------------------------------- */
.muted { color: var(--ink-2); }
.faint { color: var(--ink-3); }
.mono { font-family: var(--font-mono); }
.num { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.ok { color: var(--ok); }
.warn { color: var(--warn); }
.bad { color: var(--bad); }
.tag {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: var(--t-12);
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 20px;
  padding: 0 6px;
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  color: var(--ink-2);
}
.sr-only {
  position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0;
}

/* 12. Motion ----------------------------------------------------------- */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  a, button, .btn { transition: opacity var(--dur) ease-out, transform var(--dur) ease-out; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after {
    animation: none !important;
    transition: none !important;
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
  }
}
```

#### Decisions in the base stylesheet

- **Dark tokens appear twice.** Once under `[data-theme="dark"]` for an explicit toggle, once under `prefers-color-scheme` for visitors who never touch the toggle. The `:not([data-theme="light"])` guard lets a visitor force light mode on a dark operating system.
- **Input borders use `--ink-3`, not `--rule`.** WCAG 1.4.11 asks for 3:1 contrast on the boundary of a control. `--rule` on `--paper` is about 1.3:1. `--ink-3` is 4.6:1.
- **Links are ink with an underline.** The accent stays reserved for the one primary action on a screen. A page with forty orange links has no primary action.
- **Buttons change fill on hover, not elevation.** Primary goes from accent to ink. Secondary goes from transparent to `--paper-3`. The 1px press offset on `:active` is the only movement.
- **Transitions cover opacity and transform only.** Color changes are instant. This matches the motion rule and removes the slow 300ms `transition-all` fade that ships with most starter kits.
- **`max-width: var(--measure)` sits on block text elements**, so a page without a wrapper still keeps lines near 66 characters. Tables and `pre` opt out because their content is not running prose.
- **`.tag` is a rectangle with a 1px rule.** It replaces the rounded-full pill. There is no dot variant.
- **`.panel` is the only box.** Use it when content needs a boundary, such as a form group or a code sample with a caption. Most sections need only `.section`, which is a top rule and 64px of padding.

### 6.2 Tailwind v3 configuration

Tailwind ships with a palette whose most visible members are `indigo-500` and `violet-600`, eight shadow sizes, rounded corners up to `rounded-3xl`, gradient utilities, backdrop blur, and an animation named `ping` that exists to make a status dot pulse. Every one of those is a tell. Replace `theme` keys outright instead of using `theme.extend`, because extend keeps the defaults.

```js
// tailwind.config.js (Tailwind CSS 3.4)
/** @type {import('tailwindcss').Config} */
module.exports = {
  content: ["./src/**/*.{html,js,jsx,ts,tsx,mdx}"],
  darkMode: ["selector", '[data-theme="dark"]'],

  corePlugins: {
    ringWidth: false,
    ringColor: false,
    ringOffsetWidth: false,
    ringOffsetColor: false,
    ringOpacity: false,
    boxShadowColor: false,
    dropShadow: false,
    gradientColorStops: false,
    backdropFilter: false,
    backdropBlur: false,
    backdropBrightness: false,
    backdropContrast: false,
    backdropGrayscale: false,
    backdropHueRotate: false,
    backdropInvert: false,
    backdropOpacity: false,
    backdropSaturate: false,
    backdropSepia: false,
  },

  theme: {
    colors: {
      transparent: "transparent",
      current: "currentColor",
      inherit: "inherit",
      paper: { DEFAULT: "var(--paper)", 2: "var(--paper-2)", 3: "var(--paper-3)" },
      ink: { DEFAULT: "var(--ink)", 2: "var(--ink-2)", 3: "var(--ink-3)" },
      rule: { DEFAULT: "var(--rule)", strong: "var(--rule-strong)" },
      accent: { DEFAULT: "var(--accent)", ink: "var(--accent-ink)" },
      ok: "var(--ok)",
      warn: "var(--warn)",
      bad: "var(--bad)",
      focus: "var(--focus)",
      scrim: "rgb(20 20 18 / 0.5)",

      // shadcn/ui names, pointed at the same tokens. See 6.4.
      background: "var(--paper)",
      foreground: "var(--ink)",
      border: "var(--rule)",
      input: "var(--ink-3)",
      ring: "var(--focus)",
      muted: { DEFAULT: "var(--paper-2)", foreground: "var(--ink-2)" },
      card: { DEFAULT: "var(--paper)", foreground: "var(--ink)" },
      popover: { DEFAULT: "var(--paper)", foreground: "var(--ink)" },
      primary: { DEFAULT: "var(--accent)", foreground: "var(--accent-ink)" },
      secondary: { DEFAULT: "var(--paper-2)", foreground: "var(--ink)" },
      destructive: { DEFAULT: "var(--bad)", foreground: "var(--paper)" },
    },

    boxShadow: {
      none: "none",
      DEFAULT: "none",
      sm: "none",
      md: "none",
      lg: "none",
      xl: "none",
      "2xl": "none",
      inner: "none",
    },

    borderRadius: { none: "0", DEFAULT: "2px", sm: "2px", md: "4px" },
    backgroundImage: { none: "none" },
    blur: { none: "0" },

    fontFamily: {
      sans: ["var(--font-sans)"],
      serif: ["var(--font-serif)"],
      mono: ["var(--font-mono)"],
    },

    fontSize: {
      xs: ["12px", { lineHeight: "1.5" }],
      sm: ["14px", { lineHeight: "1.5" }],
      base: ["16px", { lineHeight: "1.5" }],
      lg: ["18px", { lineHeight: "1.5" }],
      xl: ["21px", { lineHeight: "1.3" }],
      "2xl": ["24px", { lineHeight: "1.25" }],
      "3xl": ["32px", { lineHeight: "1.2" }],
      "4xl": ["40px", { lineHeight: "1.15" }],
      "5xl": ["56px", { lineHeight: "1.15" }],
    },

    spacing: {
      0: "0",
      px: "1px",
      0.5: "2px",
      1: "4px",
      2: "8px",
      3: "12px",
      4: "16px",
      6: "24px",
      8: "32px",
      10: "40px",
      12: "48px",
      16: "64px",
      24: "96px",
      32: "128px",
    },

    transitionProperty: {
      none: "none",
      DEFAULT: "opacity, transform",
      opacity: "opacity",
      transform: "transform",
    },
    transitionDuration: { 0: "0ms", 75: "75ms", 100: "100ms", 150: "150ms", DEFAULT: "120ms" },
    transitionTimingFunction: { DEFAULT: "ease-out", out: "ease-out", linear: "linear" },

    animation: { none: "none", spin: "spin 1s linear infinite" },

    extend: {
      maxWidth: { measure: "66ch", page: "1120px" },
    },
  },
  plugins: [],
};
```

#### What each override does

- **`colors` replaced, not extended.** The default palette is gone, including `indigo`, `violet`, `purple`, `fuchsia`, `blue` and `sky`. A class like `bg-indigo-600` now generates nothing, so a pasted snippet renders unstyled instead of on-brand-for-someone-else. Colors point at CSS variables, so `data-theme="dark"` switches them at runtime without a second build.
- **`scrim` is a literal color.** Tailwind v3 cannot apply an opacity modifier such as `bg-ink/40` to a color defined as `var(--ink)`. The dialog overlay needs translucency, so it gets one fixed token.
- **shadcn names map to canonical tokens.** shadcn components reference `bg-background`, `border-input`, `text-muted-foreground` and so on. Mapping them keeps those components compiling while you replace them. One name collides: shadcn's `accent` is a pale hover tint, and here `accent` is the burnt orange. Any shadcn component you have not replaced yet will flash orange on hover. Treat that as a to-do list.
- **`boxShadow` keys all map to `none`.** Keeping the plugin and emptying its values means third-party markup that contains Tailwind's shadow classes renders flat, and `shadow-none` resets still work. Disabling the plugin would also drop `shadow-none`.
- **Ring plugins disabled.** Tailwind's `ring-*` utilities draw with `box-shadow`. Focus uses `outline-2 outline-offset-2 outline-focus` instead, which also survives Windows High Contrast mode, where box-shadow is removed.
- **`gradientColorStops` disabled and `backgroundImage` emptied.** This removes the gradient direction utilities and every color stop. Background images from a URL still work through arbitrary values.
- **All backdrop plugins disabled, `blur` reduced to `none`.** No frosted glass, no blurred hero glow.
- **`borderRadius` stops at 4px.** `rounded-lg`, `rounded-xl`, `rounded-2xl` and `rounded-3xl` no longer exist. `rounded-full` is gone too; add `full: "9999px"` back only if the product has avatars, and lint its use to avatar components.
- **`spacing` is the canonical scale plus 2px and 40px.** `p-5`, `gap-7` and `mt-10` stop working on purpose; the scale has no 20px or 28px step. The 40px step exists for control height (`h-10`).
- **`fontSize` uses the canonical type scale with unitless line heights** that fall inside 1.15 to 1.25 for headings and 1.5 for body.
- **`transitionProperty` default is opacity and transform**, and there is no `colors` or `all` key. `transition-all duration-300`, copied from any template, compiles to nothing.
- **`animation` keeps only `spin`.** `animate-ping` is the pulsing ring around a green status dot. `animate-pulse` is the shimmering skeleton. `animate-bounce` is the arrow under a hero. All three are removed.

### 6.3 Tailwind v4 configuration

Tailwind v4 has no `tailwind.config.js` by default and no `corePlugins`. Configuration lives in CSS under `@theme`. Setting a namespace to `initial` removes every default value in it, which is the v4 equivalent of replacing a key instead of extending it.

```css
/* app.css (Tailwind CSS 4.1) */
@import "tailwindcss";

/* Dark mode follows the data-theme attribute, not only the OS setting. */
@custom-variant dark (&:where([data-theme="dark"], [data-theme="dark"] *));

/* Step 1: clear the defaults. */
@theme {
  --color-*: initial;
  --shadow-*: initial;
  --inset-shadow-*: initial;
  --drop-shadow-*: initial;
  --text-shadow-*: initial;
  --blur-*: initial;
  --radius-*: initial;
  --animate-*: initial;
  --font-*: initial;
  --text-*: initial;
  --ease-*: initial;
}

/* Step 2: static tokens. */
@theme {
  --spacing: 4px;

  --radius-xs: 2px;
  --radius-sm: 2px;
  --radius-md: 4px;

  --font-sans: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  --font-serif: "Source Serif 4", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
  --font-mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, monospace;

  --text-xs: 12px;   --text-xs--line-height: 1.5;
  --text-sm: 14px;   --text-sm--line-height: 1.5;
  --text-base: 16px; --text-base--line-height: 1.5;
  --text-lg: 18px;   --text-lg--line-height: 1.5;
  --text-xl: 21px;   --text-xl--line-height: 1.3;
  --text-2xl: 24px;  --text-2xl--line-height: 1.25;
  --text-3xl: 32px;  --text-3xl--line-height: 1.2;
  --text-4xl: 40px;  --text-4xl--line-height: 1.15;
  --text-5xl: 56px;  --text-5xl--line-height: 1.15;

  --ease-out: ease-out;
  --default-transition-duration: 120ms;
  --default-transition-timing-function: ease-out;
  --animate-spin: spin 1s linear infinite;

  --container-measure: 66ch;
  --container-page: 1120px;
}

/* Step 3: colors read runtime variables, so data-theme swaps them. */
@theme inline {
  --color-paper: var(--paper);
  --color-paper-2: var(--paper-2);
  --color-paper-3: var(--paper-3);
  --color-ink: var(--ink);
  --color-ink-2: var(--ink-2);
  --color-ink-3: var(--ink-3);
  --color-rule: var(--rule);
  --color-rule-strong: var(--rule-strong);
  --color-accent: var(--accent);
  --color-accent-ink: var(--accent-ink);
  --color-ok: var(--ok);
  --color-warn: var(--warn);
  --color-bad: var(--bad);
  --color-focus: var(--focus);

  /* shadcn/ui names */
  --color-background: var(--paper);
  --color-foreground: var(--ink);
  --color-border: var(--rule);
  --color-input: var(--ink-3);
  --color-ring: var(--focus);
  --color-muted: var(--paper-2);
  --color-muted-foreground: var(--ink-2);
  --color-card: var(--paper);
  --color-card-foreground: var(--ink);
  --color-popover: var(--paper);
  --color-popover-foreground: var(--ink);
  --color-primary: var(--accent);
  --color-primary-foreground: var(--accent-ink);
  --color-secondary: var(--paper-2);
  --color-secondary-foreground: var(--ink);
  --color-destructive: var(--bad);
}

/* Step 4: paste the :root, [data-theme="dark"] and prefers-color-scheme
   blocks from section 1 of unslop-base.css here, outside @theme. */
```

#### What each override does

- **`--color-*: initial`** deletes all 22 default color families, so `text-violet-600` and `from-indigo-500` produce no CSS. It also removes `white` and `black`; `bg-transparent` and `text-current` keep working because they are static utilities.
- **`--shadow-*`, `--inset-shadow-*`, `--drop-shadow-*`, `--text-shadow-*: initial`** remove every named shadow size. The four namespaces are separate in v4; clearing only the first leaves inner and drop variants alive.
- **`--blur-*: initial`** removes the named steps behind `blur-md` and `backdrop-blur-xl`.
- **`--radius-*: initial`** followed by three steps means `rounded-lg` and larger have no value. `rounded-xs`, `rounded-sm` and `rounded-md` resolve to 2px, 2px and 4px.
- **`--animate-*: initial`** deletes `ping`, `pulse` and `bounce`. Only `spin` returns, for loading indicators.
- **`@theme inline` for colors.** Without `inline`, Tailwind writes `var(--color-paper)` into each utility and resolves it where the theme variable is declared. With `inline` it writes `var(--paper)` directly, so the value follows `data-theme` on any ancestor.
- **`--spacing: 4px`** keeps v4's multiplier model. Any integer works (`p-5` is 20px), so the scale is enforced by the class check in 6.6, not by the config.

#### What v4 cannot switch off

Some v4 utilities are static and ignore the theme. `bg-linear-to-r`, `bg-radial`, `bg-conic`, arbitrary values like `shadow-[0_0_40px_#6366f1]`, and every `ring-*` width still compile. Reject them with the class check in 6.6. Do not try to override core utilities with `@utility` to neutralize them; the override order is not part of Tailwind's public contract and has changed between minor versions.

### 6.4 shadcn/ui

shadcn/ui copies component source into your repository, so its defaults are yours to edit. The defaults are also the most recognizable component set on the web: the `rounded-xl border shadow` card, the 36px button with a 1px focus ring, the zoom-in dialog over an 80 percent black overlay. Replace these seven files after running `npx shadcn init`. Every replacement keeps the export names and props of the original, so call sites do not change.

#### The defaults to remove

These are the class strings shadcn generates (new-york style, Tailwind v3 era), shortened to the parts that matter:

```slop
// card.tsx
"rounded-xl border bg-card text-card-foreground shadow"
// button.tsx
"inline-flex ... rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-colors
 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring ..."
default: "bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow hover:bg-primary/90"
// badge.tsx
"inline-flex items-center rounded-md border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold"
// dialog.tsx
overlay: "fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/80 data-[state=open]:animate-in data-[state=open]:fade-in-0"
content: "... gap-4 border bg-background p-6 shadow-lg duration-200
          data-[state=open]:zoom-in-95 data-[state=open]:slide-in-from-top-[48%] sm:rounded-lg"
// dropdown-menu.tsx
"z-50 min-w-[8rem] overflow-hidden rounded-md border bg-popover p-1 shadow-md
 data-[state=open]:zoom-in-95 data-[side=bottom]:slide-in-from-top-2"
// sonner.tsx
toast: "group-[.toaster]:bg-background group-[.toaster]:border-border group-[.toaster]:shadow-lg"
// input.tsx
"flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-1 shadow-sm
 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring"
```

The pattern across all seven: a shadow for separation, a 6px to 12px radius, a box-shadow ring for focus with `outline-none` stripping the native outline, and zoom or slide entrances on overlays. The replacements below use a border for separation, 2px radius, outline focus, and either no entrance motion or a 120ms fade.

#### Button

```tsx
// components/ui/button.tsx
import * as React from "react";
import { Slot } from "@radix-ui/react-slot";
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

const buttonVariants = cva(
  [
    "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap",
    "rounded-sm border font-medium",
    "focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus",
    "active:translate-y-px disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50",
    "[&_svg]:size-4 [&_svg]:shrink-0",
  ].join(" "),
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        primary: "border-accent bg-accent text-accent-ink hover:border-ink hover:bg-ink hover:text-paper",
        secondary: "border-ink bg-transparent text-ink hover:bg-paper-3",
        quiet: "border-transparent bg-transparent text-ink underline underline-offset-4 hover:decoration-2",
        danger: "border-bad bg-transparent text-bad hover:bg-bad hover:text-paper",
      },
      size: {
        sm: "h-8 px-3 text-sm",
        md: "h-10 px-4 text-sm",
        lg: "h-12 px-6 text-base",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: { variant: "secondary", size: "md" },
  },
);

export interface ButtonProps
  extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>,
    VariantProps<typeof buttonVariants> {
  asChild?: boolean;
}

export const Button = React.forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ButtonProps>(
  ({ className, variant, size, asChild = false, ...props }, ref) => {
    const Comp = asChild ? Slot : "button";
    return <Comp ref={ref} className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size }), className)} {...props} />;
  },
);
Button.displayName = "Button";
export { buttonVariants };
```

The default variant is `secondary`, not `primary`. A screen gets one accent button, and making it opt-in means a developer has to choose which one. The shadcn variant names `default`, `outline`, `ghost` and `destructive` are renamed; if you would rather not touch call sites, alias them in the `variant` map.

#### Card

```tsx
// components/ui/card.tsx
import * as React from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

type DivProps = React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>;

export function Card({ className, ...props }: DivProps) {
  return <div className={cn("rounded-sm border border-rule bg-paper text-ink", className)} {...props} />;
}

export function CardHeader({ className, ...props }: DivProps) {
  return <div className={cn("flex flex-col gap-1 border-b border-rule px-6 py-4", className)} {...props} />;
}

export function CardTitle({ className, ...props }: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLHeadingElement>) {
  return <h3 className={cn("text-lg font-semibold leading-tight", className)} {...props} />;
}

export function CardDescription({ className, ...props }: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLParagraphElement>) {
  return <p className={cn("text-sm text-ink-2", className)} {...props} />;
}

export function CardContent({ className, ...props }: DivProps) {
  return <div className={cn("px-6 py-4", className)} {...props} />;
}

export function CardFooter({ className, ...props }: DivProps) {
  return <div className={cn("flex items-center gap-3 border-t border-rule bg-paper-2 px-6 py-3", className)} {...props} />;
}
```

`CardTitle` renders an `h3` instead of shadcn's `div`, so cards appear in the heading outline. The footer sits on `--paper-2`: a tonal step instead of a second border weight.

#### Badge

```tsx
// components/ui/badge.tsx
import * as React from "react";
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

const badgeVariants = cva(
  "inline-flex h-6 items-center rounded-sm border px-2 text-xs font-medium",
  {
    variants: {
      tone: {
        neutral: "border-rule text-ink-2",
        ok: "border-ok text-ok",
        warn: "border-warn text-warn",
        bad: "border-bad text-bad",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: { tone: "neutral" },
  },
);

export interface BadgeProps
  extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>,
    VariantProps<typeof badgeVariants> {}

export function Badge({ className, tone, ...props }: BadgeProps) {
  return <span className={cn(badgeVariants({ tone }), className)} {...props} />;
}
```

No filled variants, no dot child, no pulse. The tone colors the text and the border, and the words inside carry the meaning: "Failed 14:02", not a red capsule. The prop is `tone` instead of `variant` so a search for `variant="default"` on a Badge finds every unconverted call site.

#### Dialog

```tsx
// components/ui/dialog.tsx (the two parts that change)
import * as React from "react";
import * as DialogPrimitive from "@radix-ui/react-dialog";
import { X } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export const DialogOverlay = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof DialogPrimitive.Overlay>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof DialogPrimitive.Overlay>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <DialogPrimitive.Overlay ref={ref} className={cn("fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-scrim", className)} {...props} />
));
DialogOverlay.displayName = "DialogOverlay";

export const DialogContent = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof DialogPrimitive.Content>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof DialogPrimitive.Content>
>(({ className, children, ...props }, ref) => (
  <DialogPrimitive.Portal>
    <DialogOverlay />
    <DialogPrimitive.Content
      ref={ref}
      className={cn(
        "fixed left-1/2 top-1/2 z-50 grid w-[calc(100%-32px)] max-w-lg -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2",
        "gap-4 rounded-sm border border-rule-strong bg-paper p-6 text-ink",
        className,
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
      <DialogPrimitive.Close
        className="absolute right-3 top-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-sm text-ink-2 hover:bg-paper-3 hover:text-ink focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-focus"
      >
        <X className="size-4" strokeWidth={1.5} aria-hidden="true" />
        <span className="sr-only">Close</span>
      </DialogPrimitive.Close>
    </DialogPrimitive.Content>
  </DialogPrimitive.Portal>
));
DialogContent.displayName = "DialogContent";
```

The dialog appears without zoom or slide. The border is `--rule-strong` (ink) because a modal sits over a scrim and needs a hard edge; a 1px `--rule` line disappears against the darkened page. The overlay is 50 percent, down from 80, so the user can still see what the dialog is about.

#### DropdownMenu

```tsx
// components/ui/dropdown-menu.tsx (content and item)
export const DropdownMenuContent = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof DropdownMenuPrimitive.Content>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof DropdownMenuPrimitive.Content>
>(({ className, sideOffset = 4, ...props }, ref) => (
  <DropdownMenuPrimitive.Portal>
    <DropdownMenuPrimitive.Content
      ref={ref}
      sideOffset={sideOffset}
      className={cn("z-50 min-w-48 overflow-hidden rounded-sm border border-rule-strong bg-paper p-1 text-ink", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  </DropdownMenuPrimitive.Portal>
));
DropdownMenuContent.displayName = "DropdownMenuContent";

export const DropdownMenuItem = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof DropdownMenuPrimitive.Item>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof DropdownMenuPrimitive.Item>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <DropdownMenuPrimitive.Item
    ref={ref}
    className={cn(
      "relative flex h-8 cursor-default select-none items-center gap-2 rounded-sm px-2 text-sm outline-none",
      "data-[highlighted]:bg-paper-3 data-[disabled]:pointer-events-none data-[disabled]:opacity-50",
      "[&_svg]:size-4 [&_svg]:text-ink-2",
      className,
    )}
    {...props}
  />
));
DropdownMenuItem.displayName = "DropdownMenuItem";
```

`outline-none` is acceptable on menu items only because Radix moves focus and sets `data-highlighted` on the focused item, which gets a `--paper-3` fill. `min-w-48` is 192px; add `minWidth: { 48: "192px" }` to the v3 config, or use `min-w-[192px]`.

#### Toast with Sonner

```tsx
// components/ui/sonner.tsx
"use client";
import { Toaster as Sonner } from "sonner";

export function Toaster() {
  return (
    <Sonner
      position="bottom-right"
      duration={6000}
      visibleToasts={3}
      icons={{ success: null, info: null, warning: null, error: null }}
      toastOptions={{
        unstyled: true,
        classNames: {
          toast: "flex w-[356px] items-start gap-3 rounded-sm border border-rule-strong bg-paper p-4 text-sm text-ink",
          title: "font-medium",
          description: "mt-1 text-ink-2",
          actionButton: "ml-auto h-8 rounded-sm border border-ink px-3 font-medium hover:bg-paper-3",
          cancelButton: "h-8 px-2 text-ink-2 underline",
          error: "border-l-4 border-l-bad",
          warning: "border-l-4 border-l-warn",
          success: "border-l-4 border-l-ok",
        },
      }}
    />
  );
}
```

`unstyled: true` drops Sonner's built-in card styles, which include a shadow and an 8px radius. The default icons are set to `null`; the 4px left rule and the words carry the state. Duration goes from 4000ms to 6000ms because a toast with an Undo action needs time to read and reach. Never use `richColors`, which fills the toast with saturated green or red.

#### Input

```tsx
// components/ui/input.tsx
import * as React from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export const Input = React.forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>>(
  ({ className, type = "text", ...props }, ref) => (
    <input
      ref={ref}
      type={type}
      className={cn(
        "flex h-10 w-full rounded-sm border border-ink-3 bg-paper px-3 text-base text-ink",
        "placeholder:text-ink-3",
        "focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus",
        "disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:bg-paper-2 disabled:text-ink-3",
        "aria-[invalid=true]:border-bad",
        "file:mr-3 file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium",
        className,
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  ),
);
Input.displayName = "Input";
```

Height goes from 36px to 40px, which matches the button and clears the 24px minimum target in WCAG 2.5.8 with room for touch. The text is 16px at every breakpoint; below 16px, iOS Safari zooms the page when the field gets focus. Invalid state shows through `aria-invalid`, which screen readers also announce, so the visual and the semantic state cannot drift apart.

#### Leave the rest, then check

Components not listed here (Tabs, Select, Popover, Tooltip, Sheet, Command) carry the same `shadow-md rounded-md` pattern and the same zoom entrances. Apply the same four substitutions: border for shadow, `rounded-sm` for anything larger, outline for ring, no entrance animation. Then run the class check from 6.6 across `components/ui`. A run with zero findings is the definition of done.

### 6.5 Design tokens as data

Keep one source for the tokens and generate the CSS, the Tailwind values and the TypeScript constants from it. The shape below is Style Dictionary's: nested objects, each leaf holding `value`, `type`, and an optional `comment`. Keys are the canonical names, so the generated CSS variables match 6.1 exactly (`--paper-2`, not `--color-paper-2`).

#### Token files

```json
// tokens/base.json
{
  "radius": { "value": "2px", "type": "dimension", "comment": "0 or 2px. Never above 4px." },
  "font-sans": { "value": "\"IBM Plex Sans\", system-ui, -apple-system, \"Segoe UI\", sans-serif", "type": "fontFamily" },
  "font-serif": { "value": "\"Source Serif 4\", Georgia, \"Times New Roman\", serif", "type": "fontFamily" },
  "font-mono": { "value": "\"IBM Plex Mono\", ui-monospace, \"SFMono-Regular\", Menlo, monospace", "type": "fontFamily" },
  "s1": { "value": "4px" }, "s2": { "value": "8px" }, "s3": { "value": "12px" },
  "s4": { "value": "16px" }, "s5": { "value": "24px" }, "s6": { "value": "32px" },
  "s7": { "value": "48px" }, "s8": { "value": "64px" }, "s9": { "value": "96px" },
  "s10": { "value": "128px" },
  "t": {
    "12": { "value": "12px" }, "14": { "value": "14px" }, "16": { "value": "16px" },
    "18": { "value": "18px" }, "21": { "value": "21px" }, "24": { "value": "24px" },
    "32": { "value": "32px" }, "40": { "value": "40px" }, "56": { "value": "56px" }
  },

Strip the `//` filename lines before saving; JSON has no comments.

#### Build config

```js
// sd.config.mjs (Style Dictionary 4)
import StyleDictionary from "style-dictionary";

// Values are already final CSS. The only transform is the name.
const css = (destination, selector) => ({
  transforms: ["name/kebab"],
  buildPath: "build/",
  files: [{ destination, format: "css/variables", options: { selector, outputReferences: false } }],
});

const light = new StyleDictionary({
  source: ["tokens/base.json", "tokens/color.light.json"],
  platforms: {
    css: css("tokens.css", ":root"),
    js: {
      transforms: ["name/camel"],
      buildPath: "build/",
      files: [
        { destination: "tokens.js", format: "javascript/es6" },
        { destination: "tokens.d.ts", format: "typescript/es6-declarations" },
      ],
    },
  },
});

const dark = new StyleDictionary({
  source: ["tokens/color.dark.json"],
  platforms: { css: css("tokens-dark.css", ':root[data-theme="dark"]') },
});

await light.buildAllPlatforms();
await dark.buildAllPlatforms();
```

The default `css` transform group includes `size/rem`, which rewrites `16px` as `1rem` and fails on values like `66ch`. Listing transforms explicitly avoids both. If a token ever needs a computed value, add the transform for that one type instead of switching groups.

#### CSS-in-JS

Do not copy hex values into a JavaScript theme object. A `ThemeProvider` that swaps objects re-renders the whole tree on a theme change and duplicates the source of truth. Reference the CSS variables instead, and let `data-theme` on the root element do the switching.

```ts
// src/tokens.ts
const v = (name: string) => `var(--${name})` as const;

export const t = {
  color: {
    paper: v("paper"), paper2: v("paper-2"), paper3: v("paper-3"),
    ink: v("ink"), ink2: v("ink-2"), ink3: v("ink-3"),
    rule: v("rule"), ruleStrong: v("rule-strong"),
    accent: v("accent"), accentInk: v("accent-ink"),
    ok: v("ok"), warn: v("warn"), bad: v("bad"), focus: v("focus"),
  },
  space: { 1: "4px", 2: "8px", 3: "12px", 4: "16px", 5: "24px", 6: "32px", 7: "48px", 8: "64px", 9: "96px", 10: "128px" },
  text: { xs: "12px", sm: "14px", base: "16px", lg: "18px", xl: "21px", "2xl": "24px", "3xl": "32px", "4xl": "40px", "5xl": "56px" },
  font: { sans: v("font-sans"), serif: v("font-serif"), mono: v("font-mono") },
  radius: "2px",
  measure: "66ch",
  focusRing: { outline: `2px solid ${v("focus")}`, outlineOffset: "2px" },
  motion: { duration: "120ms", easing: "ease-out" },
} as const;
```

```tsx
// Panel.tsx (styled-components or Emotion, same syntax)
import styled from "styled-components";
import { t } from "./tokens";

export const Panel = styled.section`
  background: ${t.color.paper2};
  border: 1px solid ${t.color.rule};
  border-radius: ${t.radius};
  padding: ${t.space[5]};

  & + & {
    margin-top: ${t.space[4]};
  }

  &:focus-within {
    border-color: ${t.color.ruleStrong};
  }
`;
```

The `space` and `text` maps are literal pixel values because they never change by theme. Colors and fonts are variable references because they do. The key names (`paper2`, `ink3`) follow camelCase for JavaScript; the variable names stay kebab-case so the CSS and the JavaScript point at the same custom property.

### 6.6 Lint rules that enforce it

Three layers: stylelint for stylesheets, ESLint for JSX, and a dependency-free Node script that runs on any file type in CI. All three read the same lexicon file, `banned-words.txt` (one entry per line, `#` for comments; Part 7 holds the full list).

#### stylelint

```json
{
  "extends": ["stylelint-config-standard"],
  "rules": {
    "property-disallowed-list": [
      "text-shadow",
      "backdrop-filter",
      "-webkit-backdrop-filter"
    ],
    "declaration-property-value-allowed-list": {
      "box-shadow": ["none"],
      "transition-property": ["/^(none|opacity|transform)(,\\s*(opacity|transform))*$/"],
      "/^border(-(top|bottom)-(left|right))?-radius$/": ["0", "2px", "4px", "50%", "/^var\\(--radius\\)$/"]
    },
    "function-disallowed-list": [
      "linear-gradient",
      "radial-gradient",
      "conic-gradient",
      "repeating-linear-gradient",
      "repeating-radial-gradient",
      "repeating-conic-gradient",
      "drop-shadow"
    ],
    "declaration-property-value-disallowed-list": {
      "/^(transition|transition-duration|animation|animation-duration)$/": [
        "/\\b(15[1-9]|1[6-9]\\d|[2-9]\\d{2}|\\d{4,})ms\\b/",
        "/\\b\\d*\\.?\\d+s\\b/",
        "/\\ball\\b/"
      ],
      "/color|background|border|fill|stroke|outline/": [
        "/#(6366f1|4f46e5|4338ca|818cf8|8b5cf6|7c3aed|6d28d9|a78bfa|a855f7|9333ea|7e22ce|c084fc|d946ef|c026d3)\\b/i"
      ]
    },
    "color-named": "never"
  }
}
```

- `box-shadow` may only be `none`. The other three properties are banned outright.
- `function-disallowed-list` catches every gradient function, including ones hidden in `border-image` or `mask`, and the `drop-shadow` filter.
- Durations must be written in milliseconds and stay at or under 150ms; the seconds form (`0.3s`) is rejected because it hides 300ms in a shape that reads short. `transition: all` is rejected.
- The hex list holds the 400 to 700 steps of Tailwind's `indigo`, `violet`, `purple` and `fuchsia`. These are the values that leak in when someone pastes from a Tailwind UI snippet that was compiled to plain CSS.
- The radius list allows `50%` for avatars and radio buttons. Grep for `50%` in review and confirm each use is one of those two.

#### Shared lexicon and class rules

```js
// scripts/unslop-rules.mjs
import fs from "node:fs";

export const EMOJI =
  /[\u{1F000}-\u{1FAFF}\u{2600}-\u{27BF}\u{2B00}-\u{2BFF}\u{2190}-\u{21FF}\u{2300}-\u{23FF}\u{FE0F}\u{200D}\u{20E3}]/u;

function forms(w) {
  if (w.includes(" ")) return [w];
  const out = new Set([w]);
  for (const s of ["s", "es", "d", "ed", "ing", "ly", "er", "ers", "est", "ment", "ness"]) out.add(w + s);
  if (w.endsWith("e")) for (const s of ["ing", "ingly", "ely"]) out.add(w.slice(0, -1) + s);
  if (w.endsWith("y")) for (const s of ["ies", "ied", "ily", "ier", "iest"]) out.add(w.slice(0, -1) + s);
  if (w.endsWith("ize")) for (const s of ["ization", "ise", "ised", "ising", "isation"]) out.add(w.slice(0, -3) + s);
  return [...out];
}

const esc = (s) =>
  s.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&").replace(/-/g, "[-\\s]+").replace(/ /g, "\\s+").replace(/'/g, "['\u2019]");

export function loadLexicon(file = new URL("../banned-words.txt", import.meta.url)) {
  const entries = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8")
    .split("\n").map((l) => l.trim().toLowerCase()).filter((l) => l && !l.startsWith("#"));
  const alts = entries.flatMap(forms).sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length).map(esc);
  return new RegExp(`(?<![A-Za-z0-9])(?:${alts.join("|")})(?![A-Za-z0-9])`, "i");
}

// Tailwind classes. "s[h]adow" is spelled with a character class so this
// file passes its own check.
const V = "(?:^|\\s)(?:[\\w\\[\\]=&-]+:)*";
export const CLASS_RULES = [
  [new RegExp(V + "(?:inset-|drop-|text-)?s[h]adow(?:-(?!none(?:\\s|$))\\S+)?(?=\\s|$)"), "Shadow utility"],
  [new RegExp(V + "bg-(?:gradient|linear|radial|conic)\\b"), "gradient utility"],
  [new RegExp(V + "(?:from|via|to)-\\S+"), "gradient color stop"],
  [new RegExp(V + "backdrop-\\S+"), "backdrop filter utility"],
  [new RegExp(V + "ring(?:-\\S+)?(?=\\s|$)"), "Ring utility (box-shadow based); use outline"],
  [new RegExp(V + "rounded(?:-[trblse]{1,2})?-(?:lg|xl|2xl|3xl|full)(?=\\s|$)"), "radius above 4px"],
  [new RegExp(V + "animate-(?:ping|pulse|bounce)\\b"), "attention animation"],
  [new RegExp(V + "\\w+-(?:indigo|violet|purple|fuchsia)-\\d{2,3}\\b"), "indigo/violet/purple palette"],
  [new RegExp(V + "duration-(?:15[1-9]|1[6-9]\\d|[2-9]\\d{2}|\\d{4,})\\b"), "duration over 150ms"],
  [new RegExp(V + "transition-all\\b"), "transition-all"],
];

export const CSS_RULES = [
  [/box-shadow\s*:\s*(?!none\b)/i, "box-shadow"],
  [/text-shadow\s*:\s*(?!none\b)/i, "text-shadow"],
  [/drop-shadow\s*\(/i, "drop-shadow filter"],
  [/(?:repeating-)?(?:linear|radial|conic)-gradient\s*\(/i, "CSS gradient"],
  [/backdrop-filter\s*:\s*(?!none\b)/i, "backdrop-filter"],
];

export function checkClasses(str) {
  return CLASS_RULES.filter(([re]) => re.test(str)).map(([, msg]) => msg);
}
```

#### ESLint

```js
// eslint.config.js (flat config, ESLint 9)
import tseslint from "typescript-eslint";
import { EMOJI, loadLexicon, checkClasses } from "./scripts/unslop-rules.mjs";

const BANNED = loadLexicon();
const COPY_ATTRS = new Set(["alt", "title", "placeholder", "aria-label", "aria-description", "label", "description"]);

const unslop = {
  rules: {
    copy: {
      meta: { type: "problem", schema: [] },
      create(context) {
        const check = (node, text) => {
          if (EMOJI.test(text)) context.report({ node, message: "Emoji in user-facing text." });
          const m = text.match(BANNED);
          if (m) context.report({ node, message: `Banned word "${m[0]}" in user-facing text.` });
          if (/!(\s|$)/.test(text)) context.report({ node, message: "Exclamation mark in user-facing text." });
        };
        return {
          JSXText(node) { check(node, node.value); },
          JSXAttribute(node) {
            const name = node.name.name;
            const v = node.value;
            if (!v) return;
            const str = v.type === "Literal" ? v.value
              : v.expression?.type === "Literal" ? v.expression.value
              : v.expression?.type === "TemplateLiteral" ? v.expression.quasis.map((q) => q.value.cooked).join(" ")
              : null;
            if (typeof str !== "string") return;
            if (name === "className" || name === "class") {
              for (const msg of checkClasses(str)) context.report({ node, message: `Class rule: ${msg}.` });
            } else if (COPY_ATTRS.has(name)) {
              check(node, str);
            }
          },
        };
      },
    },
    classes: {
      meta: { type: "problem", schema: [] },
      create(context) {
        return {
          // cn("..."), cva("...", { variants }), clsx("...")
          "CallExpression[callee.name=/^(cn|cva|clsx|twMerge)$/] Literal"(node) {
            if (typeof node.value !== "string") return;
            for (const msg of checkClasses(node.value)) context.report({ node, message: `Class rule: ${msg}.` });
          },
        };
      },
    },
  },
};

export default tseslint.config(
  ...tseslint.configs.recommended,
  {
    files: ["**/*.{jsx,tsx}"],
    plugins: { unslop },
    rules: { "unslop/copy": "error", "unslop/classes": "error" },
  },
);
```

The `copy` rule reads JSX text and the attributes a person sees or hears. It does not read every string literal, because error codes and analytics event names would produce noise. Strings that live in a locale file are covered by the Node script below.

#### Node script for CI

```js
#!/usr/bin/env node
// scripts/unslop-check.mjs. Usage: node scripts/unslop-check.mjs src content locales
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { EMOJI, loadLexicon, checkClasses, CSS_RULES } from "./unslop-rules.mjs";

const BANNED = loadLexicon();
const SKIP = new Set(["node_modules", ".git", "dist", "build", ".next", "coverage"]);
const problems = [];

function walk(dir) {
  for (const e of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    if (SKIP.has(e.name)) continue;
    const p = path.join(dir, e.name);
    e.isDirectory() ? walk(p) : checkFile(p);
  }
}

function copyFrom(line, ext) {
  if (ext === ".json") return [...line.matchAll(/:\s*"((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)"/g)].map((m) => m[1]);
  if ([".md", ".mdx", ".txt"].includes(ext)) return [line.replace(/`[^`]*`/g, " ")];
  const text = [...line.matchAll(/>([^<>{}]+)</g)].map((m) => m[1]);
  const attrs = [...line.matchAll(/\b(?:alt|title|placeholder|aria-label|label)=["']([^"']+)["']/g)].map((m) => m[1]);
  return [...text, ...attrs];
}

function checkFile(file) {
  const ext = path.extname(file);
  const markup = [".html", ".jsx", ".tsx", ".vue", ".svelte", ".astro"].includes(ext);
  const styles = [".css", ".scss", ".less"].includes(ext) || markup;
  const copy = markup || [".md", ".mdx", ".txt", ".json"].includes(ext);
  if (!styles && !copy) return;

  let fence = false;
  fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8").split("\n").forEach((line, i) => {
    const at = `${file}:${i + 1}`;
    if (/^\s*(```|~~~)/.test(line)) { fence = !fence; return; }
    if (EMOJI.test(line)) problems.push(`${at}: emoji`);
    if (styles) for (const [re, msg] of CSS_RULES) if (re.test(line)) problems.push(`${at}: ${msg}`);
    if (markup) {
      for (const m of line.matchAll(/\bclass(?:Name)?=["'`]([^"'`]+)["'`]/g)) {
        for (const msg of checkClasses(m[1])) problems.push(`${at}: ${msg}`);
      }
    }
    if (copy && !fence) {
      for (const s of copyFrom(line, ext)) {
        const m = s.match(BANNED);
        if (m) problems.push(`${at}: banned word "${m[0]}"`);
      }
    }
  });
}

for (const target of process.argv.slice(2)) {
  fs.statSync(target).isDirectory() ? walk(target) : checkFile(target);
}
for (const p of problems) console.log(p);
console.log(`${problems.length} problems`);
process.exit(problems.length ? 1 : 0);
```

Wire all three into `package.json` and run them in CI on every pull request:

```json
{
  "scripts": {
    "lint:css": "stylelint \"src/**/*.{css,scss}\"",
    "lint:js": "eslint .",
    "lint:unslop": "node scripts/unslop-check.mjs src content locales",
    "lint": "npm run lint:css && npm run lint:js && npm run lint:unslop"
  }
}
```

### 6.7 Instructions for coding agents

Paste the block below into the file your agent reads on every task. Then paste the word list under it. The block is about 600 words, which fits comfortably in a system prompt; longer versions get skimmed by models the same way they get skimmed by people.

- Claude Code: `CLAUDE.md` at the repository root.
- Codex and other agents that follow the convention: `AGENTS.md` at the root.
- Cursor: `.cursor/rules/unslop.mdc`, with front matter `alwaysApply: true` and `globs: ["**/*.{tsx,jsx,html,css,md,mdx}"]`. The older single `.cursorrules` file still works.
- GitHub Copilot: `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.

```text
# Interface and copy rules (UNSLOP)

Follow these in every file you create or edit. If the task explicitly asks
for something these rules forbid, do it, and say which rule you broke.

Visual
- No box-shadow, text-shadow, drop-shadow filter, or Tailwind shadow-*
  utility except shadow-none. Separate layers with a 1px border
  (var(--rule)) and a background step: --paper, --paper-2, --paper-3.
- No gradients of any kind. No linear-gradient, radial-gradient,
  conic-gradient, Tailwind bg-linear, bg-gradient, from-, via-, to- classes,
  gradient text, or glow behind a hero.
- No backdrop-filter, glass panels, blur, neon, or animated borders.
- Radius is 0 or 2px, never above 4px. Circles only for avatars and radios.
- Colors come from the tokens in unslop-base.css or the Tailwind config.
  Never indigo, violet, purple, fuchsia or blue for brand, buttons or links.
  One accent color per screen, on the one primary action.
- Fonts: IBM Plex Sans for interface, IBM Plex Mono for code and figures,
  Source Serif 4 for long reading. Sizes 12 14 16 18 21 24 32 40 56px.
  Body 16px, line height 1.5, lines at most 66ch.
- Spacing 4 8 12 16 24 32 48 64 96 128px. Nothing else.
- Focus: outline 2px solid var(--focus), offset 2px. Never Tailwind ring-* utilities.
  Never remove the outline without a visible replacement.
- Motion: 150ms or less, ease-out, opacity and transform only, nothing under
  prefers-reduced-motion. No scroll reveals. No animate-ping, animate-pulse,
  animate-bounce.
- Icons: one SVG set, 1.5px stroke, 16 or 20px. No emoji anywhere: interface,
  copy, code comments, commit messages, docs.
- No status pills, no dots. No "LIVE", "New", "Beta" capsules. Write the
  state and the time: "Deployed 14:02 UTC".
- Left-align. Center only one short line.
- Do not put every section in a card. Use a top rule and spacing. A box is
  for a thing the user acts on as a unit.

Copy
- First line says what the product does and for whom, in words a customer
  uses. Then show it: screenshot, code sample, or a number with unit and date.
- Buttons name the action: "Create invoice", "Install CLI", "Delete 3 files".
  Never "Get started", "Learn more", "Submit" when a specific verb exists.
- Headings label content: "Pricing", "Install", "Limits".
- No exclamation marks, no em dashes, no rhetorical questions, no
  "Introducing", no "Welcome back" banners, no "Trusted by 10,000+ teams".
- Every number has a unit, a source or a date. Delete numbers you cannot source.
- Testimonials need a full name, role, company and date, or they go.
- Never use the words in the list below, in any form. If a sentence needs
  one, it has no claim in it: write the claim or delete the sentence.

Before you finish
- Run: npm run lint (stylelint, eslint, scripts/unslop-check.mjs).
- Report the output. Do not claim compliance you did not check.
```

#### Notes

- **The headline names the customer and the object.** The wrong visitor leaves in one second, which saves both sides time. The 2 to 40 range comes from the customer list, not a guess.
- **Four features as a definition list.** Each description holds a number, a day count, or a named format. No icons; the terms are the headings.
- **The screenshot is flat and captioned.** The perspective tilt exists to hide that the image is a mockup.
- **One action, one label, everywhere.** "Create account" in the header and the hero. The secondary action downloads a sample invoice, which answers the first question a studio asks.

    <p class="small muted">Version 2.0.3, 2 October 2026. Postgres 13 to 17. MIT licence.</p>
    <div class="cluster">
      <a class="btn btn-primary" href="/docs/quickstart">Read the quickstart</a>
      <a class="btn" href="https://github.com/pgshift/pgshift">Source on GitHub</a>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="section">
    <h2>A plan, before anything runs</h2>
    <p><code>pgshift plan</code> reads a migration and prints the steps with their lock level.
      Nothing touches the database until <code>pgshift apply</code>.</p>
    <pre class="plan"><code>$ pgshift plan migrations/0042_orders_status.sql
target   orders  41.2M rows  18 GB
step 1   ADD COLUMN status text                   ACCESS EXCLUSIVE   2 ms
step 2   backfill status, batches of 10,000       none               ~14 min
step 3   ADD CONSTRAINT status_nn NOT VALID       ACCESS EXCLUSIVE   3 ms
step 4   VALIDATE CONSTRAINT status_nn            SHARE UPDATE EXCL  reads and writes continue
step 5   CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY                none               ~6 min
longest lock: 3 ms</code></pre>
  </section>

  <section class="section">
    <h2>What it does with each change</h2>
    <table>
      <thead><tr><th>Change</th><th>pgshift</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr><td>Add column with default</td><td>Adds it nullable, backfills in batches, then sets the default and NOT NULL.</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Add index</td><td>Uses <code>CONCURRENTLY</code>. Drops and retries once if the build fails.</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Rename column</td><td>Refuses. Prints the expand, migrate, contract steps to do it in three deploys.</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Change column type</td><td>Refuses when Postgres would rewrite the table. Runs in place when it would not.</td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </section>

</main>
```

#### Notes

- **The terminal block is real output.** Developers trust a page in proportion to how much of the actual tool it shows. A plan with lock levels and row counts says more than any adjective.
- **Dark mode follows the system.** The base stylesheet switches on `prefers-color-scheme`. Forcing near-black on everyone is a style choice copied from other dev-tool sites, not a reader preference.
- **The refusals are on the front page.** "Refuses to rename a column" is the line that makes the rest credible.
- **Version, date, supported range and licence sit under the install line.** These are the four facts an engineer checks before reading anything else.

### 6.10 Analytics dashboard

The rebuild uses the Tailwind v3 config from 6.2. Its chart follows the single-series rules: one 2px ink line, a recessive grid, no legend, and a table view of the same numbers.

#### The slop version

```slop

```

#### Tells

1. "Welcome back, Alex" with a wave emoji, taking the top 100px of a screen people open to check numbers.
2. Four KPI cards, each `rounded-2xl shadow-sm ring-1`, each with an icon in an `indigo-50` tile.
3. The figures are the shadcn dashboard example's, unchanged: $45,231.89, +20.1%, +2350, +573 "Active Now".
4. Green change pills with no period stated. "From last month" compares a partial month to a full one.
5. Every delta green and upward, including ones where up is bad.
6. Area chart filled with an indigo-to-transparent `linearGradient`, stroked `#6366f1` (Tailwind `indigo-500`).
7. An "AI `Insights`" card on a violet-to-indigo gradient with a glass button, whose content is a restated number plus `leveraging` and `boost engagement`.
8. No date range, no data freshness, no table view of the chart.

#### The rebuild

```tsx
type Kpi = { label: string; now: string; prev: string; delta: string; better: boolean };

const kpis: Kpi[] = [
  { label: "Revenue", now: "$48,210", prev: "$44,980", delta: "+7.2%", better: true },
  { label: "New subscriptions", now: "312", prev: "341", delta: "-8.5%", better: false },
  { label: "Cancellations", now: "41", prev: "39", delta: "+2", better: false },
  { label: "Refunds", now: "$1,140", prev: "$1,620", delta: "-29.6%", better: true },
];

export function Overview({ days }: { days: { date: string; revenue: number }[] }) {
  const max = Math.max(...days.map((d) => d.revenue));
  const pts = days.map((d, i) => `${(i / (days.length - 1)) * 100},${100 - (d.revenue / max) * 90}`).join(" ");

  return (
    <main className="mx-auto max-w-page px-6 py-8">
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-4 border-b border-rule pb-4">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold">Overview</h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-ink-2">
          1 to 14 Oct 2026 against 17 to 30 Sep. Data as of 09:00 UTC. <a href="?range" className="underline">Change</a>
        </p>
      </header>

      <dl className="grid grid-cols-2 border-b border-rule md:grid-cols-4">
        {kpis.map((k) => (
          <div key={k.label} className="border-r border-rule px-4 py-4 last:border-r-0">
            <dt className="text-sm text-ink-2">{k.label}</dt>
            <dd className="mt-1 font-mono text-2xl tabular-nums">{k.now}</dd>
            <dd className="text-sm tabular-nums">
              <span className={k.better ? "text-ok" : "text-bad"}>{k.delta}</span>{" "}
              <span className="text-ink-3">from {k.prev}</span>
            </dd>
          </div>
        ))}
      </dl>

      <p className="border-b border-rule py-3 text-sm">
        New subscriptions fell 8.5 percent. 24 of the 29 missing signups were on the Annual plan,
        after the price change on 3 Oct. <a href="/reports/annual" className="underline">See the Annual plan report</a>
      </p>

      <section className="py-8" aria-labelledby="rev">
        <h2 id="rev" className="text-lg font-semibold">Revenue per day, USD</h2>
        <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" preserveAspectRatio="none" className="mt-4 h-48 w-full" role="img"
             aria-label={`Daily revenue, ${days[0].date} to ${days[days.length - 1].date}. Table below.`}>
          {[10, 55, 100].map((y) => <line key={y} x1="0" x2="100" y1={y} y2={y} stroke="var(--rule)" strokeWidth="1" vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke" />)}
          <polyline points={pts} fill="none" stroke="var(--ink)" strokeWidth="2" vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke" />
        </svg>
        <details className="mt-3 text-sm">
          <summary className="cursor-pointer">Show as table</summary>
          <table className="mt-2">
            <thead><tr><th>Date</th><th className="text-right">Revenue</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>{days.map((d) => (
              <tr key={d.date}><td>{d.date}</td><td className="text-right tabular-nums">${d.revenue.toLocaleString("en-US")}</td></tr>
            ))}</tbody>
          </table>
        </details>
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}
```

#### Notes

- **The KPI row is one strip, divided by 1px rules.** Four cards with four icons repeat the same frame four times. A `dl` strip reads as one row of figures and takes 40 percent less height.
- **Each delta names its period and its baseline.** "+7.2% from $44,980" can be checked. The color follows whether the change is good, so a rise in cancellations is red.
- **The AI card becomes one sentence with numbers and a link.** If a model or an analyst found the cause, state the cause. If nobody did, show nothing.
- **One series, one ink line, no fill.** A single series needs no legend; the heading names it. The table under `details` is the accessible view and the export for anyone who wants the figures.
- **Freshness is in the header.** "Data as of 09:00 UTC" answers the first question anyone asks about a dashboard number.

#### Tells

1. "Welcome to the docs" heading with a books emoji and "`Let's dive` in" under it.
2. Gradient band from `indigo-50` behind the search.
3. Search box with `rounded-2xl shadow-xl` floating mid-page.
4. Six category cards with emoji tiles, all the same size, so the quickstart has the same weight as "Community".

#### The rebuild

```html
<style>
  .docs { display: grid; gap: var(--s7); padding-block: var(--s7); }
  @media (min-width: 960px) { .docs { grid-template-columns: 220px 1fr; } }
  .side { font-size: var(--t-14); }
  .side ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; }
  .start { counter-reset: step; list-style: none; padding: 0; }
  .start li { padding-block: var(--s3); border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }
  .groups { display: grid; gap: var(--s6); grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); max-width: none; }
  .groups ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; font-size: var(--t-14); }
</style>

<div class="wrap docs">
  <nav class="side" aria-label="Documentation">
    <label for="ver">Version</label>
    <select id="ver"><option>3.4 (current)</option><option>3.3</option><option>2.x (end of life)</option></select>
    <form role="search" class="field">
      <label for="q">Search</label>
      <input id="q" type="search" placeholder="Event name, error code, endpoint">
      <p class="hint">Press <kbd>/</kbd> to focus.</p>
    </form>
  </nav>

  <main class="stack" style="--stack: var(--s6)">
    <header class="stack">
      <h1>Relay documentation</h1>
      <p class="lede">Relay delivers webhooks for you: it signs them, retries failures for 72 hours,
        and keeps a searchable log of every attempt.</p>
      <p class="small muted">Version 3.4. Updated 9 October 2026. <a href="/changelog">Changelog</a></p>
    </header>

    <section>
      <h2>Start here</h2>
      <ol class="start">
        <li><a href="/docs/quickstart">Send your first webhook</a> <span class="muted">10 minutes. Node, Python or curl.</span></li>
        <li><a href="/docs/verify">Verify signatures on the receiving end</a> <span class="muted">5 minutes.</span></li>
        <li><a href="/docs/retries">Choose a retry policy</a> <span class="muted">Defaults and when to change them.</span></li>
      </ol>
      <pre><code>npm install @relay/node</code></pre>
    </section>

    <section class="groups">
      <div><h3>Guides</h3><ul>
        <li><a href="/docs/guides/fan-out">Fan out one event to many endpoints</a></li>
        <li><a href="/docs/guides/replay">Replay failed deliveries</a></li>
        <li><a href="/docs/guides/rotate">Rotate signing secrets without downtime</a></li></ul></div>
      <div><h3>Reference</h3><ul>
        <li><a href="/docs/api">HTTP API</a></li><li><a href="/docs/cli">CLI</a></li>
        <li><a href="/docs/errors">Error codes</a></li><li><a href="/docs/limits">Rate limits and quotas</a></li></ul></div>
    </section>
  </main>
</div>
```

#### Notes

- **The first paragraph says what the product does in one sentence**, because a large share of docs visitors arrive from search and have never seen the marketing site.
- **"Start here" is an ordered list with time estimates.** It has an order, so it is an `ol`, and the times let a reader pick a task that fits the next ten minutes.
- **The other links are task titles, grouped under three plain headings.** "Rotate signing secrets without downtime" is something a reader searches for. "Guides" with a book emoji is not.
- **Version and update date sit under the title.** Stale docs are the most common support complaint; showing the date admits it up front.

#### Tells

1. Abstract 3D stock render as the hero, darkened with a black-to-transparent gradient so white text stays legible.
2. "Trending" pill with a fire emoji on a post with no traffic data behind it.
3. Title in the "`Unlocking` `the Power of` X: A `Comprehensive` Guide" pattern.
4. Read-time estimate with clock emoji, the default output of most blog starters.
5. A TL;DR box in `indigo-50` that says nothing the title did not.
6. Opening paragraph built from `in today's`, `fast-paced`, `landscape`, `more than just`, `crucial`, `delve`, `intricacies`.
7. Emoji on every `h2`, and a "Key `Takeaways`" list of check marks.
8. Close with `in conclusion`, `arsenal` and `happy coding`.

#### The rebuild

```html
<style>
  .post { padding-block: var(--s8); }
  .post header > * + * { margin-top: var(--s3); }
  .post .body { font-family: var(--font-serif); font-size: var(--t-18); line-height: 1.6; margin-top: var(--s7); }
  .post .body pre { font-size: var(--t-14); }
  .notes { margin-top: var(--s7); padding-top: var(--s4); border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }
</style>

<article class="wrap post">
  <header>
    <p class="small"><a href="/writing">Writing</a></p>
    <h1>Cache keys that survive a deploy</h1>
    <p class="lede">We cut origin requests by 61 percent by taking the build hash out of three cache keys.
      This is what we changed, and the one case where it broke.</p>
    <p class="small muted">Ines Duarte, platform team. 3 October 2026.</p>
  </header>

  <div class="body prose">
    <p>Every deploy changed our build hash, and the hash was part of the cache key for HTML, the
      product JSON and the image manifest. A deploy at 14:00 emptied the edge cache for all three.
      For the next 20 minutes, origin served 9 times its normal request rate.</p>
    <h2>What we changed</h2>
    <p>We keyed the JSON and the manifest on content instead of on the build:</p>
    <pre><code>cache_key = sha256(path + response_body)[:16]   # was: path + BUILD_ID</code></pre>
    <p>HTML kept the build hash, because it references the new script bundle.<sup><a href="#n1" id="r1">1</a></sup></p>
    <h2>Where it broke</h2>
    <p>Two pages read a feature flag at render time. Their body did not change when the flag did,
      so the edge served the old version for up to an hour. We added the flag state to the key for those two routes.</p>
  </div>

  <footer class="notes small">
    <ol>
      <li id="n1">Scripts are named by content hash, so old HTML still finds its bundle. <a href="#r1">Back</a></li>
    </ol>
  </footer>
</article>
```

#### Notes

- **The summary is the first paragraph, and it contains the result.** 61 percent, three keys, one failure. A separate TL;DR box only exists when the opening fails to do this.
- **Serif at 18px and 1.6 line height for the body, sans for the interface around it.** Long reading benefits from the larger size; 66ch still holds.
- **No hero image.** An abstract render tells the reader nothing about cache keys. A diagram of the request path would earn its place; stock art does not.
- **The failure case gets its own heading.** It is the most useful section for a reader about to try the same change, and the most credible part of the post.

    <button class="rounded-full border">Get Started</button></div>
  <div class="relative scale-105 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-indigo-500 to-purple-600 p-[2px] shadow-2xl">
    <span class="absolute -top-4 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-pink-500 to-orange-400 px-4 text-xs">{emoji:star} Most Popular</span>
    <div class="rounded-2xl bg-white p-8"><h3>Pro</h3><p class="text-5xl font-bold">$49<span>/mo</span></p>
      <ul><li>{emoji:check} Unlimited projects</li><li>{emoji:check} Advanced analytics</li>
          <li>{emoji:check} Priority support</li><li>{emoji:check} AI-powered insights</li></ul>
      <button class="w-full rounded-full bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-lg">Start Free Trial</button></div></div>
  <div class="rounded-2xl border p-8 shadow-sm"><h3>Enterprise</h3><p class="text-5xl font-bold">Custom</p>
    <ul><li>{emoji:check} Everything in Pro</li><li>{emoji:check} Dedicated success manager</li>
        <li>{emoji:check} Enterprise-grade security</li></ul><button>Contact Sales</button></div>
</div>
<details><summary>Can I cancel anytime?</summary>Absolutely! Cancel anytime, no questions asked. {emoji:smile}</details>
```

#### Tells

1. "Simple, transparent pricing" with a money emoji: the heading on most SaaS template pricing pages.
2. A pill toggle with a green "Save 20%" capsule, while the yearly price never shows the yearly total.
3. The middle plan scaled to 105 percent inside a 2px indigo-to-purple gradient border with `shadow-2xl`.
4. A "Most Popular" badge in a second gradient, pink to orange, with a star emoji. Nobody states who it is popular with.
5. Feature lines that cannot be compared: "Basic analytics" against "Advanced analytics", "Email support" against "Priority support".
6. `AI-powered` `insights` as a Pro line item, with no description.
7. Enterprise priced "Custom" and listing `enterprise-grade` security, so the security on the other plans is something less.
8. Three button labels for one kind of action.
9. An FAQ answer of "Absolutely" plus an exclamation mark and an emoji.

#### The rebuild

```html
<style>
  .plans th[scope="col"] { vertical-align: bottom; }
  .plans .price { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--t-24); font-weight: 500; }
  .plans td:not(:first-child), .plans th[scope="col"] { width: 22%; }
  .billing { display: grid; gap: var(--s5); margin-top: var(--s5); }
</style>

<main class="wrap stack" style="--stack: var(--s7); padding-block: var(--s8)">
  <header class="stack">
    <h1>Pricing</h1>
    <p class="lede">Prices in USD, per workspace, before tax. Pay monthly, or yearly for two months free.</p>
  </header>

  <table class="plans">
    <thead>
      <tr><th></th><th scope="col">Free</th><th scope="col">Team</th><th scope="col">Business</th></tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><th scope="row">Monthly</th><td class="price">$0</td><td class="price">$40</td><td class="price">$120</td></tr>
      <tr><th scope="row">Yearly</th><td>$0</td><td>$400 ($33.33 a month)</td><td>$1,200 ($100 a month)</td></tr>
      <tr><th scope="row">Members</th><td>3</td><td>15</td><td>Unlimited</td></tr>
      <tr><th scope="row">Projects</th><td>5</td><td>Unlimited</td><td>Unlimited</td></tr>
      <tr><th scope="row">History kept</th><td>30 days</td><td>1 year</td><td>Forever, plus export</td></tr>
      <tr><th scope="row">SAML single sign-on</th><td>No</td><td>No</td><td>Yes</td></tr>
      <tr><th scope="row">Support reply, working days</th><td>Forum</td><td>Within 1 day</td><td>Within 4 hours</td></tr>
      <tr><th scope="row"></th>
        <td><a class="btn" href="/signup">Create workspace</a></td>
        <td><a class="btn btn-primary" href="/signup?plan=team">Create workspace</a></td>
        <td><a class="btn" href="/signup?plan=business">Create workspace</a></td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>

  <section>
    <h2>Billing questions</h2>
    <dl class="billing">
      <div><dt>What happens when we reach a limit?</dt>
        <dd>Nothing breaks. We email the workspace owners, and new members or projects wait until you upgrade or remove some.</dd></div>
      <div><dt>Can we cancel?</dt>
        <dd>Yes, from Settings, Billing. Monthly plans stop at the end of the month. Yearly plans are refunded for the unused whole months.</dd></div>
    </dl>
  </section>
</main>
```

#### Notes

- **A table, because pricing is a comparison.** Rows hold the same attribute across plans, so a reader moves one eye line to compare. Three cards force them to hold numbers in memory.
- **Every row is a quantity or a yes or no.** "Within 4 hours, working days" replaces "Priority support". "History kept" replaces "Advanced analytics".
- **Yearly shows the total and the arithmetic.** "Two months free" plus $400 against $40 a month is checkable in one glance. "Save 20%" was not even right; 2 of 12 months is 16.7 percent.
- **The recommended plan gets the accent button, nothing else.** No scale, no badge, no border. One accent per page holds here too.

#### Tells

#### The rebuild

```html
<style>

</style>

<main class="wrap">
  <section class="app-hero">
